  - the identity tolerances: $10^{-6}$ for the finite-difference, persistent-injection and Hessian checks
    (measured at most $6.9\times10^{-10}$, $3.8\times10^{-8}$ and $7.9\times10^{-12}$);
  - $10^{-14}$ at $\lambda=0$ (measured 0);
  - 0.2 on the $\lambda=2$ ratio (measured 1.97–1.98);
  - the factor 10 in S4(c) (measured at most 4.4);
  - $10^{-17}$ for $S^{(C)}$ at $u$ (measured at most $3.8\times10^{-19}$);
  - $10^{-6}$ on our minimized statistic against lavaan's (measured at most $8.6\times10^{-8}$);
  - the negative controls' margins: $>10^{-3}$ wherever $P$ stands in for $J$ (measured
    $\ge5.3\times10^{-3}$), and $>10$ for $dw$ without $r$ (measured $\ge65$);
  - in `mg-sens-d`: $\varepsilon_V=2u$ (measured at most $0.89u$); the factor 100 between the
    re-evaluated and the frozen floor (measured over 1000); $10^{-15}$ for exact-$\Delta$ residues
    (measured at most $1.3\times10^{-16}$); the factor 100 for the coupling (measured over 3000).
- **Not tolerances:** the inequalities $\le1$, $\le$ `env` and $\le$ `plain_bound`. They are the derived
  bounds themselves.

**(i) Result S1 against finite differences.** The checks run at $\eta=10^{-5}$:
- a known relative $dw$, then separately a known $ds$, against central differences of tight refits;
- the corollary at $\lambda=0$ and at $\lambda=2$;
- two controls: $P$ in place of $J$, and $dw$ without $r$.

**(ii) $J$ against $P$:**
- the contraction $c$;
- $\|R\|/\|P\|$;
- $2J$ against a central difference of the exact gradient;
- the $c/(1-c)$ bound.

**(iii) The stopping iterate.** Our own Gauss–Newton iteration runs with `optimize()`'s stopping rule as
we read it, from the ULS start. It is then repeated with $\pm$ a known $dw$, stopping at the same
iteration count, for $K-2,\dots,K+1$. The checks:
- the perturbed runs' own stops are at the same $K$, with no halving;
- the envelope (b) holds;
- the gap is at most $10\,\delta_{K-1}$ (S4(c));
- the gap shrinks with each extra step.

**(C)** Additive perturbations are injected at a known size in place of rounding:
- persistent, against $J^{-1}\delta\hat g$, with $P^{-1}$ as the control;
- one step only, showing the contraction;
- random relative perturbations of $\hat g$ and $P$ at every step, against S3(4).

S3(4) is then evaluated at $u$ itself.

**(iv) The summation model.** A shuffled sum whose exact value is known is computed two ways:
- plain double summation varies with the order, inside $\gamma_{n-1}\sum|x|$;
- double-double accumulation followed by one rounding gives the exact value in every order.

**(v) Result S5.** An R model of production's $\Delta$ replaces the complex-step correlation rows of the
$\lambda$ and $\psi$ columns with `dwlsmv_mg_dcols`'s central difference. The checks:
- $E$ against the bound's scale ($\varepsilon_V$);
- the polish floor with $\Delta$ re-evaluated against $\Delta$ frozen;
- determinism under identical inputs;
- twenty ulp-size $w$ triggers, with the exact $\Delta$ and with the production-like one, at the
  production stopping rule from the ULS start, against S1's linear prediction and S5(c)'s envelope.

```{r mg-sens-setup}
# Design E's pooled objective (weighting (a)), our own sigma(theta): s_g, Gamma_g from lavaan's Stage 1 on
# dE (mg-we), sigma from inv_model. Delta by complex step (exact to rounding); the residual curvature
# R = sum_k w_k r_k grad^2 sigma_k by a central difference of Delta' (w o r) with r held fixed.
sv_E   <- mg_parts(fE1$fit)                                   # configural fit: only its Stage 1 is used
sv_s   <- unlist(lapply(lavTech(fE1$fit, "wls.obs"), as.numeric))
sv_w   <- sv_E$w                                              # pi_g / diag(Gamma_g), stacked
sv_jac <- function(sig, x, h = 1e-30)
  sapply(seq_along(x), function(i) { e <- complex(real = x, imaginary = 0); e[i] <- e[i] + 1i * h; Im(sig(e)) / h })
stopifnot(max(Mod(tcrossprod(c(1 + 2i, 3 - 1i)) - c(1 + 2i, 3 - 1i) %*% t(c(1 + 2i, 3 - 1i)))) == 0)  # no conjugation
# One Gauss-Newton iteration as dwlsmv_minimize runs it (step P^-1 ghat, ghat = Delta'W r = -grad F / 2),
# optionally with step halving on F and the stopping rule nu < nrtol and (ptol or vtol).
# nu = g'H^-1 g with g = grad F, H = 2P, i.e. nu = 2 ghat'P^-1 ghat. dg / dP: injected perturbations (C).
sv_gn <- function(sig, s, w, x, K = NULL, halve = TRUE, maxit = 200, nrtol = 1e-12, ptol = 1e-10, vtol = 1e-12,
                  dg = function(j, gh, P) 0, dP = function(j, P) 0) {
  Ff <- function(x) sum(w * (s - sig(x))^2); f <- Ff(x); xs <- list(x); nus <- numeric(); halv <- 0L
  for (j in seq_len(maxit)) {
    D <- sv_jac(sig, x); P <- crossprod(D, w * D); gh <- drop(crossprod(D, w * (s - sig(x))))
    st <- solve(P + dP(j, P), gh + dg(j, gh, P)); a <- 1; xn <- x + st; fn <- Ff(xn)
    if (halve) while (fn > f && a > 2^-30) { a <- a / 2; xn <- x + a * st; fn <- Ff(xn); halv <- halv + 1L }
    xo <- x; fo <- f; x <- xn; f <- fn; xs[[j + 1L]] <- x
    Dn <- sv_jac(sig, x); ghn <- drop(crossprod(Dn, w * (s - sig(x))))
    nus <- c(nus, 2 * sum(ghn * solve(crossprod(Dn, w * Dn), ghn)))
    stop_rule <- nus[j] < nrtol && (max(abs(x - xo) / (abs(xo) + 1)) < ptol || abs(f - fo) / (abs(fo) + 1) < vtol)
    if (if (is.null(K)) stop_rule else j == K) break
  }
  list(x = x, K = j, nus = nus, halv = halv, xs = xs)
}
sv_tight <- function(sig, s, w, x) sv_gn(sig, s, w, x, halve = FALSE, maxit = 80, K = 80)$x   # rounding floor
sv_parts <- function(sig, s, w, x, h = 1e-4) {
  D <- sv_jac(sig, x); r <- s - sig(x); P <- crossprod(D, w * D); wr <- w * r
  R <- sapply(seq_along(x), function(j) { e <- replace(numeric(length(x)), j, h)
    (crossprod(sv_jac(sig, x + e), wr) - crossprod(sv_jac(sig, x - e), wr)) / (2 * h) })
  R <- (R + t(R)) / 2; J <- P - R
  list(D = D, r = r, P = P, R = R, J = J, A = solve(J, t(w * D)),           # A = J^-1 Delta'W
       c = max(abs(Re(eigen(solve(P, R), only.values = TRUE)$values))))      # || I - P^-1 J ||_P
}
sv_lev <- lapply(setNames(nm = c("loadings", "intercepts")), function(lev) {
  m <- inv_model(inv_designs$E, lev); sig <- m$sigma
  x0  <- sv_gn(sig, sv_s, rep(1, length(sv_s)), inv_point(m, inv_tau(inv_designs$E), inv_lam))$x   # ULS start
  th  <- sv_tight(sig, sv_s, sv_w, sv_gn(sig, sv_s, sv_w, x0)$x)                                 # exact minimizer
  gid <- rep(seq_along(sv_E$wv), lengths(sv_E$wv)); r <- sv_s - sig(th)          # the layout is lavaan's:
  Tc <- sum((sv_E$n_g - 1) * tapply(unlist(sv_E$wv) * r^2, gid, sum))           # its minimized statistic (C)
  rl <- abs(Tc / inv_fit(dE, lev)$chisq - 1); cat(sprintf("%s: our T_C against lavaan's, relative %.2g\n", lev, rl))
  stopifnot(rl < 1e-6)                                                            # chosen after measuring
  c(list(sig = sig, nm = rep(names(m$lay), m$lay), x0 = x0, th = th), sv_parts(sig, sv_s, sv_w, th))
})
sv_kap <- function(o) data.frame(par = o$nm, theta = o$th,
  kap_s = rowSums(abs(o$A)) / (1 + abs(o$th)), kap_w = drop(abs(o$A) %*% abs(o$r)) / (1 + abs(o$th)))
invisible(lapply(names(sv_lev), function(lev) {
  k <- sv_kap(sv_lev[[lev]]); cat(lev, "\n"); print(head(k[order(-k$kap_w), ], 6), digits = 3) }))
```

```{r mg-sens-a}
# (i) Result S1 against central finite differences of tight refits: a known relative dw, then a known ds.
set.seed(20261014); sv_xi <- sample(c(-1, 1), length(sv_s), TRUE)
sv_fd <- function(o, s1, w1, s2, w2) (sv_tight(o$sig, s1, w1, o$th) - sv_tight(o$sig, s2, w2, o$th)) / 2
sv_ra <- sapply(sv_lev, function(o) {
  eta <- 1e-5; eps <- eta * sv_xi; ds <- 1e-6 * sv_xi
  fw <- sv_fd(o, sv_s, sv_w * (1 + eps), sv_s, sv_w * (1 - eps)); pw <- drop(o$A %*% (o$r * eps))
  fs <- sv_fd(o, sv_s + ds, sv_w, sv_s - ds, sv_w);                pt <- drop(o$A %*% ds)
  pP <- drop(solve(o$P, crossprod(o$D, sv_w * o$r * eps)))                 # control: P in place of J
  pn <- drop(o$A %*% eps)                                                  # control: dw without r
  c(dw_J = mg_rel(fw, pw), ds_J = mg_rel(fs, pt), dw_P = mg_rel(fw, pP), nor_over_dw = max(abs(pn)) / max(abs(fw)))
})
print(signif(sv_ra, 3))
stopifnot(sv_ra["dw_J", ] < 1e-6, sv_ra["ds_J", ] < 1e-6,                 # chosen after measuring (see text)
          sv_ra["dw_P", ] > 1e-3, sv_ra["nor_over_dw", ] > 10)
# The corollary: the dw channel scales with the misfit, the ds channel does not. s_lam = sigma(theta-hat) + lam r
# keeps theta-hat stationary (Delta'W r = 0), so J_lam = P - lam R exactly.
sv_rl <- sapply(sv_lev, function(o) {
  eps <- 1e-5 * sv_xi; ds <- 1e-6 * sv_xi; sg <- o$sig(o$th)
  d0w <- sv_fd(o, sg, sv_w * (1 + eps), sg, sv_w * (1 - eps))              # lam = 0: an exact fit stays exact
  d0s <- sv_fd(o, sg + ds, sv_w, sg - ds, sv_w)
  s2 <- sg + 2 * o$r; d2w <- sv_fd(o, s2, sv_w * (1 + eps), s2, sv_w * (1 - eps))
  p2w <- drop(solve(o$P - 2 * o$R, crossprod(o$D, sv_w * (2 * o$r) * eps)))
  c(lam0_dw = max(abs(d0w)), lam0_ds = mg_rel(d0s, drop(solve(o$P, crossprod(o$D, sv_w * ds)))),
    lam2_dw = mg_rel(d2w, p2w), lam2_over_lam1 = max(abs(d2w)) / max(abs(o$A %*% (o$r * eps))))
})
print(signif(sv_rl, 3))
stopifnot(sv_rl["lam0_dw", ] < 1e-14, sv_rl["lam0_ds", ] < 1e-6, sv_rl["lam2_dw", ] < 1e-6,
          abs(sv_rl["lam2_over_lam1", ] - 2) < 0.2)
```

```{r mg-sens-jp}
# (ii) J against P: the residual-curvature term's size, the contraction c, and 2J against a central difference
# of the exact gradient (the Hessian of F).
sv_jp <- sapply(sv_lev, function(o) {
  gF <- function(x) -2 * drop(crossprod(sv_jac(o$sig, x), sv_w * (sv_s - o$sig(x))))
  HF <- sapply(seq_along(o$th), function(j) { e <- replace(numeric(length(o$th)), j, 1e-5)
    (gF(o$th + e) - gF(o$th - e)) / 2e-5 }); HF <- (HF + t(HF)) / 2
  b  <- crossprod(o$D, sv_w * o$r * sv_xi)                                # a dw right-hand side
  dJ <- solve(o$J, b); dP <- solve(o$P, b); Pn <- function(v) sqrt(drop(crossprod(v, o$P %*% v)))
  c(c = o$c, R_over_P = norm(o$R, "2") / norm(o$P, "2"), HF_vs_2J = mg_rel(HF, 2 * o$J),
    HF_vs_2P = mg_rel(HF, 2 * o$P), JmP_over_bound = Pn(dJ - dP) / (o$c / (1 - o$c) * Pn(dP)),
    min_eig_J = min(eigen(o$J, only.values = TRUE)$values))
})
print(signif(sv_jp, 3))
stopifnot(sv_jp["c", ] < 1, sv_jp["min_eig_J", ] > 0, sv_jp["HF_vs_2J", ] < 1e-6,
          sv_jp["HF_vs_2P", ] > 1e-3, sv_jp["JmP_over_bound", ] <= 1)
```

```{r mg-sens-iter}
# (iii) The stopping iterate. Same GN iteration, from the same ULS start (which does not depend on w),
# production stopping rule; then +/- a known dw at the same iteration count K.
sv_it <- lapply(sv_lev, function(o) {
  eps <- 1e-5 * sv_xi; pw <- drop(o$A %*% (o$r * eps))
  b0 <- sv_gn(o$sig, sv_s, sv_w, o$x0); K <- b0$K
  own <- c(sv_gn(o$sig, sv_s, sv_w * (1 + eps), o$x0)$K, sv_gn(o$sig, sv_s, sv_w * (1 - eps), o$x0)$K)
  rows <- t(sapply((K - 2L):(K + 1L), function(k) {
    dk <- (sv_gn(o$sig, sv_s, sv_w * (1 + eps), o$x0, K = k)$x - sv_gn(o$sig, sv_s, sv_w * (1 - eps), o$x0, K = k)$x) / 2
    bk <- sv_gn(o$sig, sv_s, sv_w, o$x0, K = k)
    c(K = k, gap = max(abs(dk - pw)) / max(abs(pw)), dist_prev = max(abs(bk$xs[[k]] - o$th)),
      nu = bk$nus[k], env = max(sqrt(diag(solve(o$J, o$P) %*% solve(o$J)) * 2 * bk$nus[k])) / max(abs(pw)))
  }))
  list(K = K, own = own, halv = b0$halv, nus = b0$nus, rows = rows)
})
invisible(lapply(names(sv_it), function(lev) { z <- sv_it[[lev]]; rw <- z$rows
  cat(sprintf("%s: K = %d (perturbed runs stop at %s), halvings %d, nu by iteration %s\n", lev, z$K,
              paste(z$own, collapse = "/"), z$halv, paste(signif(z$nus, 2), collapse = " ")))
  print(signif(rw, 3))
  stopifnot(all(z$own == z$K), z$halv == 0L,
            all(rw[, "gap"] <= rw[, "env"]),                               # S4(b): the nu envelope holds, loosely
            all(rw[, "gap"] <= 10 * rw[, "dist_prev"]),                    # S4(c): gap = O(delta_{K-1}); 10 chosen after measuring
            all(diff(log(rw[, "gap"])) < 0))                               # each extra step shrinks the gap
}))
```

```{r mg-sens-c}
# (C) Additive perturbations inside the iteration, injected at a known size eta in place of rounding.
# (1) persistent: ghat + dg at every step converges to theta-hat + J^-1 dg (sign convention of S3);
# (2) one step only, at iteration j: contracted by the later steps; (3) random relative perturbations of
# ghat and P at every step, against the trajectory bound of S3.
sv_c <- sapply(sv_lev, function(o) {
  q <- length(o$th); dgv <- 1e-9 * cos(seq_len(q))
  per <- sv_gn(o$sig, sv_s, sv_w, o$th, halve = FALSE, K = 80, dg = function(j, gh, P) dgv)$x - o$th
  b0 <- sv_gn(o$sig, sv_s, sv_w, o$x0); K <- b0$K
  one <- sapply(1:K, function(jj) max(abs(sv_gn(o$sig, sv_s, sv_w, o$x0, K = K,
                 dg = function(j, gh, P) if (j == jj) dgv else 0)$x - b0$x)))
  eta <- 1e-10; set.seed(7)
  rnd <- replicate(5, max(abs((sv_gn(o$sig, sv_s, sv_w, o$x0, K = K,
           dg = function(j, gh, P) eta * runif(q, -1, 1) * abs(gh),
           dP = function(j, P) eta * matrix(runif(q * q, -1, 1), q) * abs(P))$x - b0$x) / (1 + abs(b0$x)))))
  stK <- b0$xs[[K + 1L]] - b0$xs[[K]]; Pi <- abs(solve(o$P))
  bnd <- max(K * drop(Pi %*% (eta * abs(o$P) %*% abs(stK)) + Pi %*% (eta * abs(o$P) %*% abs(stK))) / (1 + abs(b0$x)))
  # S3 at the true rounding size: u = 2^-53, u_q = 2^-104 (conservative for double-double), D terms per entry
  uu <- 2^-53; Dn <- length(sv_s); gq <- Dn * 2^-104 / (1 - Dn * 2^-104)
  f  <- 2 * gq * colSums(abs(sv_w * o$r * o$D)); dPb <- 2 * uu * abs(o$P) + 2 * gq * crossprod(abs(o$D), sv_w * abs(o$D))
  scu <- max((K * drop(Pi %*% ((2 * uu * abs(o$P) + dPb) %*% abs(stK))) + drop(Pi %*% f) / (1 - o$c)) / (1 + abs(b0$x)))
  c(persist = mg_rel(per, drop(solve(o$J, dgv))), persist_P = mg_rel(per, drop(solve(o$P, dgv))),
    one_first_over_last = one[1] / one[K], rand_max = max(rnd), bound = bnd, rand_over_bound = max(rnd) / bnd,
    S_C_at_u = scu)
})
print(signif(sv_c, 3))
stopifnot(sv_c["persist", ] < 1e-6, sv_c["persist_P", ] > 1e-3,
          sv_c["one_first_over_last", ] < 1, sv_c["rand_over_bound", ] <= 1, sv_c["S_C_at_u", ] < 1e-17)
```

```{r mg-sens-sum}
# (iv) The summation bound behind delta-g, on a constructed sum whose exact value is known: x = (a, -a, v),
# shuffled, exact sum v. Plain double recursive summation (Reduce, not sum(), which accumulates in long double)
# moves with the order, within gamma_{n-1} sum|x|; double-double accumulation then one rounding returns v
# in every order: the model for quadcross() (one probe, see text), whose order is the processor count's.
sv_two <- function(a, b) { s <- a + b; bb <- s - a; c(s, (a - (s - bb)) + (b - bb)) }
sv_dd  <- function(x) { hi <- 0; lo <- 0
  for (xk in x) { t <- sv_two(hi, xk); lo <- lo + t[2]; u <- t[1] + lo; lo <- lo - (u - t[1]); hi <- u }
  hi + lo }
sv_sm <- local({
  set.seed(42); n <- 42L; a <- runif(n / 2 - 1, -1, 1) * 10^runif(n / 2 - 1, -3, 3); v <- 1.2345e-9
  x <- c(a, -a, v, 0); u <- .Machine$double.eps / 2; gam <- function(k) k * u / (1 - k * u)
  perm <- replicate(200, { y <- sample(x); c(plain = Reduce(`+`, y), dd = sv_dd(y)) })
  c(plain_spread = diff(range(perm["plain", ])), plain_maxerr = max(abs(perm["plain", ] - v)),
    plain_bound = gam(n - 1) * sum(abs(x)), dd_maxerr_ulps = max(abs(perm["dd", ] - v)) / (u * abs(v)))
})
print(signif(sv_sm, 3))
stopifnot(sv_sm[["plain_spread"]] > 0, sv_sm[["plain_maxerr"]] <= sv_sm[["plain_bound"]],
          sv_sm[["dd_maxerr_ulps"]] <= 1)
```

```{r mg-sens-d}
# (D) Production's Delta: the correlation rows of the lambda and psi (phi) columns are central differences
# of V at h = 1e-5 max(1, |v|), scaled by omega_j omega_k after differencing (dwlsmv_mg_dcols); every other
# entry is closed form (here: complex step). A model of production's arithmetic in R, not Stata's.
sv_cdjac <- function(lev) {
  nm <- sv_lev[[lev]]$nm; nT <- sum(nm == "tau"); off <- function(M) M[lower.tri(M)]
  r1 <- nT + seq_len(10); r2 <- 21L + nT + seq_len(10)                   # correlation rows, groups 1 and 2
  V1 <- function(x) off(tcrossprod(x[nm == "lam"]))
  V2 <- function(x) off(tcrossprod(x[nm == "lam"])) * x[nm == "phi"]
  function(sig, x) {
    D <- sv_jac(sig, x); oo <- off(tcrossprod(x[nm == "om"]))
    for (j in which(nm %in% c("lam", "phi"))) {
      h <- 1e-5 * max(1, abs(x[j])); xp <- replace(x, j, x[j] + h); xm <- replace(x, j, x[j] - h)
      D[r1, j] <- (V1(xp) - V1(xm)) / (2 * h); D[r2, j] <- (V2(xp) - V2(xm)) / (2 * h) * oo
    }
    D
  }
}
sv_gnj <- function(sig, s, w, x, jac, maxit = 200) {                     # sv_gn's rule, any Jacobian
  Ff <- function(x) sum(w * (s - sig(x))^2); f <- Ff(x)
  for (j in seq_len(maxit)) {
    D <- jac(sig, x); st <- solve(crossprod(D, w * D), crossprod(D, w * (s - sig(x)))); a <- 1
    xn <- x + drop(st); fn <- Ff(xn)
    while (fn > f && a > 2^-30) { a <- a / 2; xn <- x + a * drop(st); fn <- Ff(xn) }
    xo <- x; fo <- f; x <- xn; f <- fn
    Dn <- jac(sig, x); gn <- drop(crossprod(Dn, w * (s - sig(x)))); nu <- 2 * sum(gn * solve(crossprod(Dn, w * Dn), gn))
    if (nu < 1e-12 && (max(abs(x - xo) / (abs(xo) + 1)) < 1e-10 || abs(f - fo) / (abs(fo) + 1) < 1e-12)) break
  }
  list(x = x, K = j)
}
sv_d <- lapply(sv_lev, function(o) {
  lev <- if (any(o$nm == "nu")) "loadings" else "intercepts"; cdj <- sv_cdjac(lev); th <- o$th
  u <- 2^-53; hj <- 1e-5 * pmax(1, abs(th)); cd <- o$nm %in% c("lam", "phi")
  E <- cdj(o$sig, th) - o$D                                                # derivative-computation error at theta-hat
  cdrow <- rowSums(abs(E)) > 0
  sc <- (outer(abs(o$sig(th)), rep(1, length(th))) + abs(o$D) * rep(abs(th) + hj, each = nrow(E))) / rep(hj, each = nrow(E))
  epsV <- max((abs(E) / sc)[cdrow, cd]) / u                               # E in units of S5's scale
  Eb <- 2 * u * sc * outer(cdrow, cd)                                     # S5's bound, eps_V = 2u (after measuring)
  phi <- drop(abs(solve(o$P)) %*% crossprod(Eb, sv_w * abs(o$r)))
  env <- 2 * phi / ((1 - o$c) * (1 + abs(th)))                            # S5(c): the envelope of a residue
  pol <- function(frozen) { a <- th; D0 <- cdj(o$sig, a); st <- numeric()
    for (k in 1:8) { D <- if (frozen) D0 else cdj(o$sig, a)
      s_ <- drop(solve(crossprod(D, sv_w * D), crossprod(D, sv_w * (sv_s - o$sig(a))))); a <- a + s_; st <- c(st, max(abs(s_))) }
    st }
  b0x <- sv_gnj(o$sig, sv_s, sv_w, o$x0, sv_jac); b0c <- sv_gnj(o$sig, sv_s, sv_w, o$x0, cdj)
  same <- identical(b0c$x, sv_gnj(o$sig, sv_s, sv_w, o$x0, cdj)$x)        # deterministic e: no residue alone
  trig <- t(sapply(1:20, function(m) { set.seed(100 + m); w2 <- sv_w * (1 + sample(c(-1, 1), length(sv_w), TRUE) * u)
    rx <- sv_gnj(o$sig, sv_s, w2, o$x0, sv_jac); rc <- sv_gnj(o$sig, sv_s, w2, o$x0, cdj)
    c(exact = max(abs(rx$x - b0x$x) / (1 + abs(th))), cd = max(abs(rc$x - b0c$x) / (1 + abs(th))),
      lin = max(abs(o$A %*% (o$r * (w2 / sv_w - 1))) / (1 + abs(th))), over_env = max(abs(rc$x - b0c$x) / (1 + abs(th)) / env),
      sameK = rx$K == b0x$K && rc$K == b0c$K) }))
  list(epsV = epsV, e = max(abs(crossprod(E, sv_w * o$r))), pol_re = pol(FALSE)[-1], pol_fr = pol(TRUE)[-1],
       env = max(env), same = same, trig = trig)
})
sv_dt <- sapply(sv_d, function(z) c(eps_V_over_u = z$epsV, max_e = z$e, floor_reeval = min(z$pol_re),
  floor_frozen = max(z$pol_fr), envelope = z$env, exact_max = max(z$trig[, "exact"]), cd_max = max(z$trig[, "cd"]),
  cd_median = median(z$trig[, "cd"]), linear_max = max(z$trig[, "lin"]), cd_over_env = max(z$trig[, "over_env"])))
print(signif(sv_dt, 3))
for (z in sv_d) stopifnot(z$same, all(z$trig[, "sameK"] == 1), z$epsV <= 2,
  min(z$pol_re) > 100 * max(z$pol_fr),                                    # the floor exists only with re-evaluated Delta
  max(z$trig[, "exact"]) < 1e-15,                                          # exact Delta: an ulp trigger stays at rounding
  max(z$trig[, "cd"]) > 100 * max(z$trig[, "exact"]),                      # production-like Delta: it couples to the floor
  max(z$trig[, "over_env"]) <= 1)                                          # inside S5(c)'s envelope
```

#### The error budget's form (thresholds open)

A later test compares, per element and per pair of grid cells, a measured residue $m_i$ (check 6's
measure) with a prediction $p_i$:
- along the $a$-axis, S1's, from that axis's measured $ds$ and $\varepsilon$;
- along the $b$-axis, S3's bound.

Between $p_i$ and $m_i$ sit the following terms. Their sizes on design E (above) illustrate the form;
they are not the confirmatory fits' sizes.

| Term | Form | Size on design E |
|---|---|---|
| Linearization of S1 | relative $O(L\,\|dp\|)$ | negligible at ulp-scale $dp$; the central differences at $\eta=10^{-5}$ agree to $\le7\times10^{-10}$ |
| Iterate gap, same $K$ and halving (S4(c)) | relative $O(KL\delta_{K-1})$, $\delta_{K-1}\approx\sqrt{\nu_K/2}/c$ | $2\times10^{-6}$, $7\times10^{-6}$ |
| Discrete stopping, when $K$ or halving differs (S4(b)) | absolute $\le\sqrt{2\nu(J^{-1}PJ^{-1})_{ii}}$, zeroth order | up to the size of the response; recorded per cell, attributed outside both $S$ |
| $J$'s evaluation (the routine's $R$ by finite differences of $\Delta'(w\circ r)$, step $h$) | relative on $R$: $O(h^2)+O(u/h)$; on $d\hat\theta$: $c$ times that | depends on $h$; the routine states its $h$ |
| $P$ for $J$, if ever substituted | relative $\le c/(1-c)$ | 0.03–0.04 (the prediction uses $J$) |
| The prediction's own floating point | relative $O(u\,\kappa(J))$ | — |
| Resolution of $m_i$ | one ulp of $\hat\theta_i$, $\le 2u\|\hat\theta_i\|/(1+\|\hat\theta_i\|)<2.3\times10^{-16}$ | a rank or ratio test needs $m_i$ well above it |
| (C), from the reductions (S3(4)) | the bound above | $\le4\times10^{-19}$ |
| (D) through a trigger (S5(c)) | absolute $\le2\varphi_i/(1-c)$, zeroth order in the trigger; zero if the trigger does not reach the iterates | residues up to 0.021 of the envelope ($\le1.4\times10^{-12}$); the envelope $\le8.4\times10^{-11}$ |
| $J$'s evaluation, given (D) | the routine's $R$ is a central difference of the noisy $\Delta_c'(w\circ r)$: an extra $O(\|e\|/h_R)$ on $R$ | with $h_R\approx6\times10^{-6}$, estimated (not measured) at $\approx2.5\times10^{-8}$ absolute on $R$ |
| Unmodelled | the arithmetic of `dwls_model()` and of `dwls_delta()`'s closed-form part; `optimize()` internals | measured on the $b$-axis |

**Open, for the preregistration** (none chosen here):
- the numerical pass thresholds for the ranking test and for the magnitude test;
- how elements whose predictions differ by less than the budget are ranked (ties);
- which elements enter (all of $\theta$, or those whose $m_i$ clears the resolution);
- which pairs of processor counts enter;
- the confirmatory fits. E, B and D are consistency-only, since they are the data the hypothesis came
  from, so the confirmatory fits must be ones whose residue has not been measured.

#### Post-convergence polish: a path-independent stopping point {#sec-polish}

*Added 2026-10-23 with the polish's adoption (spec Module 7; E-014). The chunk below was
executed in R 4.5.2 the same day.*

**Why.** The mechanism diagnostic (E-015; descriptive, after the result) found that
`optimize()`'s `"nr"`, after a good Newton step, tries longer steps while F does not increase. Near
$\hat\theta$ that comparison can be an ulp-level tie. On one unit it went one way at one processor
count and the other way at another, and the two fits stopped $3.9\times10^{-8}$ apart at the same
solution. The polish takes pure Gauss–Newton steps from the converged point, with no extension, no
halving and no F comparison.

**Result PO1.** With $P$, $R$, $J=P-R$ and $\hat g=\Delta'Wr$ as in @sec-mg-sensitivity, the polish map is
$T(\theta)=\theta+P(\theta)^{-1}\hat g(\theta)$.
- Since $\hat g(\hat\theta)=0$ and $\partial\hat g/\partial\theta'=-J$,
  $$\left.\frac{\partial T}{\partial\theta'}\right|_{\hat\theta}=I-P^{-1}J=P^{-1}R .$$
- $\hat\theta$ is a fixed point of $T$, and $T$ contracts near it exactly when $c=\rho(P^{-1}R)<1$,
  which is `dwlsmv_sens`'s own condition.
- Two stopping points $\theta_A$ and $\theta_B=\theta_A+\delta$ near $\hat\theta$ therefore map to
  $T^k(\theta_B)-T^k(\theta_A)=(P^{-1}R)^k\delta+O(\lvert\delta\rvert\,\lvert\theta_A-\hat\theta\rvert+\lvert\delta\rvert^2)$.
- The limit depends only on $(s,w)$, not on the path. The path enters only through $\delta$, which is
  multiplied by $c^k$.
- At $R=0$ (a perfect fit) the rate is quadratic; the misfit is what makes it linear.

**Corollary (the floor).** In floating point the gap falls as $c^k\delta$ until it meets the evaluation
noise of $T$. That floor is **measured, not derived**: polish P0 on pilot files found $1.7\times10^{-14}$
to $3.7\times10^{-13}$ in check 6's units (E-014). Production's thresholds
($10^{-11}$, cap 20) were **chosen after measuring** from that floor.

**What this section does not do.**
- It chooses no tolerance for check 6.
- Production's own cross-count behaviour was validated separately, in Stata
  (E-014). Under the tested conditions the polish removed the targeted
  $3.9\times10^{-8}$ discrepancy, to $5.2\times10^{-12}$. It did not lower cross-count variation in
  general.
- It does not bound the floor across processor counts. Under StataMP 18 at counts 1–6
  (E-014, 2026-10-28; FAIL-S1), from bitwise-identical starts, polished
  fits differed by up to $1.7\times10^{-12}$, and one unit reached $1.4\times10^{-11}$. The gaps exceed
  P0's step floor (a single-count measure, so not directly comparable). Corrected 2026-11-02: this was
  first read as the evaluation noise of $T$ itself depending on the count. On fixed bit-exact inputs the
  polish's operations were bitwise identical across counts while Stage 1's $w$ moved
  (polish-step-probe-s18: 4 units, one trajectory, movement below its floors not excluded), and
  s18-p6-diag accepts that the count reaches $\hat\theta$ only through $w$, for the 4-against-6 pair on
  its cases. The route at other pairs is not established. **Descriptive, after the result**; nothing
  here is derived.
- PO1 holds in exact arithmetic. At machine level, continuing past the stop did not contract to rounding
  on any of 456 units (E-014), so "path-independent" in this
  section's title describes the exact-arithmetic limit, not a machine-level guarantee.

```{r polish-contraction}
# The polish's contraction (Result PO1), on a self-contained one-factor correlation structure
# (p = 8, D = 28, sigma_ij = lambda_i lambda_j, unequal weights): two converged points that differ by a
# forward step of relative length 1.28e-7 (d-mech's), with w moved by +/- 1 ulp, under pure GN steps.
po_sig <- function(l, pr) l[pr[, 1]] * l[pr[, 2]]
po_jac <- function(l, pr, p) { J <- matrix(0, nrow(pr), p)
  J[cbind(seq_len(nrow(pr)), pr[, 1])] <- l[pr[, 2]]; J[cbind(seq_len(nrow(pr)), pr[, 2])] <- l[pr[, 1]]; J }
po_step <- function(l, s, w, pr, p) { J <- po_jac(l, pr, p); r <- s - po_sig(l, pr)
  solve(crossprod(J, w * J), crossprod(J, w * r))[, 1] }
po_c <- function(l, s, w, pr, p) { J <- po_jac(l, pr, p); r <- s - po_sig(l, pr); R <- matrix(0, p, p)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(pr))) { a <- pr[i, 1]; b <- pr[i, 2]
    R[a, b] <- R[a, b] - w[i] * r[i]; R[b, a] <- R[b, a] - w[i] * r[i] }
  max(Mod(eigen(solve(crossprod(J, w * J), R))$values)) }
po_rel <- function(x, y) max(abs(x - y) / (1 + abs(y)))
# the RNG state is restored afterwards, so later chunks are unaffected
po_seed <- if (exists(".Random.seed", envir = globalenv())) get(".Random.seed", envir = globalenv()) else NULL
local({
set.seed(20261022)
po_p <- 8; po_pr <- t(combn(po_p, 2))
po_out <- NULL
for (sd in c(0.01, 0.05, 0.12)) {
  l0 <- runif(po_p, 0.45, 0.85); s <- po_sig(l0, po_pr) + rnorm(nrow(po_pr), 0, sd)
  w <- 1 / runif(nrow(po_pr), 0.5, 2)
  l <- rep(0.6, po_p); last <- NULL
  for (k in 1:200) { d <- po_step(l, s, w, po_pr, po_p); if (po_rel(l + d, l) < 1e-10) break; l <- l + d; last <- d }
  cc <- po_c(l, s, w, po_pr, po_p)
  a <- l; b <- l + 1.28e-7 * last / sqrt(sum(last^2))
  wb <- w * (1 + 2^-52 * sample(c(-1, 1), length(w), TRUE))
  gap <- po_rel(b, a); ratios <- NULL
  for (k in 1:25) {
    a <- a + po_step(a, s, w, po_pr, po_p); b <- b + po_step(b, s, wb, po_pr, po_p)
    g2 <- po_rel(b, a); if (gap > 1e-13) ratios <- c(ratios, g2 / gap); gap <- g2 }
  po_out <- rbind(po_out, data.frame(misfit = sd, c = cc, ratio_min = min(ratios), ratio_max = max(ratios), final = gap))
}
print(po_out, digits = 3)
# Tolerances chosen after measuring (polish_check.log): ratio within 25% of c while the gap is above 1e-13;
# final gap at or below 1e-14.
stopifnot(all(abs(po_out$ratio_min / po_out$c - 1) < 0.25), all(abs(po_out$ratio_max / po_out$c - 1) < 0.25),
          all(po_out$final <= 1e-14))
})
if (is.null(po_seed)) rm(".Random.seed", envir = globalenv()) else assign(".Random.seed", po_seed, envir = globalenv())
```

#### The `e(T3)` side: a per-fit bound on $T_3$'s processor-count residue {#sec-mg-sensitivity-t3}

*Added 2026-10-15 by the main session, from the approved plan E-039, and
executed the same day: R 4.6.0, with lavaan 0.7.2 for Stage 1 and two reference statistics. No Stata
run, and no $T_3$ residue measured: those belong to the later, preregistered step.*

**Why.** Check 6 (`dwlsmv_dtrefit`) compares `e(b)` and `e(T3)`, never `e(V)`. S1–S5 bound the
`e(b)` side, and the grid tested that bound. `e(T3)` had fixture observations only (c6-g2: at most
$1.4\times10^{-13}$).

This subsection derives a bound $B_{T3}$ on $|T_{3,a}-T_{3,b}|/(1+|T_{3,b}|)$ for two processor counts
$a$ and $b$. The bound is computable from one fit's own quantities and measured inputs. It chooses no
tolerance, slack or threshold; those are listed at the end, for the preregistration. New names start
with `t3_`. Results are numbered TS1–TS7, to keep them apart from the statistic $T_3$.

##### Result TS1: the quantity, as implemented

From `dwls_inference`, `dwlsmv_traces`, `dwlsmv_scaleshift`, `dwls_fit`, `dwls_delta`,
`dwlsmv_mg_dcols`, `dwlsmv_delta_cols` and `dwls_gamma` with its Ψ routines (read 2026-10-15):

$$
T_3=\mathcal T(s,\hat\theta,\Delta_c,\Omega)=d+a\,(T-t_1),\qquad a=\sqrt{d/t_2},\qquad d=D_\bullet-q>0 .
$$

- $T=n_TF$ with $n_T=N-G$, and $F=r'Wr$, $r=s-\sigma(\hat\theta)$. $F$ is re-evaluated at the returned
  $\hat\theta$ by `dwlsmv_fdwls`.
- $t_1=\operatorname{Tr}(U\Omega)$ and $t_2=\operatorname{Tr}((U\Omega)^2)$, with
  $U=W-W\Delta P^{-1}\Delta'W$ and $P=\Delta'W\Delta$ (S1's $P$, the code's bread). They are computed by
  MG4's expansion, and $U$ is never formed.
- $\Omega=\operatorname{blockdiag}(\Gamma_g/\pi_g)$, $\pi_g=N_g/N$, and $W=\operatorname{diag}(1/\operatorname{diag}\Omega)$,
  in $F$ and in the traces alike (weighting (a)). **$W$ is not an input of its own.**
- $\Delta_c=\Delta(\hat\theta)+E$. $E$ is nonzero only on group $g$'s correlation rows, in the $\lambda$,
  $\beta$ and $\psi$ columns that group $g$'s table carries; S5 bounds it there. Ties sum group
  columns, exactly.
- At $d=0$, $T_3=T$ and only $T$'s parts below apply.

**Where the plan and the code disagree (the code wins):**
1. **`quadcross()` and the processor count.** Plan §§2–3 say `quadcross()` does not move with the
   processor count. `dwls_gamma.mata`'s header records that it does, by about one ulp, measured on
   bitwise-identical input (E-040 2026-09-19, and *`quadcross()` drift figure*). So a
   diag-$\hat\Gamma$ difference needs no difference in Ψ.
   - **Where Ψ could move, by inspection.** Ψ is a gather of per-cell table values. The tables are
     built from elementwise operations, from Mata `sum()` over each pair's $K_1\times K_2$ cells
     (`dwlsmv_pairinfo`), and from small products $\psi_a I_{\rho a}$ (`dwlsmv_psi_rho_table`).
     Whether `sum()` or `*` on these small arrays moves with the count is not established.
   - **Prior information.** The pair fits' root finder uses the same kind of sums, and $s$ was bitwise
     identical across counts on the grid. That is consistent with an invariant Ψ; it does not prove it.
   - **Either way, off-diagonal $\Omega$ can move:** `quadcross(Psi, Psi)` forms every entry. The bound
     therefore takes a measured $d\Omega$.
2. **Not every product is a `quadcross()`** (plan §2). The bread is inverted by `cholinv()`, and each
   trace is `sum(diagonal(...))` in double. Both enter TS6.
3. **Two roundings of one $w$.** The fit's weight is $(N_g/N)\cdot(1/\gamma_{g,kk})$; the traces' is
   $1/(\gamma_{g,kk}/\pi_g)$. They are two roundings of one quantity, so there is one input, and TS6
   carries the rounding.
4. **Posting, not in the plan.** `e(T3)` reaches `e()` through `strofreal(T3, "%21.0g")`. That reads back
   exactly for $|x|\ge10^{-2}$ (measured 2026-10-07; spec D11), so the posting term is 0 when
   $|T_3|\ge10^{-2}$. Below that it is not derived here; the chunks assert $|T_3|\ge10^{-2}$.
5. **As the plan says:** $T_{\rm raw}=(N-G)F$. The threshold rows and the $\tau,\nu,\omega,\alpha$ columns
   are closed form. The correlation rows of $\lambda,\beta,\psi$ are central differences at
   $h_j=10^{-5}\max(1,|v_j|)$, scaled by $\omega_j\omega_k$ after differencing.

##### Result TS2: an exact decomposition, and the uniformity condition

Let count $c$ produce $\theta_c$, $\Delta_c=\Delta(\theta_c)+E_c$ and $(s_c,\Omega_c)$. Telescoping one input
at a time:

$$
\begin{aligned}
T_{3,a}-T_{3,b}={}&\big[\mathcal T(s_a,\theta_a,\Delta(\theta_a)+E_a,\Omega_a)-\mathcal T(s_a,\theta_a,\Delta(\theta_a),\Omega_a)\big] &&\text{(1a) }E_a\\
&+\big[\mathcal T(s_a,\theta_a,\Delta(\theta_a),\Omega_a)-\mathcal T(s_a,\theta_b,\Delta(\theta_b),\Omega_a)\big] &&\text{(2) }\hat\theta\text{, through }F\text{ and }\Delta(\theta)\\
&+\big[\mathcal T(s_a,\theta_b,\Delta(\theta_b),\Omega_a)-\mathcal T(s_b,\theta_b,\Delta(\theta_b),\Omega_b)\big] &&\text{(3) Stage 1: }s,\ \Omega\text{ with }W=W(\Omega)\\
&+\big[\mathcal T(s_b,\theta_b,\Delta(\theta_b),\Omega_b)-\mathcal T(s_b,\theta_b,\Delta(\theta_b)+E_b,\Omega_b)\big] &&\text{(1b) }E_b
\end{aligned}
$$

This is the plan's three-term form with $\Delta_c$ split into $\Delta(\theta_c)$ and its own noise. The noise
then appears once per run.

**The interaction rule.** The total is at most the sum of the term bounds, for any ordering and with no
independence assumption, **provided each term's bound holds uniformly over the points the term visits**:
- (1a) and (1b): at $(\theta_c,\Omega_c)$ for either count, so for every $\theta$ in the $\theta$ envelope
  and every $\Omega$ within $d\Omega$;
- (2): along $\theta_b\to\theta_a$ at $\Omega_a$, though its gradient is taken at $(\theta_b,\Omega_b)$;
- (3): along $(s_b,\Omega_b)\to(s_a,\Omega_a)$ at $\theta_b$.

TS3–TS5 bound each term to first order at the stored fit $b$, and state the remainder. Uniformity then
means this: the relative change of each gradient over the envelope, plus the remainders, stays within a
slack $\rho_T$. `mg-t3-routes` measures it.

##### Result TS3: route 1, Δ's evaluation noise in the traces

$T$ does not involve $\Delta$, so $d\mathcal T=-a\,(dt_1+\kappa\,dt_2)$ with $\kappa=(T-t_1)/(2t_2)$.
Write $K_1=\Delta'W\Omega W\Delta$ (the code's `B`), so that $t_1=w'\operatorname{diag}\Omega-\operatorname{Tr}(P^{-1}K_1)$.
Differentiating $P^{-1}$ and $K_1$, and then $t_2=\operatorname{Tr}(U\Omega U\Omega)$ through
$dU=-(W\,d\Delta\,P^{-1}\Delta'W+\text{its transpose})+W\Delta P^{-1}dP\,P^{-1}\Delta'W$, gives

$$
dt_1=\langle G_1,d\Delta\rangle,\quad G_1=-2\,U\Omega W\Delta P^{-1};\qquad
dt_2=\langle G_2,d\Delta\rangle,\quad G_2=-4\,U\Omega U\Omega W\Delta P^{-1}.
$$

So $G_\Delta=-a(G_1+\kappa G_2)$. With $\bar E$ S5's elementwise bound on $|E|$,

$$
\beta_1=\langle|G_\Delta|,\bar E\rangle,\qquad |(1a)|+|(1b)|\le2\beta_1\ \text{(first order, uniformly)} .
$$

**The plan's hypothesis (§4.2) holds.** Let $Q=W^{1/2}\Delta$, $H=Q(Q'Q)^{-1}Q'$ and
$\tilde\Omega=W^{1/2}\Omega W^{1/2}$, whose diagonal is 1. Then
$G_1=-2W^{1/2}(I-H)\tilde\Omega\,Q(Q'Q)^{-1}$, and so

$$
|dt_1|\le\frac{2\,\|(I-H)\tilde\Omega\|_F\,\|W^{1/2}d\Delta\|_F}{\sigma_{\min}(Q)},\qquad
|dt_2|\le\frac{4\,\|(I-H)\tilde\Omega(I-H)\tilde\Omega\|_F\,\|W^{1/2}d\Delta\|_F}{\sigma_{\min}(Q)} .
$$

That is one power of $\sigma_{\min}$, against two ($P^{-1}$) in $\hat\theta$'s amplification. On design E,
$\sigma_{\min}(Q)=0.13$, and the normwise bound is loose by more than 100, so $B_{T3}$ uses $\beta_1$.

**Zeroth order in the trigger, as in S5(c).**
- If $\theta_a=\theta_b$ bitwise and Δ's arithmetic does not move, then $E_a=E_b$, and (1a)+(1b) is of
  second order ($E\times d\Omega$).
- Once the iterates differ at all, $E_a$ and $E_b$ are two draws, and $2\beta_1$ is the envelope.

##### Result TS4: route 2, $\hat\theta$'s shift

With the exact $\Delta(\theta)$, $\hat g=\Delta'Wr$ and $v_l=\langle G_\Delta,\partial\Delta/\partial\theta_l\rangle$:
- $d\mathcal T/d\theta_l=-2an_T\hat g_l+v_l$;
- $F(\theta+\delta)-F(\theta)=-2\hat g'\delta+\delta'J\delta+O(\delta^3)$.

So, for $|\theta_a-\theta_b|\le\Theta$ elementwise,

$$
\beta_2=\sum_l\big(2an_T\,\bar g_l+|v_l|\big)\,\Theta_l+a\,n_T\,\Theta'|J|\,\Theta,\qquad
\bar g=|\hat g_c|+\bar E'W|r|+|\Delta|'W|r|\,\|\varepsilon\|_\infty .
$$

- **$F$.** At an exact minimum $\hat g=0$, and $F$ moves at second order only, $a\,n_T\,\delta'J\delta$. The
  stored iterate has $\hat g\ne0$. $\bar g$ bounds the exact $\hat g$ by three pieces:
  - the computed $\hat g_c=\Delta_c'Wr$;
  - S5's $e=E'Wr$;
  - $W$'s move between $\Omega_b$ and $\Omega_a$ (term (2) sits at $\Omega_a$; $\varepsilon$ is the relative
    weight change).
- **The traces.** Here $\Delta$ is at most linear in any single parameter (the structure of Lemma
  MS2.1), so central differences of $\Delta$ in $\theta_l$ give $\partial\Delta/\partial\theta_l$ with no
  truncation error. From production's $\Delta_c$ they carry $O(\bar E/h)$ noise: about $10^{-7}$ relative
  at $h=10^{-4}$, which falls inside $\rho_T$.
- **$\Theta$ is S1–S5's envelope, in absolute units:**
  $\Theta=|A(ds+r\circ\varepsilon)|+(1+|\hat\theta|)S^{(C)}+2\varphi/(1-c)$. This is the grid's
  $B_i$ without its $\rho$ and its resolution term. It holds at equal $K$ and line search (S4(c)). For a
  displaced pair only S4(b)'s $\nu$-envelope is available; that choice is left to the preregistration.
  S1–S5 are reused here, not re-derived.

##### Result TS5: route 3, the Stage 1 inputs, with $W=W(\Omega)$

Let $\Pi=\Delta P^{-1}\Delta'W$, an oblique projector. Then $dU=(I-\Pi)'\,dW\,(I-\Pi)$. At fixed
$\theta$, with $dw_k=-w_k^2\,d\Omega_{kk}$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
dt_1&=\operatorname{Tr}(U\,d\Omega)+\textstyle\sum_k dw_k\,[(I-\Pi)\Omega(I-\Pi)']_{kk},\\
dt_2&=2\operatorname{Tr}(U\Omega U\,d\Omega)+2\textstyle\sum_k dw_k\,[(I-\Pi)\Omega U\Omega(I-\Pi)']_{kk},\\
dT&=n_T\big(\textstyle\sum_k dw_k\,r_k^2+2r'W\,ds\big).
\end{aligned}
$$

Collecting these, $d\mathcal T=\langle G_\Omega,d\Omega\rangle+g_s'ds$, with $g_s=2an_TWr$, and

$$
\beta_3=\langle|G_\Omega|,|d\Omega|\rangle+|g_s|'|ds| .
$$

- **Off-diagonals enter at first order**, through $U$ and $U\Omega U$. Nothing reduces them to the
  diagonal.
- **Scale invariance.** $d\Omega=\epsilon\,\Omega$ leaves $t_1$ and $t_2$ unchanged, because $U\Pi=0$.
  Dropping the $dW$ terms breaks this: that is the control "$W$ as a separate input".
- **$F$ through $W$ is first order:** $n_T\sum_kdw_kr_k^2=n_T\,r'dW\,r$, as plan §4.4 says.
- **One $d\Gamma$, counted once.** The same measured $d\Omega$ gives $\varepsilon$ for $\Theta$'s
  $S^{(A)}$ (term (2)) and $d\Omega$ for $\beta_3$ (term (3)). These are different telescoped terms, so
  nothing is counted twice.

##### Result TS6: $T_3$'s own evaluation

Two runs round differently when their reduction orders differ, and also when their inputs differ. Two
terms carry this, both to first order.

**$\beta_{\rm eval}$: reduction order and the inverse.** It sums $\langle|\partial T_3/\partial X|,\delta X\rangle$
over the intermediates $X$ of `dwlsmv_traces` ($P$, $P^{-1}$, $\Omega W\Delta$, `B`, `C`,
$P^{-1}$`B`), where $\partial T_3/\partial X$ is the total derivative with everything downstream exact.
The scalar roundings are added.
- **Per `quadcross()` output:** $\delta X=2u\sum|\text{terms}|$. This covers S3's double-double model
  ($2u|x|$ plus a $\gamma^q$ term). It also covers a per-thread chunk model consistent with the recorded
  one-ulp movement. The mechanism is not established.
  **Superseded in production (user, 2026-10-20):** `dwlsmv_sens_t3` now uses SE6's Q4 form,
  $\delta X=2\gamma_{n-1}\sum|\text{terms}|$, after the exact-reference reading refuted Q1 per run
  (E-030). The Q1 form stays here, and in TS7 and the chunks before SE6,
  as the record of what was run.
- **`cholinv()`:** a backward error $|\delta P_{ij}|\le c_{\rm ch}\,u\sqrt{P_{ii}P_{jj}}$, with
  $c_{\rm ch}=6(q+1)$. **This is an assumed algorithm constant, not established for Mata's `cholinv()`**,
  like S3(3)'s constant for `optimize()`.
- **`sum(diagonal())`:** $2\gamma_q\sum|\cdot|$.

A first form, which composed absolute values stage by stage, was valid but $10^3$ to $10^5$ times looser
(verification, below). The gradient form is the one $B_{T3}$ uses.

**$\beta_{\rm elem}$: elementwise roundings, redrawn when the inputs differ.**

$$
\beta_{\rm elem}=\langle|G_\Delta|,4u|\Delta|\rangle+\textstyle\sum_k|\partial T_3/\partial w_k|\,2u\,w_k+\sum_k|g_{s,k}|\,2\epsilon_5|\sigma_k| .
$$

The three parts are:
- the closed-form $\Delta$ entries and $W\circ\Delta$;
- $w=1/\operatorname{diag}\Omega$;
- $\sigma(\hat\theta)$ inside $r$, with $\epsilon_5=2u$, S5's value for the model's evaluation error.

Each is counted for both runs. This term was added after the fifth run, from re-reading the derivation
and not from a failed check.

##### Result TS7: check 6's measure, and $B_{T3}$

$$
B_{T3}=\frac{(1+\rho_T)\,(2\beta_1+\beta_2+\beta_3)+\beta_{\rm eval}+\beta_{\rm elem}}{1+|T_3|}+\frac{2u|T_3|}{1+|T_3|},
$$

with every term at the stored fit $b$, for $|T_3|\ge10^{-2}$. Its inputs:
- **the fit's own:** $\Delta_c$; $\Omega$ (each group's $\Gamma_g$ and $N_g$); $W$; $r$; $\hat\theta$;
  $\hat g_c$; $J$ ($P$, and S2's $R$); $A$; $c$; $K$ and the last step (S3); and
  $\partial\Delta/\partial\theta$, from differences of $\Delta_c$;
- **measured:** $d\Omega$ including its off-diagonals (and $\varepsilon$ from its diagonal); $ds$; and S5's
  model-evaluation error for $\bar E$ (the grid measured at most $1.005u$);
- **assumed:** $u_q\le2^{-104}$ (S3), and the `quadcross()` model and $c_{\rm ch}$ (TS6);
- **slack:** $\rho_T$, which covers the remainders and the uniformity condition. Here they are at most
  $3.2\times10^{-6}$ of a gradient. The chunks use $\rho_T=0.01$ as a working value (the grid's $\rho$);
  the preregistration sets it.

**On design E** (R's model of production's arithmetic, not Stata's, and not the fixtures):

| | metric | scalar | $G=1$ |
|---|---|---|---|
| $B_{T3}$ | $1.9\times10^{-11}$ | $1.3\times10^{-11}$ | $1.0\times10^{-11}$ |
| $2\beta_1/(1+\lvert T_3\rvert)$ | $1.0\times10^{-11}$ | $7.1\times10^{-12}$ | $8.7\times10^{-12}$ |
| $\beta_2/(1+\lvert T_3\rvert)$ | $5.6\times10^{-12}$ | $4.4\times10^{-12}$ | |
| $\beta_{\rm eval}/(1+\lvert T_3\rvert)$ | $3.1\times10^{-12}$ | $1.7\times10^{-12}$ | $1.3\times10^{-12}$ |
| $\beta_3$ at $4u\lvert\Omega\rvert$; $\beta_{\rm elem}$ | $1.2\times10^{-15}$; $2.5\times10^{-14}$ | $1.0\times10^{-15}$; $2.0\times10^{-14}$ | $1.5\times10^{-14}$ ($\beta_{\rm elem}$) |
| largest production-like residue (20 ulp triggers on all of $\Omega$) | $2.2\times10^{-13}$ (0.011 of $B_{T3}$) | $1.0\times10^{-13}$ (0.008) | |

These figures describe design E's data and its $N$; they are not a tolerance. `dwlsmv_dt_reftol` stays
$10^{-10}$. $\beta_2$ is dominated by S5's $2\varphi/(1-c)$, so the $\theta$ envelope reaches $T_3$ mainly
through $v$.

**$G=1$** is the special case $\pi=1$, $\Omega=\Gamma$, $n_T=N-1$. TS1–TS7 hold verbatim with one
group, and `mg-t3-g1` checks this.

#### Verification of TS1–TS7 (R 4.6.0; executed 2026-10-15)

The predictions and thresholds were written before any of these chunks ran:
E-039, with six addenda, each written before the run it
governs. Failed predictions are kept, and the chunks' assertions pin the recorded outcomes.

| Item | Claim | Threshold (before running) | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| P1, P2 | $\mathcal T$ is MG4 with `mg_ab`; with lavaan's objects and $T$ convention it is lavaan's `chisq.scaled` | $10^{-12}$, $10^{-8}$ | held: $1.2\times10^{-14}$, $5.7\times10^{-15}$ |
| P4–P7 | $G_\Delta$, $G_\Omega$ (diagonal, off-diagonal, full), $g_s$, $\nabla_\theta$ against central differences | $10^{-6}$ | **failed** for P4, P5 off-diagonal and P7 (up to $6.2\times10^{-6}$); the others held |
| D1–D3 | the same against complex steps; FD error at $10\times h$ | $10^{-10}$, $10^{-9}$; $\le0.3$ | held: $\le5.9\times10^{-12}$; 0.09. So P4–P7 failed on finite-difference rounding, and the gradients are right |
| P8–P11 | scale invariance; "$W$ fixed" control; off-diagonal control; normwise form | $10^{-13}$/$10^{-12}$; $>10^{-3}$; $[0.9,1.1]$; $\le1$ | held: $\le7.9\times10^{-14}$; 0.19–2.0; 1.00; $8.2\times10^{-3}$ |
| P12 | each route alone, aligned, against its first-order term | $[0.99,1.01]$ | held: 0.996–1.000 |
| P13 | drop one route: the change exceeds $\beta_{\rm eval}+r_T$ | $>1$ | **failed** with the first form of $\beta_{\rm eval}$ (routes 1 and 3: $7.6\times10^{-4}$, 0.04) |
| E1–E4 | gradient form: covers reordering; tighter than the first form; intermediate gradients; P13 again | $\le1$; $\le1$; $10^{-10}$; $>1$ | held: $2.9\times10^{-3}$; $\le1.6\times10^{-3}$; $4.1\times10^{-13}$; 1.65–2578 |
| — | route 1 with independent endpoints is $2\beta_1$ | $[1.9,2.1]$ | held: 2.00 |
| P14, U1, U2 | uniformity of $G_\Delta$, $G_\Omega$, $\nabla_\theta$; the trace part $v$; $F$'s gradient change against $2an_T\lvert J\rvert\Theta$ | $10^{-6}$; $10^{-6}$; $\le1$ | $G_\Delta$, $G_\Omega$ held ($\le7.6\times10^{-9}$); **$\nabla_\theta$ failed** ($3.2\times10^{-6}$, the $F$ part); U1 held ($3.8\times10^{-10}$); **U2 failed** by $9.2\times10^{-7}$ on metric, at a threshold row where $J$ has one entry, so the bound is attained and $\hat g$'s rounding tips it over. $\beta_2$ uses the Taylor form, which P12 checks directly |
| P15 | 200 joint draws within every envelope; the aligned worst case | $\le B_{T3}$; $[0.5,1]$ | held: $\le0.19$; 0.83–0.86 |
| P16 | production-like ulp triggers inside $B_{T3}$; exact-$\Delta$ residues; coupling | $\le B_{T3}$; $\le10^{-14}$; $>10$ | inside: held ($\le0.011$, equal $K$). **Exact residues failed** ($2.1\times10^{-14}$). **Coupling failed** on scalar (4.9; metric 13.5) |
| D4 | exact-$\Delta$ residues lie inside R's own evaluation term | $\le1$ | held: $\le2.9\times10^{-3}$. So P16's two failures sit at R's arithmetic floor |
| P17 | 50 joint row and column permutations against $\beta_{\rm eval}$ (plain-double model) | $\le1$ | held: first form $4.7\times10^{-6}$, gradient form $2.9\times10^{-3}$ |
| E5 | P15, P16, P18 with $\beta_{\rm elem}$ added | $\le B_{T3}$ | held |
| M1 | production-like $E$ is 0 off the mask and within $\bar E$ on it | $=0$; $\le1$ | held: 0; $\le0.59$ |
| P18 | $G=1$: $\pi$, $\Omega$, $w$ identical; lavaan; P4, P5; synthetic end to end | identical; $10^{-6}$; $10^{-6}$; $\le B_{T3}$ | held: identical; $5.2\times10^{-10}$; $8.2\times10^{-7}$, $2.2\times10^{-7}$; 0.18 |

**What a reader should take from the failures.** None of them is a counterexample to $B_{T3}$:
- P4–P7, P16 and D4 show the tests' own arithmetic floors;
- P13 shows that the first form of $\beta_{\rm eval}$ was useless as a size, though valid;
- P14 and U2 concern the uniformity of a gradient that $\beta_2$ does not need at first order.

All four were predictions set too tight, or claims about the wrong object. They are recorded as
failures because the rule is that a frozen prediction is never re-read after the run.

**Re-pinned 2026-10-19 (the user's option (a)).** On the milestone laptop (R 4.5.2, lavaan 0.7.2,
Windows ARM), the central-difference values moved across the 1e-6 line in both directions. So did D3 and
P16's coupling. The chunk assertions had pinned the 2026-10-15 values, so they failed there.
- **Values (loadings / intercepts, laptop):**
  - P4a: $1.3\times10^{-5}$ / $4.0\times10^{-7}$
  - P4b: $7.4\times10^{-7}$ / $8.6\times10^{-7}$
  - P5diag: $1.8\times10^{-6}$ / $1.0\times10^{-7}$
  - P5off: $6.1\times10^{-7}$ / $2.5\times10^{-5}$
  - P7: $1.6\times10^{-6}$ / $9.6\times10^{-8}$
  - D3: 0.040 / 0.64
  - coupling: 4.1 / 8.6
  - $G=1$ P4: $3.4\times10^{-6}$
- **What changed.** These are now reported, not asserted. They measure the tests' own rounding floors,
  not the gradients. The gradients stay asserted by the complex-step checks D1 and D2, which held at
  $\le1.3\times10^{-12}$ on both machines.
- **What did not change.** No threshold, prediction or recorded outcome. The table above still records
  the 2026-10-15 outcomes as run.

```{r mg-t3-setup}
# T3 = T(s, theta, Delta, Omega) as dwls_inference computes it, line by line, and its first-order
# gradients (Results TS3-TS5). W = W(Omega) = diag(1 / diag(Omega)) everywhere: in F (through T) and in
# the traces. The base point is a tight refit under that W, so that T and the traces see one W.
t3_u  <- 2^-53
t3_Om <- sv_E$Om; t3_w0 <- 1 / diag(t3_Om); t3_nT <- sv_E$N - sv_E$G     # Omega = blockdiag(Gamma_g / pi_g)
t3_inv <- function(P) chol2inv(chol(P))                                     # cholinv(), as the code
t3_tr <- function(Dl, Om, w = 1 / diag(Om), inv = t3_inv) {               # dwlsmv_traces, line by line
  WD <- w * Dl; Ei <- inv(crossprod(Dl, WD)); G_ <- crossprod(Om, WD)
  B <- crossprod(WD, G_); C <- crossprod(G_, w * G_); EB <- crossprod(Ei, B)
  c(t1 = sum(w * diag(Om)) - sum(Ei * B),
    t2 = sum(w * crossprod(Om * Om, w)) - 2 * sum(Ei * C) + sum(EB * t(EB)))
}
t3_of <- function(Tst, tr, Dd) Dd + sqrt(Dd / tr[["t2"]]) * (Tst - tr[["t1"]])   # a T + b, b = D - a Tr(M)
t3_at <- function(sig, th, Dl, Om, s = sv_s, nT = t3_nT, inv = t3_inv) {
  w <- 1 / diag(Om); r <- s - sig(th); Tst <- nT * sum(w * r^2); tr <- t3_tr(Dl, Om, w, inv)
  Dd <- length(s) - length(th)
  c(T3 = t3_of(Tst, tr, Dd), T = Tst, tr, a = sqrt(Dd / tr[["t2"]]), Dd = Dd)
}
# The gradients. dT3 = a [dT - dt1 - kap dt2], kap = (T - t1) / (2 t2).
#   Delta (TS3):  G1 = -2 U Om W Delta P^-1,  G2 = -4 U Om U Om W Delta P^-1
#   Omega (TS5):  dt1 = tr(U dOm) + sum_k dw_k [(I-Pi) Om (I-Pi)']_kk,  dt2 = 2 tr(U Om U dOm)
#                 + 2 sum_k dw_k [(I-Pi) Om U Om (I-Pi)']_kk,  dT = nT sum_k dw_k r_k^2,  dw_k = -w_k^2 dOm_kk
#   s:            dT = 2 nT r'W ds;   theta (TS4): dT3 = -2 a nT ghat'dtheta + <G_Delta, dDelta/dtheta>
t3_grad <- function(sig, th, Dl, Om, s = sv_s, nT = t3_nT) {
  w <- 1 / diag(Om); r <- s - sig(th); v <- t3_at(sig, th, Dl, Om, s, nT)
  a <- v[["a"]]; kap <- (v[["T"]] - v[["t1"]]) / (2 * v[["t2"]])
  Pi <- solve(crossprod(Dl, w * Dl)); WDPi <- (w * Dl) %*% Pi
  U <- diag(w) - WDPi %*% t(w * Dl); UO <- U %*% Om
  G1 <- -2 * UO %*% WDPi; G2 <- -4 * UO %*% UO %*% WDPi
  IP <- diag(length(w)) - Dl %*% t(WDPi)                                   # I - Pi, Pi = Delta P^-1 Delta'W
  Z1 <- IP %*% Om %*% t(IP); Z2 <- IP %*% Om %*% UO %*% t(IP)
  G1O <- U - diag(w^2 * diag(Z1)); G2O <- 2 * UO %*% U - diag(2 * w^2 * diag(Z2))
  GTO <- -diag(nT * w^2 * r^2)
  gh <- drop(crossprod(Dl, w * r))
  list(v = v, a = a, kap = kap, r = r, w = w, Pi = Pi, U = U, G1 = G1, G2 = G2,
       GD = -a * (G1 + kap * G2), GO = a * (GTO - G1O - kap * G2O), G1O = G1O, G2O = G2O, GTO = GTO,
       G1Ow = U, G2Ow = 2 * UO %*% U,                                       # the W-held-fixed parts (control)
       gs = 2 * a * nT * w * r, gh = gh, gF = -2 * a * nT * gh,
       Gw = a * (nT * r^2 - diag(Z1) - 2 * kap * diag(Z2)))                 # dT3/dw at fixed Omega
}
t3_dD <- function(sig, th, h = 1e-4)                                         # dDelta/dtheta_l, central (exact here:
  lapply(seq_along(th), function(l) { hl <- h * max(1, abs(th[l]))          # Delta is at most linear in any one
    (sv_jac(sig, replace(th, l, th[l] + hl)) - sv_jac(sig, replace(th, l, th[l] - hl))) / (2 * hl) })   # parameter)
t3_gth <- function(g, dD) g$gF + vapply(dD, function(M) sum(g$GD * M), 0)
# Where production's Delta carries central-difference error (dwlsmv_mg_dcols): the correlation rows of
# group g, in the lambda, beta and psi columns that group g's table carries. S5's bound on those entries.
t3_mask <- function(nm, nTg = sum(nm == "tau"), Pg = 10L, Dg = 21L) {
  M <- matrix(FALSE, 2L * Dg, length(nm)); r1 <- nTg + seq_len(Pg); r2 <- Dg + nTg + seq_len(Pg)
  M[r1, nm == "lam"] <- TRUE; M[r2, nm %in% c("lam", "phi")] <- TRUE; M
}
t3_Ebar <- function(sig, th, Dl, mask, eps_s5 = 2 * t3_u) {   # S5: (eps|sigma_k| + u(|v_j|+h_j)|Delta_kj|)/h_j, eps = S5's 2u
  hj <- 1e-5 * pmax(1, abs(th)); sg <- abs(sig(th))
  Eb <- (eps_s5 * outer(sg, rep(1, length(th))) + t3_u * abs(Dl) * rep(abs(th) + hj, each = nrow(Dl))) /
        rep(hj, each = nrow(Dl))
  Eb * mask
}
# The theta envelope of S1-S5, absolute: |A(ds + r o eps)| + (1+|theta|) S^(C) + 2 phi / (1 - c)
t3_Theta <- function(o, w, Ebar, eps = 0, ds = 0, K, stK) {
  Pi <- abs(solve(o$P)); n <- length(w); gq <- n * 2^-104 / (1 - n * 2^-104)
  SA <- abs(drop(o$A %*% (ds + o$r * eps)))
  f  <- 2 * gq * colSums(abs(w * o$r * o$D)); dPb <- 2 * t3_u * abs(o$P) + 2 * gq * crossprod(abs(o$D), w * abs(o$D))
  SC <- K * drop(Pi %*% ((2 * t3_u * abs(o$P) + dPb) %*% abs(stK))) + drop(Pi %*% f) / (1 - o$c)
  phi <- drop(Pi %*% crossprod(Ebar, w * abs(o$r)))
  SA + SC + 2 * phi / (1 - o$c)
}
# The route terms (TS3-TS5), absolute on T3.
t3_beta <- function(g, Ebar, gth_abs, Theta, J, dOm = 0, ds = 0) {
  c(b1 = sum(abs(g$GD) * Ebar),                                              # one endpoint
    b2 = sum(gth_abs * Theta) + g$a * t3_nT_of(g) * drop(crossprod(Theta, abs(J) %*% Theta)),
    b3 = sum(abs(g$GO) * abs(dOm)) + sum(abs(g$gs) * abs(ds)))
}
t3_nT_of <- function(g) g$v[["T"]] / sum(g$w * g$r^2)                        # nT, read back from T = nT F
# |grad_theta| with S4/S5's bound on the exact ghat at a stopping iterate: |ghat_c| + |Ebar|'W|r| + |Delta|'W|r| max|eps|
t3_gth_abs <- function(g, dD, gh_c, Ebar, Dl, eps_max = 0) {
  ghb <- abs(gh_c) + drop(crossprod(Ebar, g$w * abs(g$r))) + drop(crossprod(abs(Dl), g$w * abs(g$r))) * eps_max
  2 * g$a * t3_nT_of(g) * ghb + abs(vapply(dD, function(M) sum(g$GD * M), 0))
}
# The evaluation term (TS6): every product of dwlsmv_traces perturbed at its own model size, first order.
# eta(n, X) bounds the cross-run difference of a reduction of n terms with absolute-term sum X:
# Stata model 2u X (quadcross, chunk model), R model 2 gamma_(n+1) X (plain double, any order).
t3_eta_stata <- function(n, X) 2 * t3_u * X
t3_eta_R     <- function(n, X) 2 * (n + 1) * t3_u / (1 - (n + 1) * t3_u) * X
t3_eta_q4    <- function(n, X) 2 * (n - 1) * t3_u / (1 - (n - 1) * t3_u) * X   # SE6: Q4, 2 gamma_(n-1) X
t3_beval_abs <- function(Dl, Om, r, nT, eta, c_ch = 6 * (ncol(Dl) + 1)) {   # first form: absolute values composed
  w <- 1 / diag(Om); D <- nrow(Dl); q <- ncol(Dl); aD <- abs(Dl); WD <- w * Dl
  P <- crossprod(Dl, WD); Ei <- solve(P); Gm <- crossprod(Om, WD); B <- crossprod(WD, Gm)
  C <- crossprod(Gm, w * Gm); EB <- Ei %*% B; aEi <- abs(Ei)
  dP  <- eta(D, crossprod(aD, w * aD)) + c_ch * t3_u * sqrt(outer(diag(P), diag(P)))  # + cholinv backward
  dEi <- aEi %*% dP %*% aEi
  dGm <- eta(D, crossprod(abs(Om), abs(WD)))
  dB  <- eta(D, crossprod(abs(WD), abs(Gm))) + crossprod(abs(WD), dGm)
  dC  <- eta(D, crossprod(abs(Gm), w * abs(Gm))) + crossprod(dGm, w * abs(Gm)) + crossprod(abs(Gm), w * dGm)
  dEB <- eta(q, aEi %*% abs(B)) + dEi %*% abs(B) + aEi %*% dB
  gq  <- 2 * q * t3_u / (1 - q * t3_u)                                       # sum(diagonal()): plain double
  a1 <- sum(w * diag(Om)); y <- crossprod(Om * Om, w); a2 <- sum(w * y)
  dt1 <- eta(D, a1) + sum(diag(dEB)) + gq * sum(abs(diag(EB))) + t3_u * (abs(a1) + abs(sum(diag(EB))))
  X2 <- Ei %*% C; X3 <- EB %*% EB
  dX2 <- diag(eta(q, aEi %*% abs(C)) + dEi %*% abs(C) + aEi %*% dC)
  dX3 <- diag(eta(q, abs(EB) %*% abs(EB)) + 2 * abs(EB) %*% dEB)
  dt2 <- eta(D, sum(w * abs(y))) + sum(w * eta(D, crossprod(Om * Om, w))) +
         2 * (sum(dX2) + gq * sum(abs(diag(X2)))) + sum(dX3) + gq * sum(abs(diag(X3))) +
         2 * t3_u * (abs(a2) + 2 * abs(sum(diag(X2))) + abs(sum(diag(X3))))
  t2 <- a2 - 2 * sum(diag(X2)) + sum(diag(X3)); t1 <- a1 - sum(diag(EB))
  Tst <- nT * sum(w * r^2); Dd <- D - q; a <- sqrt(Dd / t2); kap <- (Tst - t1) / (2 * t2)
  dT <- nT * eta(D, sum(w * r^2))
  a * (dT + dt1 + abs(kap) * dt2) + 4 * t3_u * (abs(a * Tst) + abs(a * t1) + Dd)
}
# Second form (the one B_T3 uses): the first-order worst case over independent roundings,
# sum_X <|dT3/dX|, delta_X>, with dT3/dX the total derivative of T3 in the intermediate X of
# dwlsmv_traces (downstream recomputed exactly). dT3 = a dT - a dt1 - a kap dt2.
t3_evgrad <- function(Dl, Om, r, nT) {
  w <- 1 / diag(Om); WD <- w * Dl; P <- crossprod(Dl, WD); Ei <- solve(P); Gm <- crossprod(Om, WD)
  B <- crossprod(WD, Gm); C <- crossprod(Gm, w * Gm); EB <- Ei %*% B; q <- ncol(Dl); D <- nrow(Dl)
  a1 <- sum(w * diag(Om)); y <- drop(crossprod(Om * Om, w)); a2 <- sum(w * y); X2 <- Ei %*% C; X3 <- EB %*% EB
  t1 <- a1 - sum(diag(EB)); t2 <- a2 - 2 * sum(diag(X2)) + sum(diag(X3)); Tst <- nT * sum(w * r^2)
  a <- sqrt((D - q) / t2); kap <- (Tst - t1) / (2 * t2)
  F_EB <- a * diag(q) - 2 * a * kap * t(EB)                                  # t1 through tr(EB), t2 through tr(EB EB)
  G_B <- Ei %*% F_EB; G_C <- 2 * a * kap * Ei
  G_Ei <- F_EB %*% t(B) + 2 * a * kap * t(C); G_P <- -Ei %*% G_Ei %*% Ei
  G_Gm <- WD %*% G_B + (w * Gm) %*% (G_C + t(G_C))
  list(w = w, WD = WD, P = P, Ei = Ei, Gm = Gm, B = B, C = C, EB = EB, X2 = X2, X3 = X3, y = y, a1 = a1, a2 = a2,
       t1 = t1, t2 = t2, Tst = Tst, a = a, kap = kap, F_EB = F_EB, G_B = G_B, G_C = G_C, G_Ei = G_Ei, G_P = G_P,
       G_Gm = G_Gm, D = D, q = q)
}
t3_beval <- function(Dl, Om, r, nT, eta, c_ch = 6 * (ncol(Dl) + 1)) {
  z <- t3_evgrad(Dl, Om, r, nT); D <- z$D; q <- z$q; w <- z$w; a <- z$a; k <- abs(z$kap)
  aD <- abs(Dl); aEi <- abs(z$Ei); gq <- 2 * q * t3_u / (1 - q * t3_u)        # sum(diagonal()): plain double
  dP  <- eta(D, crossprod(aD, w * aD)) + c_ch * t3_u * sqrt(outer(diag(z$P), diag(z$P)))   # + cholinv (assumed)
  dGm <- eta(D, crossprod(abs(Om), abs(z$WD))); dB <- eta(D, crossprod(abs(z$WD), abs(z$Gm)))
  dC  <- eta(D, crossprod(abs(z$Gm), w * abs(z$Gm))); dEB <- eta(q, aEi %*% abs(z$B))
  dX2 <- diag(eta(q, aEi %*% abs(z$C))); dX3 <- diag(eta(q, abs(z$EB) %*% abs(z$EB)))
  sum(abs(z$G_P) * dP) + sum(abs(z$G_Gm) * dGm) + sum(abs(z$G_B) * dB) + sum(abs(z$G_C) * dC) +
    sum(abs(z$F_EB) * dEB) + 2 * a * k * sum(dX2) + a * k * sum(dX3) +
    a * k * (sum(w * eta(D, drop(crossprod(Om * Om, w)))) + eta(D, sum(w * abs(z$y)))) +
    a * eta(D, z$a1) + a * nT * eta(D, sum(w * r^2)) +
    a * gq * sum(abs(diag(z$EB))) + 2 * a * k * gq * sum(abs(diag(z$X2))) + a * k * gq * sum(abs(diag(z$X3))) +
    a * t3_u * (abs(z$a1) + abs(sum(diag(z$EB)))) + a * k * 2 * t3_u * (abs(z$a2) + 2 * abs(sum(diag(z$X2))) + abs(sum(diag(z$X3)))) +
    4 * t3_u * (abs(a * z$Tst) + abs(a * z$t1) + D - q)
}
# The downstream computation from the intermediates, for the complex-step check of the gradients (E3)
t3_chain <- function(Dl, Om, r, nT, dP = 0, dEi = 0, dGm = 0, dB = 0, dC = 0, dEB = 0) {
  w <- 1 / diag(Om); WD <- w * Dl; P <- crossprod(Dl, WD) + dP; Ei <- solve(P) + dEi
  Gm <- crossprod(Om, WD) + dGm; B <- crossprod(WD, Gm) + dB; C <- crossprod(Gm, w * Gm) + dC; EB <- Ei %*% B + dEB
  t1 <- sum(w * diag(Om)) - sum(diag(EB)); t2 <- sum(w * crossprod(Om * Om, w)) - 2 * sum(diag(Ei %*% C)) + sum(diag(EB %*% EB))
  Dd <- nrow(Dl) - ncol(Dl); Dd + sqrt(Dd / t2) * (nT * sum(w * r^2) - t1)
}
t3_rel <- function(x, y) abs(x - y) / max(abs(y), 1e-300)
t3_sym <- function(n) { S <- matrix(runif(n * n, -1, 1), n); (S + t(S)) / 2 }
# Elementwise roundings, redrawn when the two runs' inputs differ (TS6, added after the fifth run):
# closed-form Delta entries and W o Delta, w = 1/diag(Omega), sigma(theta-hat) in r; two runs each.
t3_belem <- function(g, Dl, sig, th, eps_s5 = 2 * t3_u)
  sum(abs(g$GD) * 4 * t3_u * abs(Dl)) + sum(abs(g$Gw) * 2 * t3_u * g$w) + sum(abs(g$gs) * 2 * eps_s5 * abs(sig(th)))
t3_rT <- function(T3) 2 * t3_u * abs(T3) / (1 + abs(T3))                     # one ulp each side, in check 6's measure
t3_rho <- 0.01                                                               # working value for the chunks only (see text)

# The base points: a tight refit under W(Omega); exact Delta; the production run's K and last step.
t3_lev <- lapply(sv_lev, function(o) {
  th <- sv_tight(o$sig, sv_s, t3_w0, o$th)
  p  <- sv_parts(o$sig, sv_s, t3_w0, th)
  b0 <- sv_gn(o$sig, sv_s, t3_w0, o$x0); K <- b0$K
  c(list(sig = o$sig, nm = o$nm, x0 = o$x0, th = th, K = K, stK = b0$xs[[K + 1L]] - b0$xs[[K]]), p)
})
# P1: the T3 map is MG4 composed with mg_ab, on the same inputs. P2: with lavaan's own Delta and Gamma and
# lavaan's T convention it reproduces lavaan's scaled-and-shifted statistic.
t3_p1 <- sapply(t3_lev, function(o) {
  v <- t3_at(o$sig, o$th, o$D, t3_Om)
  pp <- list(P = crossprod(o$D, t3_w0 * o$D), B = crossprod(t3_w0 * o$D, t3_Om %*% (t3_w0 * o$D)),
             C = crossprod(t3_Om %*% (t3_w0 * o$D), t3_w0 * (t3_Om %*% (t3_w0 * o$D))),
             had = sum(t3_w0 * (t3_Om * t3_Om) %*% t3_w0), Dtot = length(sv_s))
  ab <- mg_ab(mg_traces_q(pp), v[["Dd"]])
  abs(v[["T3"]] / (ab[["a"]] * v[["T"]] + ab[["b"]]) - 1)
})
t3_p2 <- sapply(c("loadings", "intercepts"), function(lev) {
  ck <- mg_check(inv_fit(dE, lev)$fit); pp <- ck$pp
  Tl <- ck$Tc[[mg_T_convention[["h1"]]]]
  v  <- t3_of(Tl, setNames(mg_traces_q(pp), c("t1", "t2")), pp$Dtot - pp$q)
  abs(v / ck$lavT3 - 1)
})
print(signif(rbind(P1 = t3_p1, P2 = t3_p2), 3))
stopifnot(t3_p1 < 1e-12, t3_p2 < 1e-8)                                       # P1, P2 (set before running)
stopifnot(sapply(t3_lev, function(o) abs(t3_at(o$sig, o$th, o$D, t3_Om)[["T3"]])) >= 1e-2)   # posting term is 0
invisible(lapply(names(t3_lev), function(lev) { o <- t3_lev[[lev]]; v <- t3_at(o$sig, o$th, o$D, t3_Om)
  cat(sprintf("%s: T3 = %.6f, T = %.6f, t1 = %.4f, t2 = %.4f, a = %.4f, df = %d, K = %d\n", lev, v[["T3"]],
              v[["T"]], v[["t1"]], v[["t2"]], v[["a"]], v[["Dd"]], o$K)) }))
```

```{r mg-t3-grad}
# The gradients against central finite differences of the exact computation (P4-P7), scale invariance
# (P8), the two controls (P9, P10) and the normwise form of route 1 (P11). Thresholds set before running.
set.seed(20261015)
t3_gr <- lapply(t3_lev, function(o) {
  g <- t3_grad(o$sig, o$th, o$D, t3_Om); mk <- t3_mask(o$nm); n <- nrow(o$D)
  fT <- function(Dl = o$D, Om = t3_Om, s = sv_s, th = o$th) t3_at(o$sig, th, Dl, Om, s)[["T3"]]
  hc <- 1e-20; csT <- function(Dl = o$D, Om = t3_Om, s = sv_s, th = o$th)   # complex step of T3
    Im(t3_at(o$sig, th, Dl, Om, s, inv = solve)[["T3"]]) / hc
  h <- 1e-6
  S1 <- matrix(runif(length(o$D), -1, 1), nrow(o$D)) * abs(o$D) * mk        # (a) on the mask
  S2 <- matrix(runif(length(o$D), -1, 1), nrow(o$D)) * (abs(o$D) + 1e-3)    # (b) every entry
  fdD <- function(S) (fT(Dl = o$D + h * S) - fT(Dl = o$D - h * S)) / (2 * h)
  hO <- 1e-7; Sx <- t3_sym(n) * abs(t3_Om)
  So <- list(diag = diag(diag(Sx)), off = Sx - diag(diag(Sx)), full = Sx)
  fdO <- function(S) (fT(Om = t3_Om + hO * S) - fT(Om = t3_Om - hO * S)) / (2 * hO)
  Ss <- runif(n, -1, 1) * 1e-2
  fdS <- (fT(s = sv_s + h * Ss) - fT(s = sv_s - h * Ss)) / (2 * h)
  dD <- t3_dD(o$sig, o$th); gth <- t3_gth(g, dD); St <- runif(length(o$th), -1, 1)
  fdT <- (fT(Dl = sv_jac(o$sig, o$th + h * St), th = o$th + h * St) -
          fT(Dl = sv_jac(o$sig, o$th - h * St), th = o$th - h * St)) / (2 * h)
  c1 <- 1.7; tr0 <- t3_tr(o$D, t3_Om); trc <- t3_tr(o$D, c1 * t3_Om)
  # P9: W held fixed in the traces' gradient (the dW terms dropped), along the diagonal direction
  GOfix <- g$a * (g$GTO - g$G1Ow - g$kap * g$G2Ow)
  # P10: an off-diagonal-only, sign-aligned dOmega
  Soff <- sign(g$GO) * abs(t3_Om); diag(Soff) <- 0; Soff <- (Soff + t(Soff)) / 2
  hA <- 1e-8; chA <- fT(Om = t3_Om + hA * Soff) - fT()
  # P11: |dt1|, |dt2| against their normwise bounds; first order in 100 random dDelta
  Wh <- sqrt(g$w); Q <- Wh * o$D; sv <- svd(Q)$d; H <- Q %*% solve(crossprod(Q), t(Q))
  Ot <- Wh * t(Wh * t3_Om); IH <- diag(n) - H
  nb1 <- 2 * norm(IH %*% Ot, "F") / min(sv); nb2 <- 4 * norm(IH %*% Ot %*% IH %*% Ot, "F") / min(sv)
  p11 <- replicate(100, { S <- matrix(rnorm(length(o$D)), nrow(o$D)); nq <- norm(Wh * S, "F")
    c(abs(sum(g$G1 * S)) / (nb1 * nq), abs(sum(g$G2 * S)) / (nb2 * nq)) })
  c(P4a = t3_rel(sum(g$GD * S1), fdD(S1)), P4b = t3_rel(sum(g$GD * S2), fdD(S2)),
    P5diag = t3_rel(sum(g$GO * So$diag), fdO(So$diag)), P5off = t3_rel(sum(g$GO * So$off), fdO(So$off)),
    P5full = t3_rel(sum(g$GO * So$full), fdO(So$full)), P6 = t3_rel(sum(g$gs * Ss), fdS),
    P7 = t3_rel(sum(gth * St), fdT),
    P8t1 = t3_rel(trc[["t1"]], tr0[["t1"]]), P8t2 = t3_rel(trc[["t2"]], tr0[["t2"]]),
    P8g1 = abs(sum(g$G1O * t3_Om)) / sum(abs(g$G1O) * abs(t3_Om)),
    P8g2 = abs(sum(g$G2O * t3_Om)) / sum(abs(g$G2O) * abs(t3_Om)),
    P9fix = t3_rel(sum(GOfix * So$diag), fdO(So$diag)),
    P10ratio = chA / (hA * sum(g$GO * Soff)), P10diagonly = sum(diag(diag(g$GO)) * Soff),
    P11max = max(p11), amp1 = norm(g$G1, "2") * min(sv), sig_min = min(sv), sig_ratio = min(sv) / max(sv),
    # Diagnosis of P4-P7 (added after they failed; D1-D3 set before running): complex-step directional
    # derivatives of the same map, with solve() for the bread (it takes complex input).
    D1_4a = t3_rel(sum(g$GD * S1), csT(Dl = o$D + 1i * hc * S1)), D1_4b = t3_rel(sum(g$GD * S2), csT(Dl = o$D + 1i * hc * S2)),
    D1_5diag = t3_rel(sum(g$GO * So$diag), csT(Om = t3_Om + 1i * hc * So$diag)),
    D1_5off = t3_rel(sum(g$GO * So$off), csT(Om = t3_Om + 1i * hc * So$off)),
    D1_5full = t3_rel(sum(g$GO * So$full), csT(Om = t3_Om + 1i * hc * So$full)),
    D1_6 = t3_rel(sum(g$gs * Ss), csT(s = sv_s + 1i * hc * Ss)),
    D2_7 = t3_rel(sum(gth * St), csT(th = o$th + 1i * hc * St) + csT(Dl = o$D + 1i * hc * Reduce(`+`, Map(`*`, St, dD)))),
    D3 = abs((fT(Dl = o$D + 1e-5 * S1) - fT(Dl = o$D - 1e-5 * S1)) / 2e-5 - csT(Dl = o$D + 1i * hc * S1)) /
         abs(fdD(S1) - csT(Dl = o$D + 1i * hc * S1)))
})
t3_gr <- do.call(cbind, t3_gr)
print(signif(t3_gr, 3))
# P4-P7 at 1e-6 FAILED on the first run (kept; see the text). P4-P7 and D3 measure central-difference
# rounding floors, which move across machines (2026-10-19, the user's option (a): reported, not asserted;
# both machines' values are in the text). The gradients are asserted by the complex steps D1, D2.
stopifnot(t3_gr["P6", ] <= 1e-6,
          t3_gr[c("D1_4a", "D1_4b", "D1_5diag", "D1_5off", "D1_5full", "D1_6"), ] <= 1e-10,   # D1
          t3_gr["D2_7", ] <= 1e-9,                                                             # D2
          t3_gr[c("P8t1", "P8t2"), ] <= 1e-13, t3_gr[c("P8g1", "P8g2"), ] <= 1e-12,
          t3_gr["P9fix", ] > 1e-3,
          abs(t3_gr["P10ratio", ] - 1) <= 0.1, t3_gr["P10diagonly", ] == 0,
          t3_gr["P11max", ] <= 1)
```

```{r mg-t3-routes}
# Each route alone at a resolvable input scale, sign-aligned (P12); drop-one controls (P13); uniformity of
# the gradients over the envelope (P14). Thresholds set before running.
t3_rt <- lapply(t3_lev, function(o) {
  g <- t3_grad(o$sig, o$th, o$D, t3_Om); mk <- t3_mask(o$nm); dD <- t3_dD(o$sig, o$th)
  Eb <- t3_Ebar(o$sig, o$th, o$D, mk); T30 <- g$v[["T3"]]
  Th <- t3_Theta(o, t3_w0, Eb, K = o$K, stK = o$stK)
  be <- t3_beval_abs(o$D, t3_Om, g$r, t3_nT, t3_eta_stata)                 # the first form (P13 as run)
  red <- be + t3_rT(T30) * (1 + abs(T30))                                    # beta_eval + r_T: the reduced bound
  be2 <- t3_beval(o$D, t3_Om, g$r, t3_nT, t3_eta_stata)                    # the gradient form (E4)
  red2 <- be2 + t3_rT(T30) * (1 + abs(T30))
  fT <- function(Dl = o$D, Om = t3_Om, th = o$th) t3_at(o$sig, th, Dl, Om)[["T3"]]
  # route 1: E at its bound, aligned
  Em <- sv_cdjac(if (any(o$nm == "nu")) "loadings" else "intercepts")(o$sig, o$th) - o$D   # M1: the mask
  E1 <- sign(g$GD) * Eb; ch1 <- fT(Dl = o$D + E1) - T30; b1 <- sum(abs(g$GD) * Eb)
  # route 1, both endpoints as independent draws with opposite signs: T(Delta + E) - T(Delta - E)
  ch1b <- fT(Dl = o$D + E1) - fT(Dl = o$D - E1)
  # route 2: dtheta = 1e3 Theta, aligned with the gradient (exact Delta at the moved point)
  gth <- t3_gth(g, dD); dth <- 1e3 * Th * sign(gth)
  ch2 <- fT(Dl = sv_jac(o$sig, o$th + dth), th = o$th + dth) - T30
  b2 <- sum(abs(gth) * abs(dth)) + g$a * t3_nT * drop(crossprod(abs(dth), abs(o$J) %*% abs(dth)))
  # route 3: dOmega = 1e-10 |Omega|, aligned (symmetric, so the sign of the symmetric gradient)
  dO <- 1e-10 * abs(t3_Om) * sign(g$GO); ch3 <- fT(Om = t3_Om + dO) - T30; b3 <- sum(abs(g$GO) * abs(dO))
  # P14: the gradients at a point moved by Theta (random signs) and by a 4u dOmega
  set.seed(5); thm <- o$th + Th * sample(c(-1, 1), length(Th), TRUE)
  Om2 <- t3_Om * (1 + 4 * t3_u * t3_sym(nrow(t3_Om)))
  g2 <- t3_grad(o$sig, thm, sv_jac(o$sig, thm), Om2); dD2 <- t3_dD(o$sig, thm)
  uni <- function(x1, x0) max(abs(abs(x1) - abs(x0))) / max(abs(x0))
  c(r1_ratio = ch1 / b1, r1_both_over_one = abs(ch1b) / b1, r2_ratio = ch2 / b2, r3_ratio = ch3 / b3,
    r1_over_red = abs(ch1) / red, r2_over_red = abs(ch2) / red, r3_over_red = abs(ch3) / red,
    uni_GD = uni(g2$GD * mk, g$GD * mk), uni_gth = uni(t3_gth(g2, dD2), gth), uni_GO = uni(g2$GO, g$GO),
    b1 = b1, beta_eval = be, beta_eval_grad = be2, T3 = T30,
    r1_over_red2 = abs(ch1) / red2, r2_over_red2 = abs(ch2) / red2, r3_over_red2 = abs(ch3) / red2,
    beta_elem = (bel <- t3_belem(g, o$D, o$sig, o$th)), r1_over_red3 = abs(ch1) / (red2 + bel),
    r2_over_red3 = abs(ch2) / (red2 + bel), r3_over_red3 = abs(ch3) / (red2 + bel),
    U1 = uni(t3_gth(g2, dD2) - g2$gF, gth - g$gF),                             # the trace part of grad_theta
    U2 = max(abs(g2$gF - g$gF) / (2 * g$a * t3_nT * drop(abs(o$J) %*% Th))),   # F part against its Hessian bound
    M1_off = max(abs(Em[!mk])), M1_on = max(abs(Em[mk]) / Eb[mk]))
})
t3_rt <- do.call(cbind, t3_rt)
print(signif(t3_rt, 4))
# P13, P14 and U2 FAILED (kept; see the text); the assertions pin the recorded outcomes. E4, U1, U2 were set
# before the third run.
stopifnot(abs(t3_rt[c("r1_ratio", "r2_ratio", "r3_ratio"), ] - 1) <= 0.01,          # P12
          apply(t3_rt[c("r1_over_red", "r3_over_red"), ], 1, max) < 1,             # P13 as run: failed
          t3_rt["r1_both_over_one", ] >= 1.9, t3_rt["r1_both_over_one", ] <= 2.1,
          t3_rt[c("uni_GD", "uni_GO"), ] <= 1e-6, max(t3_rt["uni_gth", ]) > 1e-6,    # P14 as run: grad_theta failed
          t3_rt[c("r1_over_red2", "r2_over_red2", "r3_over_red2"), ] > 1,            # E4
          t3_rt["U1", ] <= 1e-6, max(t3_rt["U2", ]) > 1,                             # U1; U2 as run: failed (1 + 9.2e-7)
          t3_rt["M1_off", ] == 0, t3_rt["M1_on", ] <= 1)                             # M1
```

```{r mg-t3-eval}
# The evaluation term (P17): T3 is invariant to reordering the statistics and the parameters, so joint row
# and column permutations change every reduction order and nothing else. In plain double (R's BLAS and
# chol2inv), the change must stay inside beta_eval under the plain-double model.
t3_ev <- sapply(t3_lev, function(o) {
  T30 <- t3_at(o$sig, o$th, o$D, t3_Om)[["T3"]]; r <- sv_s - o$sig(o$th)
  bR <- t3_beval(o$D, t3_Om, r, t3_nT, t3_eta_R); bS <- t3_beval(o$D, t3_Om, r, t3_nT, t3_eta_stata)
  bRa <- t3_beval_abs(o$D, t3_Om, r, t3_nT, t3_eta_R); bSa <- t3_beval_abs(o$D, t3_Om, r, t3_nT, t3_eta_stata)
  z <- t3_evgrad(o$D, t3_Om, r, t3_nT); q <- ncol(o$D); n <- nrow(o$D); hc <- 1e-20; set.seed(78)
  cs <- function(...) Im(t3_chain(o$D, t3_Om, r, t3_nT, ...)) / hc
  Sq <- function() matrix(runif(q * q, -1, 1), q); Sg <- matrix(runif(n * q, -1, 1), n)
  e3 <- c(P = { S <- Sq() * abs(z$P); t3_rel(sum(z$G_P * S), cs(dP = 1i * hc * S)) },
          Ei = { S <- Sq() * abs(z$Ei); t3_rel(sum(z$G_Ei * S), cs(dEi = 1i * hc * S)) },
          Gm = { S <- Sg * abs(z$Gm); t3_rel(sum(z$G_Gm * S), cs(dGm = 1i * hc * S)) },
          B = { S <- Sq() * abs(z$B); t3_rel(sum(z$G_B * S), cs(dB = 1i * hc * S)) },
          C = { S <- Sq() * abs(z$C); t3_rel(sum(z$G_C * S), cs(dC = 1i * hc * S)) },
          EB = { S <- Sq() * abs(z$EB); t3_rel(sum(z$F_EB * S), cs(dEB = 1i * hc * S)) })
  set.seed(77)
  dif <- replicate(50, { pr <- sample(nrow(o$D)); pc <- sample(ncol(o$D)); Dp <- o$D[pr, pc]; Op <- t3_Om[pr, pr]
    w <- 1 / diag(Op); t3_of(t3_nT * sum(w * r[pr]^2), t3_tr(Dp, Op, w), nrow(Dp) - ncol(Dp)) - T30 })
  c(max_abs_change = max(abs(dif)), beta_eval_R = bR, ratio = max(abs(dif)) / bR, beta_eval_stata = bS,
    first_form_R = bRa, ratio_first_form = max(abs(dif)) / bRa, E2_R = bR / bRa, E2_stata = bS / bSa,
    E3_max = max(e3),
    stata_measure = bS / (1 + abs(T30)), n_nonzero = sum(dif != 0))
})
print(signif(t3_ev, 3))
stopifnot(t3_ev["ratio_first_form", ] <= 1,                                         # P17 (first form)
          t3_ev["ratio", ] <= 1, t3_ev[c("E2_R", "E2_stata"), ] <= 1, t3_ev["E3_max", ] <= 1e-10)   # E1, E2, E3
```

```{r mg-t3-e2e}
# End to end. (i) Synthetic joint perturbations within every envelope at once (P15). (ii) Production-like:
# ulp triggers on every Omega entry, refits with the central-difference Delta at the production stop,
# T3 with that Delta (P16). B_T3 is formed from the stored fit's own quantities and the measured inputs.
t3_B <- function(o, Dl, th, gh_c, Om_b, dOm, eps, K, stK, rho = t3_rho, eta = t3_eta_stata) {   # eta: SE6
  g <- t3_grad(o$sig, th, Dl, Om_b); mk <- t3_mask(o$nm); Eb <- t3_Ebar(o$sig, th, Dl, mk)
  pp <- sv_parts(o$sig, sv_s, 1 / diag(Om_b), th)
  Th <- t3_Theta(pp, 1 / diag(Om_b), Eb, eps = eps, K = K, stK = stK)
  dD <- t3_dD(o$sig, th); gtha <- t3_gth_abs(g, dD, gh_c, Eb, Dl, eps_max = max(abs(eps)))
  bb <- t3_beta(g, Eb, gtha, Th, pp$J, dOm = dOm)
  be <- t3_beval(Dl, Om_b, g$r, t3_nT, eta); T3 <- g$v[["T3"]]
  bel <- t3_belem(g, Dl, o$sig, th)
  B <- ((1 + rho) * (2 * bb[["b1"]] + bb[["b2"]] + bb[["b3"]]) + be + bel) / (1 + abs(T3)) + t3_rT(T3)
  list(B = B, terms = c(2 * bb[["b1"]], bb[["b2"]], bb[["b3"]], be, bel) / (1 + abs(T3)), Theta = Th, Ebar = Eb, T3 = T3)
}
t3_e2e <- lapply(names(t3_lev), function(lev) {
  o <- t3_lev[[lev]]; cdj <- sv_cdjac(lev); u <- t3_u; n <- nrow(t3_Om)
  # (i) synthetic, at the tight point with the exact Delta
  dOm_env <- 4 * u * abs(t3_Om)
  Bs <- t3_B(o, o$D, o$th, drop(crossprod(o$D, t3_w0 * (sv_s - o$sig(o$th)))), t3_Om, dOm_env,
             eps = 4 * u, K = o$K, stK = o$stK)
  T30 <- Bs$T3; set.seed(2026)
  syn <- replicate(200, {
    tha <- o$th + runif(length(o$th), -1, 1) * Bs$Theta
    Ea <- matrix(runif(length(o$D), -1, 1), n) * Bs$Ebar; Eb <- matrix(runif(length(o$D), -1, 1), n) * Bs$Ebar
    dO <- t3_sym(n) * dOm_env
    Ta <- t3_at(o$sig, tha, sv_jac(o$sig, tha) + Ea, t3_Om + dO)[["T3"]]
    Tb <- t3_at(o$sig, o$th, o$D + Eb, t3_Om)[["T3"]]
    abs(Ta - Tb) / (1 + abs(Tb)) })
  g <- t3_grad(o$sig, o$th, o$D, t3_Om); dD <- t3_dD(o$sig, o$th); gth <- t3_gth(g, dD)
  tha <- o$th + Bs$Theta * sign(gth); E1 <- sign(g$GD) * Bs$Ebar
  Ta <- t3_at(o$sig, tha, sv_jac(o$sig, tha) + E1, t3_Om + dOm_env * sign(g$GO))[["T3"]]
  Tb <- t3_at(o$sig, o$th, o$D - E1, t3_Om)[["T3"]]
  worst <- abs(Ta - Tb) / (1 + abs(Tb)) / Bs$B
  # (ii) production-like: the stored fit is the central-difference run from the ULS start under W(Omega)
  b0c <- sv_gnj(o$sig, sv_s, t3_w0, o$x0, cdj); b0x <- sv_gnj(o$sig, sv_s, t3_w0, o$x0, sv_jac)
  Dc <- cdj(o$sig, b0c$x); T3c <- t3_at(o$sig, b0c$x, Dc, t3_Om)[["T3"]]
  T3x <- t3_at(o$sig, b0x$x, sv_jac(o$sig, b0x$x), t3_Om)[["T3"]]
  ghc <- drop(crossprod(Dc, t3_w0 * (sv_s - o$sig(b0c$x))))
  trig <- t(sapply(1:20, function(m) {
    set.seed(300 + m); Xi <- matrix(sample(c(-1, 1), n * n, TRUE), n); Xi[lower.tri(Xi)] <- t(Xi)[lower.tri(Xi)]
    Om2 <- t3_Om * (1 + Xi * u); w2 <- 1 / diag(Om2); dO <- Om2 - t3_Om
    rc <- sv_gnj(o$sig, sv_s, w2, o$x0, cdj); rx <- sv_gnj(o$sig, sv_s, w2, o$x0, sv_jac)
    Tc <- t3_at(o$sig, rc$x, cdj(o$sig, rc$x), Om2)[["T3"]]
    Tx <- t3_at(o$sig, rx$x, sv_jac(o$sig, rx$x), Om2)[["T3"]]
    Bc <- t3_B(o, Dc, b0c$x, ghc, t3_Om, dO, eps = w2 / t3_w0 - 1, K = b0c$K, stK = o$stK)
    c(cd = abs(Tc - T3c) / (1 + abs(T3c)), exact = abs(Tx - T3x) / (1 + abs(T3x)), B = Bc$B,
      over_B = abs(Tc - T3c) / (1 + abs(T3c)) / Bc$B, sameK = rc$K == b0c$K && rx$K == b0x$K,
      th_cd = max(abs(rc$x - b0c$x) / (1 + abs(b0c$x))), Bc$terms)
  }))
  colnames(trig)[7:11] <- c("route1x2", "route2", "route3", "eval", "elem")
  eR <- t3_beval(sv_jac(o$sig, b0x$x), t3_Om, sv_s - o$sig(b0x$x), t3_nT, t3_eta_R) / (1 + abs(T3x))   # D4
  list(syn_over_B = max(syn) / Bs$B, syn_max = max(syn), worst = worst, B_syn = Bs$B, terms_syn = Bs$terms, trig = trig,
       eval_R = eR)
})
names(t3_e2e) <- names(t3_lev)
t3_et <- sapply(t3_e2e, function(z) c(B_synthetic = z$B_syn, syn_max_over_B = z$syn_over_B, aligned_over_B = z$worst,
  syn_route1x2 = z$terms_syn[1], syn_route2 = z$terms_syn[2], syn_route3 = z$terms_syn[3], syn_eval = z$terms_syn[4], syn_elem = z$terms_syn[5],
  cd_max = max(z$trig[, "cd"]), cd_median = median(z$trig[, "cd"]), exact_max = max(z$trig[, "exact"]),
  B_prod = max(z$trig[, "B"]), cd_over_B = max(z$trig[, "over_B"]), theta_cd_max = max(z$trig[, "th_cd"]),
  prod_route1x2 = max(z$trig[, "route1x2"]), prod_route2 = max(z$trig[, "route2"]),
  prod_route3 = max(z$trig[, "route3"]), prod_eval = max(z$trig[, "eval"]), prod_elem = max(z$trig[, "elem"]), sameK = all(z$trig[, "sameK"] == 1),
  exact_over_evalR = max(z$trig[, "exact"]) / z$eval_R, coupling = max(z$trig[, "cd"]) / max(z$trig[, "exact"])))
print(signif(t3_et, 3))
# P16's exact-Delta part (<= 1e-14) and its coupling part (> 10, intercepts) FAILED on the fourth run (kept;
# see the text); the assertions pin the recorded outcomes. D4 was set before the fifth run.
for (t3_z in t3_e2e) stopifnot(t3_z$syn_over_B <= 1, t3_z$worst >= 0.5, t3_z$worst <= 1,  # P15
  all(t3_z$trig[, "over_B"] <= 1), all(t3_z$trig[, "sameK"] == 1),                     # P16: inside B_T3
  max(t3_z$trig[, "exact"]) > 1e-14,                                                   # P16 as run: failed
  max(t3_z$trig[, "exact"]) <= t3_z$eval_R)                                            # D4
# P16's coupling ratio is reported, not asserted: it divides two rounding-floor residues and moves across
# machines (13.5 and 4.9 on 2026-10-15; 4.1 and 8.6 on 2026-10-19; the user's option (a), 2026-10-19).
```

```{r mg-t3-g1}
# G = 1 (P18): group 1 of dE alone, the single-group model sigma = (tau, R(lambda)), Omega = Gamma, nT = N - 1.
t3_g1 <- local({
  y <- paste0("y", 1:5); d1 <- dE[dE$g == 1, y]
  f1 <- suppressWarnings(cfa(paste("f =~", paste0("NA*", y, collapse = " + "), "\nf ~~ 1*f"), data = d1,
          ordered = y, estimator = "WLSMV", parameterization = "delta", std.lv = TRUE))
  stopifnot(lavInspect(f1, "converged"))
  s1 <- as.numeric(lavTech(f1, "wls.obs")[[1]]); Gm1 <- unname(as.matrix(lavTech(f1, "gamma")[[1]])); N1 <- nrow(d1)
  pl <- mg_pool(list(Gm1), list(diag(length(s1))[, 1:2]), list(1 / diag(Gm1)), N1)
  nT1 <- (N1 - 1); off <- function(u) { R <- tcrossprod(u); R[lower.tri(R)] }
  sig1 <- function(x) c(x[1:11], off(x[12:16]))
  x0 <- sv_gn(sig1, s1, rep(1, length(s1)), c(unlist(inv_tau(KE)), inv_lam))$x
  w1 <- 1 / diag(Gm1); th <- sv_tight(sig1, s1, w1, sv_gn(sig1, s1, w1, x0)$x)
  Dl <- sv_jac(sig1, th); v <- t3_at(sig1, th, Dl, Gm1, s = s1, nT = nT1)
  lavT3 <- unname(fitMeasures(f1, "chisq.scaled"))
  g <- t3_grad(sig1, th, Dl, Gm1, s = s1, nT = nT1); set.seed(11)
```
