### What this hands Module 6

Nothing to build. The 2026-09-23 decision stands. If it is ever reopened, the
table above is the implementation, needing only $L$ and $G$ ($p\times m$) and
then $O(p^2)$ per column. Budgets (A)–(C) are its tests: against a complex
step (not available in Mata), against production's central difference by
(B), and against `60_lavaan_modelimplied.R`'s Jacobian fixture. Until then,
what it hands the current code is a bound. Production's $\Delta$ error is
rounding only, on every row a v1 table can contain, so @sec-bread-rank's
noise bound needs no truncation term for $\beta$.

### Modules 5 and 6 under multiple groups: $\sigma_g(\theta)$ and $\Delta$ {#sec-mg-sigma-delta}

*Drafted by cloud task K (read-only, from `9466d13`); the drafter's own run (R 4.3.3, lavaan 0.6.17) is
not evidence. Executed by the main session from the repository file, 2026-10-09 (R 4.6.0, lavaan
0.7.2), after every earlier chunk in document order: every assertion held on the first run, with no
chunk changed; this section's prose and comments were brought up to the decisions of that day
(O3–O7, O9, O12, the Q-2 correction). Hypotheses and tolerances were fixed by the drafter before that
run; each tolerance says whether it was set before or after a measurement.*

*Preconditions.* O1 (no row for a ν, ω or α at its reference value) and Q-2 (ω multiplies the loading
at every level) are decided, 2026-10-09 (spec §4.8 G4; E-026). The absent-row default
is per type: ω 1, every other type 0. The stacked $s$ is group by group (spec §4.8 G6, MG1). The
pooled weighting and $T$ are @sec-multigroup-scaling's and are not touched. **O6** is decided the same day:
θ within the τ, λ, β and ψ blocks is ordered (group, row, col); `mg2_fidx()` implements it as `o6 = "a"`
and keeps the declined (row, col, group) as `o6 = "b"` only to show what the decision excludes.

This section is the derivation behind Modules 5 and 6 for $G$ groups. It states $\sigma_g(\theta)$ and
$\Delta=\partial s/\partial\theta'$ in closed form, shows that $G=1$ is the existing single-group pair
exactly, and checks both against four independent references: central differences, `inv_model`,
lavaan's implied moments, and lavaan's own Jacobian.

#### Notation

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $g=1..G$ | groups; group 1 the reference (ν = 0, ω = 1, α = 0; ψ fixed by the metric) |
| $p$, $m$ | indicators, factors; the same in every group (G1) |
| $C_{gj}=K_{gj}-1$, $T_g=\sum_jC_{gj}$, $P=\binom p2$, $D_g=T_g+P$ | per group; $K$ may differ between groups (G3) |
| $o_g=\sum_{h<g}D_h$ | offset of block $g$ in $s=(s_1',\dots,s_G')'$; derived, not stored |
| $\Lambda_g,B_g,\Psi_g$ | $p\times m$, $m\times m$, $m\times m$; an absent row is 0 |
| $\nu_g,\ \omega_g,\ \alpha_g$ | $p$, $p$, $m$ vectors; an absent row is 0, **1**, 0 (G4) |
| $A_g=(I-B_g)^{-1}$, $\Phi_g=A_g\Psi_gA_g'$ | derived |
| $\kappa_g=A_g\alpha_g$, $c_g=\Lambda_g\kappa_g$ | factor mean, and its image in the indicators; $\kappa_g=\alpha_g$ when $B_g=0$ |
| $L_g=\Lambda_gA_g$, $Q_g=\Lambda_g\Phi_g$, $V_g=\Lambda_g\Phi_g\Lambda_g'$ | $p\times m$, $p\times m$, $p\times p$ |
| $\Theta^\circ_g,\ \Theta^*_g$ | derived residual variances, unscaled and on the standardized scale (below) |

$\Theta^*_g$ is what `@sec-inv-check11` calls $\Theta_{g}$ (C11-1, $m_{gj}=\omega_{gj}$).

#### Result MS1: $\sigma_g(\theta)$

Let $y^\circ_g=\nu_g+\Lambda_g\eta_g+\varepsilon_g$ with $\eta_g=\alpha_g+B_g\eta_g+\zeta_g$, $\operatorname{Var}\zeta_g=\Psi_g$ and
$\Theta^\circ_g=\operatorname{Var}\varepsilon_g$ diagonal, the observed category being set by the unscaled
thresholds $\tau_{gjc}$. The data identify $y^\circ$ only through the standardized variable
$y^*=\Omega_g\,(y^\circ-\operatorname{E}y^\circ)$, $\Omega_g=\operatorname{diag}(\omega_g)$, whose thresholds are
$\omega_{gj}(\tau_{gjc}-\nu_{gj}-c_{gj})$ and whose variance is 1 (the delta convention, unchanged under
groups). Hence

$$
s_{gjc}\;\longrightarrow\;\sigma_{gjc}=\omega_{gj}\big(\tau_{gjc}-\nu_{gj}-(\Lambda_g\kappa_g)_j\big),\qquad
\rho_{g,ij}=\omega_{gi}\,\omega_{gj}\,(\Lambda_g\Phi_g\Lambda_g')_{ij}\ \ (i\ne j),
$$

$$
\Theta^\circ_{g,jj}=\omega_{gj}^{-2}-(V_g)_{jj},\qquad
\Theta^*_{g,jj}=\omega_{gj}^{2}\,\Theta^\circ_{g,jj}=1-\omega_{gj}^{2}\,(V_g)_{jj}\quad(\text{derived, never free}).
$$

The off-diagonal of $\Omega_g(\Lambda\Phi\Lambda'+\Theta^\circ)\Omega_g$ is $\omega_i\omega_jV_{ij}$ because $\Theta^\circ$ is
diagonal, and its diagonal is 1 by the choice of $\Theta^\circ$. $\sigma_g$ is ordered by group $g$'s own
index map (spec §4.2): thresholds by indicator then category, then the lower-triangle correlations
column-major; $\sigma=(\sigma_1',\dots,\sigma_G')'$.

- **Q-2 is this algebra, not an extra rule.** ω is the standardization, so it multiplies the loading in
  $\rho$ whatever the level; at a level where ω has no row it is 1 and drops out. Modules 5 and 6 need no
  level or tie information. Positivity of $\Theta^*_{g,jj}$ is admissibility (O15), not needed to evaluate
  $\sigma$ or $\Delta$.
- **A tied element is one θ value read by several rows.** $\sigma_g$ is evaluated from group $g$'s own rows,
  $v=Z\theta+v_{\text{fixed}}$ (below).
- **$G=1$.** ω = 1, ν = 0, α = 0 gives $\sigma=(\tau,\operatorname{vech}_{\rm off}(\Lambda\Phi\Lambda'))$, spec §4.6.

#### Result MS2: the columns of $\Delta$, row by row

Let $v$ be the $n_{\rm all}$ table-row values and $\partial\sigma/\partial v_r$ the column of row $r$ (group $g$;
nonzero only in block $g$). With $j\ne k$ throughout, $E_{ab}$ the unit matrix, and $c\in 1..C_{gj}$:

| Row $r$ of group $g$ | threshold entries $\partial\sigma_{gjc}/\partial v_r$ | correlation entries $\partial\rho_{g,jk}/\partial v_r$ |
|---|---|---|
| $\tau_{ic}$ | $\omega_{gi}$ at $(i,c)$; 0 elsewhere | 0 |
| $\nu_i$ | $-\omega_{gi}$ for $j=i$, all $c$; 0 elsewhere | 0 |
| $\alpha_f$ | $-\omega_{gj}\,(L_g)_{jf}$ | 0 |
| $\omega_i$ | $\sigma_{gic}/\omega_{gi}=\tau_{gic}-\nu_{gi}-c_{gi}$ for $j=i$; 0 elsewhere | $\omega_{gk}(V_g)_{ik}$ for the pairs $(i,k)$; 0 for pairs without $i$ |
| $\lambda_{mf}$ | $-\omega_{gm}\,\kappa_{gf}$ for $j=m$; 0 elsewhere | $\omega_{gj}\omega_{gk}\big([j{=}m](Q_g)_{kf}+[k{=}m](Q_g)_{jf}\big)$ |
| $\beta_{ab}$ (to $a$, from $b$) | $-\omega_{gj}\,\kappa_{gb}\,(L_g)_{ja}$ | $\omega_{gj}\omega_{gk}\big((L_g)_{ja}(Q_g)_{kb}+(Q_g)_{jb}(L_g)_{ka}\big)$ |
| $\psi_{ab}$, $a\ne b$ | 0 | $\omega_{gj}\omega_{gk}\big((L_g)_{ja}(L_g)_{kb}+(L_g)_{jb}(L_g)_{ka}\big)$ |
| $\psi_{aa}$ | 0 | $\omega_{gj}\omega_{gk}\,(L_g)_{ja}(L_g)_{ka}$ |

*Proof.* $c_g=\Lambda_gA_g\alpha_g$ gives $\partial c/\partial\alpha_f=L e_f$, $\partial c/\partial\lambda_{mf}=\kappa_fe_m$, and, with
$\partial A=AE_{ab}A$, $\partial\kappa=\kappa_b\,Ae_a$ so $\partial c/\partial\beta_{ab}=\kappa_b\,Le_a$. $V=\Lambda\Phi\Lambda'$
with $\partial\Phi=(Ae_a)(\Phi e_b)'+(\Phi e_b)(Ae_a)'$ for $\beta_{ab}$ and $A(E_{ab}+E_{ba})A'$, $AE_{aa}A'$ for $\psi$
(@sec-delta's table), and $\partial V/\partial\lambda_{mf}$ as there; ω enters $\rho_{ik}=\omega_i\omega_kV_{ik}$ and
$\sigma_{ic}=\omega_i(\cdot)$ linearly. $\square$

The rows of the $\psi$, $\beta$ and $\lambda$ lines are @sec-delta's, times the scale $\omega_{gj}\omega_{gk}$ on the
correlation entries, plus the threshold entries that appear once $\kappa_g\ne0$ or $\omega_g\ne1$. The same
formulas give the column of a **fixed** row (the Module 12 shape) and of a row that is absent at its
reference value (the formula needs the type and index, not a stored row; see *Open here*).

**Lemma MS2.1 (central differences are exact up to rounding).** Each entry of $\sigma$ is a polynomial of
degree at most 2 in any single table row, and degree 2 only in a $\beta$ row with no path $b\rightsquigarrow a$
(@sec-delta's lemma, Sherman–Morrison; $\kappa=A\alpha$ is affine in such a $\beta$). A tie moves one row
per group (G2) and $\sigma_g$ reads group $g$'s rows only, so a tied θ element also enters each entry
through a single row. So a central difference has no truncation error on any column.

#### Result MS3: stacking, ties, and the threshold rows

$$
\Delta=\begin{pmatrix}\Delta_1\\ \vdots\\ \Delta_G\end{pmatrix},\qquad
\Delta_{\cdot t}=\sum_{r\in\mathcal R_t}\frac{\partial\sigma}{\partial v_r},
$$

$\mathcal R_t$ being the rows with `fidx` $t$: one row for an untied element, one per member group for a tie.
$\Delta=(\partial\sigma/\partial v)\,Z$ with $Z$ the $n_{\rm free}\times n_{\rm par}$ 0/1 matrix of `fidx`: **ties are
shared columns, summed.** The rows of $\Delta$ are in the order of $s$ (group by group), its columns in
G6's θ order.

1. **Block structure.** A θ element untied across groups has nonzero entries in its own group's block only. With
   no tie, no ν, ω or α row, $\Delta$ is block diagonal across groups.
2. **Threshold entries.** $\partial\sigma_{gjc}/\partial\tau_{gjc}=\omega_{gj}$: a $\tau$ column has one nonzero
   per member group, $\omega_{gj}$ in group $g$'s row (1 when ω is absent), and zeros in every correlation row.
   A ν column is $-\omega_{gj}$ on item $j$'s threshold rows. An α column is $-\omega_{gj}(L_g)_{jf}$.
   A λ or β column has threshold entries $-\omega\kappa$ and is exactly zero there while $\alpha_g=0$.
3. **The configural invariant, as a selection.** With no tie and no ν, ω, α row, $\kappa_g=0$ and $\omega_g=1$
   exactly, so $\Delta$ restricted to the threshold rows and the τ columns is a 0/1 matrix with one 1 in each row
   and column, and the threshold rows meet every other column in exact zeros. The threshold rows are
   $1..T_1,\ D_1+1..D_1+T_2,\dots$ (G6), a selection. Under O6's decided order (group, row, col) the τ
   columns come group by group in the order of $s$, so that matrix is **the identity**, as spec §4.8 G6 and @sec-marker-recovery
   state; under the declined (row, col, group) it would be a permutation matrix. `mg2-structure` (a) asserts
   both, the second as the order that must fail.
4. **With ties, ν, ω or α rows** the restriction is no longer a square block: a tied τ column has a 1 in
   group 1's row and $\omega_{g}$ in each later member's; the extra columns put $-\omega$, $-\omega L$,
   $-\omega\kappa$ in the threshold rows. This is the 2026-10-08 scoping of the τ̂ = $s_\tau$ invariant, now with the
   entries written down.
5. **At Module 3's starts** (ω = 1, ν = 0, α = 0, hence κ = 0) the scale entries are exactly 1 and the λ columns'
   threshold entries exactly 0, so the threshold part of $\Delta$ is a 0/±1 matrix. Q-2 changes one thing here
   against `inv_model`: $\partial\rho_{ij}/\partial\omega_i=\omega_jV_{ij}\ne0$ at ω = 1 at the thresholds level,
   so the rank at the starts is re-measured (`mg2-start`, Result I5's exception included).

The Δ rank check runs once on the stacked table (G6). Nothing here changes `dwlsmv_numrank`.

#### Result MS4: $G=1$ is the current single-group $\sigma$ and $\Delta$

At $G=1$ the table has no ν, ω or α row, so ω = 1, ν = 0, κ = 0 by the absent-row default, and Result MS1
is $\sigma=(\tau,\operatorname{vech}_{\rm off}(\Lambda A\Psi A'\Lambda'))$ with $\Theta^*=I-\operatorname{diag}V$. Result MS2's table has
the rows $\tau$, $\lambda$, $\beta$, $\psi$ only, and with ω = 1 and κ = 0 it is @sec-delta's table entry for entry: the
$\tau$ entry is 1, the threshold entries of $\lambda$ and $\beta$ columns are $-1\cdot0\cdot(\cdot)=0$, the correlation
entries are multiplied by $\omega_j\omega_k=1$. The leading $T\times T$ block is the identity and the off-blocks are
exact zeros. `mg2-g1` asserts it against `dj_sigma` and `dj_delta` on all five `fits5`. Both routes evaluate
the same polynomial in the same association, so the gap is expected to be 0; the assertion is @sec-delta's budget (A)
(set before measuring).

#### Result MS5: what Q-2's parameters are

Q-2's θ is lavaan's parameter vector: τ (tied by label), λ, ψ, ν, the scaling factors δ as ω, and α. `inv_model`
(@sec-invariance-id) is a *reparameterization* of the same model at the thresholds level only: its `lam2` is the
standardized loading $u=\omega\lambda$ of a polytomous item. Hence:

- **H-S1.** $\sigma^{\rm Q2}(\theta)=\sigma^{\rm inv}(x)$ at every level with $\lambda=\texttt{lam2}/\omega$ for a polytomous
  item at the thresholds level and $\lambda=\texttt{lam}$ elsewhere; without the division it differs exactly at the
  thresholds level when an item is polytomous and ω ≠ 1. Same model, same rank and df (Result I4), different θ.
- **H-L1.** $\sigma^{\rm Q2}$ at lavaan's estimates, **taking lavaan's own loading as λ**, equals
  `lavInspect(fit, "implied")` in both groups at every level, thresholds level included.
- **H-L0** (the reading in task K's brief and the 2026-10-09 Q-2 row: "lavaan's loading is $\omega\lambda$ at
  the thresholds level"; that row is corrected). Under it $\lambda=\lambda_{\rm lavaan}/\omega$ would be needed
  there. **Refuted:** `mg2-lavaan` asserts H-L1 (gap ≤ 5.6e-16 at every design × level) and keeps H-L0's
  mapping as the negative control, which misses by 0.019–0.31 at the thresholds level wherever ω̂ ≠ 1.

#### Verification

| Chunk | Checks | Tolerance and label |
|---|---|---|
| `mg2-levels` | θ count = $D-\mathrm{df}$ (Result I4) at 5 designs × 4 levels; design E: 32, 29, 27, 23 and `nall` 34, 40 (spec G8) | exact |
| `mg2-sigma` | H-S1; Θ* > 0 at the generic point; explicit fixed reference rows change neither σ nor Δ (O1, G4); each group block is `dj_sigma`-shaped | 1e-12, set before measuring; negative-control floor 1e-3 = 1e9 × tol |
| `mg2-delta` | closed Δ vs `inv_jac` on design E, 4 levels × both O6 candidates; O6 only permutes columns; a two-factor, two-group table with every ptype, β and α with B ≠ 0 and λ ties across groups with different $K$; four wrong columns rejected | 1e-8, set before measuring (about three decades over the rounding of a central difference at h = 1e-5); mutants must exceed 1e3 × tol |
| `mg2-g1` | MS4 against `dj_sigma`, `dj_delta`, `fits5` | @sec-delta's budgets (A), set before measuring |
| `mg2-structure` | MS3 items 1–5, exact | exact (`identical`, `== 0`) |
| `mg2-start` | rank at Module 3's starts under Q-2, all 20 cells, and Result I5's exception | `INV_TOL` = 1e-7; ratios printed, never asserted |
| `mg2-lavaan` | H-L1, and H-L0 as negative control, G = 2, designs A–E × 4 levels | 1e-10 (accessor path read, not audited); floor 1e-3, **chosen after the drafter's scratch gaps** (0.019 to 0.31), about 20× below the smallest |
| `mg2-lavdelta` | every table row's column = lavaan's Δ column of the matching free parameter, before equality constraints | 1e-10, set before measuring |

**How far ω̂ must be from 1 for the negative control to bite.** At the thresholds level the gap of $\rho_{ij}$
between the mapped and the raw reading is $|\omega_i\omega_j-1|\,|\lambda_i\lambda_j|\,\phi$ (ω = 1 for a binary item), so
design A (all binary) has none, and any design with a polytomous item bites as soon as one polytomous ω̂ leaves 1.
With `inv_sim`'s group 2 the population $\omega_{2j}=(\lambda_j^2\cdot1.44+\theta_{2j})^{-1/2}$ is 1.043, 0.950, 0.875,
0.814, 0.762 for items 1–5, so the smallest case (design D, item 1 polytomous only) has $|\omega-1|\approx0.04$ and a
gap of order $10^{-2}$: eight decades over `MG2_TOL_IMP` and one over `MG2_FLOOR`. The chunk prints the realized $\max|\hat\omega-1|$ and
gap per design. No new data are needed, and nothing was constructed after seeing results.

```{r mg2-core}
# Depends on: nothing (base R). Every name defined here starts with mg2_ (mg_ is
# taken by @sec-multigroup-scaling).
mg2_block <- c(tau = 1L, lambda = 2L, beta = 3L, psi = 4L, nu = 5L, omega = 6L, alpha = 7L)  # G6: ptypes 4,1,3,2,5,6,7

# One table row. i, j in the type's directive order: lambda (indicator, factor), beta (to, from),
# psi (i >= j, lower triangle), tau (indicator, k), nu/omega (indicator, 1), alpha (factor, 1).
# tie: an integer class (rows of one class share a theta element) or NA.
mg2_row <- function(g, type, i, j = 1L, free = TRUE, val = 0, tie = NA_integer_)
  data.frame(g = g, type = type, i = i, j = j, free = free, val = val, tie = tie,
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# theta's index for every free row (G6). Blocks tau, lambda, beta, psi, nu, omega, alpha.
# Within nu, omega, alpha: (group, row), decided 2026-10-08. Within tau, lambda, beta, psi the
# order across groups is O6, decided 2026-10-09: o6 = "a", (group, row, col). o6 = "b",
# (row, col, group), is kept as the declined order, which mg2-structure shows is not the identity.
# A tie takes the index of its first member in that order.
mg2_fidx <- function(rows, o6 = c("a", "b")) {
  o6 <- match.arg(o6); fr <- which(rows$free)
  blk <- mg2_block[rows$type[fr]]; gg <- rows$g[fr]; ri <- rows$i[fr]; cj <- rows$j[fr]
  grpfirst <- blk >= 5L | o6 == "a"
  ord <- order(blk, ifelse(grpfirst, gg, ri), ifelse(grpfirst, ri, cj), ifelse(grpfirst, cj, gg))
  f <- rep(NA_integer_, nrow(rows)); nxt <- 0L; seen <- list()
  for (r in fr[ord]) {
    tk <- as.character(rows$tie[r])
    if (!is.na(rows$tie[r]) && !is.null(seen[[tk]])) { f[r] <- seen[[tk]]; next }
    nxt <- nxt + 1L; f[r] <- nxt
    if (!is.na(rows$tie[r])) seen[[tk]] <- nxt
  }
  f
}

# K: list of G category-count vectors (one per group); m: number of factors.
mg2_table <- function(K, m, rows, o6 = "a") {
  rows$fidx <- mg2_fidx(rows, o6)
  list(G = length(K), K = K, p = length(K[[1]]), m = m, rows = rows,
       npar = max(0L, rows$fidx, na.rm = TRUE), nall = nrow(rows))
}
mg2_tpos <- function(Kg, j, k) sum((Kg - 1L)[seq_len(j - 1L)]) + k       # Section 4.2: pos(tau_jk)
mg2_Dg   <- function(tab) vapply(tab$K, function(k) sum(k - 1L) + choose(tab$p, 2), 1)
mg2_off  <- function(tab) c(0, cumsum(mg2_Dg(tab)))[seq_len(tab$G)]       # offsets of the group blocks in s

# Current values of every matrix, by group. An absent row reads through the per-type default
# (G4): omega 1, every other type 0.
mg2_pars <- function(tab, theta) {
  p <- tab$p; m <- tab$m
  P <- lapply(seq_len(tab$G), function(g) list(
    tau = numeric(sum(tab$K[[g]] - 1L)), Lam = matrix(0, p, m), B = matrix(0, m, m),
    Psi = matrix(0, m, m), nu = numeric(p), om = rep(1, p), al = numeric(m)))
  R <- tab$rows
  for (r in seq_len(nrow(R))) {
    v <- if (R$free[r]) theta[R$fidx[r]] else R$val[r]
    g <- R$g[r]; i <- R$i[r]; j <- R$j[r]
    switch(R$type[r],
      tau    = { P[[g]]$tau[mg2_tpos(tab$K[[g]], i, j)] <- v },
      lambda = { P[[g]]$Lam[i, j] <- v },
      beta   = { P[[g]]$B[i, j] <- v },
      psi    = { P[[g]]$Psi[i, j] <- v; P[[g]]$Psi[j, i] <- v },
      nu     = { P[[g]]$nu[i] <- v },
      omega  = { P[[g]]$om[i] <- v },
      alpha  = { P[[g]]$al[i] <- v },
      stop("unknown row type"))
  }
  P
}

# sigma_g (Q-2): s_gjc = om_j (tau_jc - nu_j - (Lam kappa)_j),  rho_ij = om_i om_j (Lam Phi Lam')_ij,
# kappa = (I-B)^-1 alpha, Phi = (I-B)^-1 Psi (I-B)^-T. Theta is never formed (derived).
mg2_sigma_g <- function(Pg, Kg) {
  m <- ncol(Pg$Lam); A <- solve(diag(m) - Pg$B)
  S  <- Pg$Lam %*% A %*% Pg$Psi %*% t(A) %*% t(Pg$Lam)                 # Lam Phi Lam'
  cc <- drop(Pg$Lam %*% (A %*% Pg$al))                                  # Lam kappa
  itm <- rep(seq_along(Kg), Kg - 1L)
  R <- tcrossprod(Pg$om) * S
  c(Pg$om[itm] * (Pg$tau - Pg$nu[itm] - cc[itm]), R[lower.tri(R)])
}
mg2_sigma <- function(tab, theta) {
  P <- mg2_pars(tab, theta)
  unlist(lapply(seq_len(tab$G), function(g) mg2_sigma_g(P[[g]], tab$K[[g]])))
}
# Theta*_g,jj = 1 - om_j^2 (Lam Phi Lam')_jj: the derived residual variance on the standardized scale
# (C11-1's Theta_gjj). Its positivity is admissibility (O15), not needed for sigma or Delta.
mg2_thetastar <- function(tab, theta) {
  P <- mg2_pars(tab, theta)
  lapply(P, function(Pg) { A <- solve(diag(tab$m) - Pg$B)
    1 - Pg$om^2 * diag(Pg$Lam %*% A %*% Pg$Psi %*% t(A) %*% t(Pg$Lam)) })
}

# d sigma_g / d (one table row's value): a vector of length D_g. The closed forms of the section.
mg2_dcol_g <- function(Pg, Kg, type, i, j) {
  p <- nrow(Pg$Lam); m <- ncol(Pg$Lam); A <- solve(diag(m) - Pg$B)
  Lm <- Pg$Lam %*% A                                   # L = Lam A
  Qm <- Pg$Lam %*% (A %*% Pg$Psi %*% t(A))             # Q = Lam Phi
  S  <- Qm %*% t(Pg$Lam)                               # Lam Phi Lam'
  kap <- drop(A %*% Pg$al); cc <- drop(Pg$Lam %*% kap); om <- Pg$om
  Tn <- sum(Kg - 1L); itm <- rep(seq_len(p), Kg - 1L); lt <- lower.tri(diag(p))
  dth <- numeric(Tn); dS <- NULL; dR <- NULL
  switch(type,
    tau    = { dth[mg2_tpos(Kg, i, j)] <- om[i] },
    nu     = { dth[itm == i] <- -om[i] },
    alpha  = { dth <- -om[itm] * Lm[itm, i] },
    omega  = { dth[itm == i] <- (Pg$tau - Pg$nu[itm] - cc[itm])[itm == i]
               dR <- matrix(0, p, p); dR[i, ] <- om * S[i, ]; dR[, i] <- om * S[, i] },
    lambda = { dth[itm == i] <- -om[i] * kap[j]
               dS <- matrix(0, p, p); dS[i, ] <- Qm[, j]; dS[, i] <- dS[, i] + Qm[, j] },
    beta   = { dth <- -om[itm] * kap[j] * Lm[itm, i]
               dS <- tcrossprod(Lm[, i], Qm[, j]) + tcrossprod(Qm[, j], Lm[, i]) },
    psi    = { dS <- if (i == j) tcrossprod(Lm[, i])
                     else tcrossprod(Lm[, i], Lm[, j]) + tcrossprod(Lm[, j], Lm[, i]) },
    stop("unknown row type"))
  if (is.null(dR)) dR <- if (is.null(dS)) matrix(0, p, p) else tcrossprod(om) * dS
  c(dth, dR[lt])
}
# One column per TABLE ROW, free or fixed (the Module 12 shape), D x length(rowidx).
mg2_dcols <- function(tab, theta, rowidx = which(tab$rows$free)) {
  P <- mg2_pars(tab, theta); Dg <- mg2_Dg(tab); off <- mg2_off(tab); Dt <- sum(Dg)
  do.call(cbind, lapply(rowidx, function(r) { R <- tab$rows[r, ]; col <- numeric(Dt)
    col[off[R$g] + seq_len(Dg[R$g])] <- mg2_dcol_g(P[[R$g]], tab$K[[R$g]], R$type, R$i, R$j); col }))
}
# Delta = (row columns) Z: the columns of rows sharing a theta index are summed.
mg2_delta <- function(tab, theta) {
  fr <- which(tab$rows$free); cols <- mg2_dcols(tab, theta, fr)
  Dl <- matrix(0, nrow(cols), tab$npar)
  for (k in seq_along(fr)) { f <- tab$rows$fidx[fr[k]]; Dl[, f] <- Dl[, f] + cols[, k] }
  Dl
}
# Threshold rows of the stacked s, and the theta columns of the tau rows.
mg2_thr_rows <- function(tab) { off <- mg2_off(tab)
  unlist(lapply(seq_len(tab$G), function(g) off[g] + seq_len(sum(tab$K[[g]] - 1L)))) }
mg2_tau_cols <- function(tab) sort(unique(tab$rows$fidx[tab$rows$type == "tau" & tab$rows$free]))
```

```{r mg2-levels}
# Depends on: inv-setup (inv_*), mg2-core.
# A table is the R image of dwlsmv_parmap: one row per table row, free or fixed. An absent row is
# read through the per-type default (G4). `tie` is the class a shared theta index comes from.

# G8's emission for one factor, G = 2 (@sec-invariance-id's level table), as a table.
mg2_level_table <- function(K, level, o6 = "a") {
  p <- length(K); C <- K - 1L; poly <- K > 2L
  tied_tau <- level != "configural"; tied_lam <- level %in% c("loadings", "intercepts")
  tid <- function(j, k) 1000L * j + k; lid <- function(j) 90000L + j
  rw <- list(); add <- function(x) rw[[length(rw) + 1L]] <<- x
  for (g in 1:2) {
    for (j in seq_len(p)) for (k in seq_len(C[j]))
      add(mg2_row(g, "tau", j, k, tie = if (tied_tau) tid(j, k) else NA_integer_))
    for (j in seq_len(p))
      add(mg2_row(g, "lambda", j, 1L, tie = if (tied_lam) lid(j) else NA_integer_))
    if (g == 1L) add(mg2_row(1L, "psi", 1L, 1L, free = FALSE, val = 1))
    else {
      pfree <- level == "intercepts" || (level == "loadings" && any(poly))
      add(mg2_row(2L, "psi", 1L, 1L, free = pfree, val = 1))
      if (level %in% c("thresholds", "loadings"))
        for (j in seq_len(p)) add(mg2_row(2L, "nu", j))
      om_j <- switch(level, configural = integer(0), thresholds = which(poly), seq_len(p))
      for (j in om_j) add(mg2_row(2L, "omega", j))          # O1: no row for an omega that stays at 1
      if (level == "intercepts") add(mg2_row(2L, "alpha", 1L))
    }
  }
  mg2_table(list(K, K), 1L, do.call(rbind, rw), o6)
}

# The same table with every absent nu, omega, alpha of a later group written as a fixed row at its
# reference value (the option O1 declined): same sigma, same Delta, by the absent-row default.
mg2_explicit <- function(tab) {
  R <- tab$rows; add <- list()
  for (g in 2:tab$G) {
    for (ty in c("nu", "omega")) for (j in seq_len(tab$p))
      if (!any(R$g == g & R$type == ty & R$i == j))
        add[[length(add) + 1L]] <- mg2_row(g, ty, j, 1L, free = FALSE, val = if (ty == "omega") 1 else 0)
    for (f in seq_len(tab$m))
      if (!any(R$g == g & R$type == "alpha" & R$i == f))
        add[[length(add) + 1L]] <- mg2_row(g, "alpha", f, 1L, free = FALSE, val = 0)
  }
  R2 <- rbind(R[, names(R) != "fidx"], do.call(rbind, add))
  mg2_table(tab$K, tab$m, R2, "a")
}

# A generic point (deterministic; Theta* > 0 in both groups, which the sigma chunk prints).
mg2_point <- function(tab, tauK = inv_tau(tab$K[[1]]), lam = inv_lam) {
  R <- tab$rows; th <- numeric(tab$npar); p <- tab$p
  for (r in which(R$free)) {
    g <- if (is.na(R$tie[r])) R$g[r] else 1L            # a tied row takes group 1's value
    th[R$fidx[r]] <- switch(R$type[r],
      tau = tauK[[R$i[r]]][R$j[r]] + if (g == 2L) .05 else 0,
      lambda = lam[R$i[r]] + if (g == 2L) .05 else 0,
      psi = 1.2, nu = seq(-.2, .2, length.out = p)[R$i[r]],
      omega = seq(.85, 1.1, length.out = p)[R$i[r]], alpha = .35)
  }
  th
}
# Module 3's starts: lambda .7, psi 1, nu 0, omega 1, alpha 0, tau at the (population) thresholds,
# a tied tau at group 1's sample threshold (O5, decided 2026-10-09).
mg2_start <- function(tab, tauK) {
  R <- tab$rows; th <- numeric(tab$npar)
  for (r in which(R$free)) {
    g <- if (is.na(R$tie[r])) R$g[r] else 1L
    th[R$fidx[r]] <- switch(R$type[r], tau = tauK[[R$i[r]]][R$j[r]] + if (g == 2L) .05 else 0,
                            lambda = .7, psi = 1, nu = 0, omega = 1, alpha = 0)
  }
  th
}
# inv_model's x (its layout) -> theta of the Q-2 table. At the thresholds level inv_model's lam2 is
# the standardized loading u = omega * lambda of a polytomous item, so Q-2's lambda is lam2 / omega
# (map = TRUE). map = FALSE passes lam2 through: the negative control.
mg2_from_inv <- function(tab, K, level, x, map = TRUE) {
  m <- inv_model(K, level); z <- split(x, rep(names(m$lay), m$lay)); poly <- K > 2L
  R <- tab$rows; th <- rep(NA_real_, tab$npar)
  for (r in which(R$free)) {
    g <- R$g[r]; i <- R$i[r]; j <- R$j[r]
    pos <- sum((K - 1L)[seq_len(i - 1L)]) + j
    v <- switch(R$type[r],
      tau = if (g == 1L || level != "configural") z$tau[pos] else z$tau2[pos],
      lambda = if (g == 1L) z$lam[i] else switch(level, configural = z$lam2[i],
                 thresholds = if (map && poly[i]) z$lam2[i] / z$om[cumsum(poly)[i]] else z$lam2[i],
                 z$lam[i]),
      psi = z$phi, nu = z$nu[i],
      omega = if (level == "thresholds") z$om[cumsum(poly)[i]] else z$om[i],
      alpha = z$kap)
    f <- R$fidx[r]
    if (!is.na(th[f]) && abs(th[f] - v) > 1e-14) stop("tied rows disagree at theta ", f)
    th[f] <- v
  }
  th
}

# ---- bookkeeping: theta and nall against the spec and Result I4 ---------------------------------
for (nm in names(inv_designs)) for (l in inv_levels) {
  K <- inv_designs[[nm]]; tab <- mg2_level_table(K, l); D <- sum(mg2_Dg(tab))
  stopifnot(tab$npar == D - inv_df(K, l))            # npar = D - df, Result I4; rank is checked below
}
KE <- inv_designs$E
stopifnot(sapply(inv_levels, function(l) mg2_level_table(KE, l)$npar) == c(32, 29, 27, 23),   # spec G8's counts
          mg2_level_table(KE, "configural")$nall == 34, mg2_level_table(KE, "intercepts")$nall == 40)
```

```{r mg2-sigma}
# Depends on: mg2-core, mg2-levels.
# (1) Q-2's sigma against inv_model's, which carries the same model at the standardized loading u
# (@sec-invariance-id). Exact algebra, entries O(1): tolerance 1e-12, set before measuring.
MG2_TOL_ALG <- 1e-12
mg2_sig_gap <- sapply(names(inv_designs), function(nm) sapply(inv_levels, function(l) {
  K <- inv_designs[[nm]]; tab <- mg2_level_table(K, l); m <- inv_model(K, l)
  x <- inv_point(m, inv_tau(K), inv_lam)
  c(mapped   = max(abs(mg2_sigma(tab, mg2_from_inv(tab, K, l, x))        - m$sigma(x))),
    unmapped = max(abs(mg2_sigma(tab, mg2_from_inv(tab, K, l, x, FALSE)) - m$sigma(x))))
}), simplify = FALSE)
for (nm in names(inv_designs)) for (l in inv_levels) {
  gp <- mg2_sig_gap[[nm]][, l]
  stopifnot(gp[["mapped"]] < MG2_TOL_ALG)                           # Q-2 = inv_model, after lambda = lam2 / omega
  # unmapped differs exactly where omega is free AND the item is polytomous: thresholds level, K > 2
  K <- inv_designs[[nm]]
  if (l == "thresholds" && any(K > 2L)) stopifnot(gp[["unmapped"]] > 1e-3)        # negative control (floor: 1e3 x tol)
  else stopifnot(gp[["unmapped"]] < MG2_TOL_ALG)
}
# (2) Theta* > 0 at the generic point, both groups (admissibility is O15; here it only shows the point is legal)
for (nm in names(inv_designs)) for (l in inv_levels) {
  K <- inv_designs[[nm]]; tab <- mg2_level_table(K, l)
  stopifnot(all(unlist(mg2_thetastar(tab, mg2_point(tab))) > 0))
}
# (3) An absent row is read through the per-type default (G4): writing every reference-valued nu,
# omega, alpha as a fixed row changes neither sigma nor Delta (O1).
for (nm in names(inv_designs)) for (l in inv_levels) {
  K <- inv_designs[[nm]]; tab <- mg2_level_table(K, l); te <- mg2_explicit(tab); th <- mg2_point(tab)
  stopifnot(te$nall >= tab$nall, te$npar == tab$npar,
            identical(mg2_sigma(te, th), mg2_sigma(tab, th)),
            identical(mg2_delta(te, th), mg2_delta(tab, th)))
}
# (4) sigma_g has the single-group form when the later-group parameters sit at their references
# (the G = 1 reduction proper is mg2-g1; this is its within-table counterpart): a two-group
# configural table's group blocks are each dj_sigma-shaped.
local({
  K <- inv_designs$E; tab <- mg2_level_table(K, "configural"); th <- mg2_point(tab); P <- mg2_pars(tab, th)
  s <- mg2_sigma(tab, th); o <- mg2_off(tab); Dg <- mg2_Dg(tab)
  for (g in 1:2) {
    M <- list(Lam = P[[g]]$Lam, B = P[[g]]$B, Psi = P[[g]]$Psi, tau = P[[g]]$tau)
    stopifnot(identical(s[o[g] + seq_len(Dg[g])], dj_sigma(M)))
  }
})
```

```{r mg2-delta}
# Depends on: mg2-core, mg2-levels, inv-setup (inv_jac, inv_rank).
# (1) Closed-form Delta against inv_jac's central differences on design E at all four levels, under
# both theta orders (O6 decided "a"; "b" only shows that the order permutes columns). sigma is at most quadratic in each
# single table row (lambda, psi, nu, alpha, omega, tau linear; beta quadratic when no path closes a
# cycle), a tie has one member per group (G2), so a central difference has rounding error only and
# 1e-8 is about three decades above its expected size at h = 1e-5 (set before measuring).
MG2_TOL_FD <- 1e-8
KE <- inv_designs$E
for (o6 in c("a", "b")) for (l in inv_levels) {
  tab <- mg2_level_table(KE, l, o6); th <- mg2_point(tab)
  Dl <- mg2_delta(tab, th); J <- inv_jac(function(t) mg2_sigma(tab, t), th)
  stopifnot(dim(Dl) == c(42, tab$npar), max(abs(Dl - J)) < MG2_TOL_FD, inv_rank(Dl) == tab$npar)
}
# (2) O6 only permutes columns. Same row values under both orders: sigma identical, Delta equal up
# to the column permutation.
for (l in inv_levels) {
  ta <- mg2_level_table(KE, l, "a"); tb <- mg2_level_table(KE, l, "b"); tha <- mg2_point(ta)
  thb <- numeric(tb$npar); perm <- integer(tb$npar)
  for (r in which(ta$rows$free)) { thb[tb$rows$fidx[r]] <- tha[ta$rows$fidx[r]]; perm[tb$rows$fidx[r]] <- ta$rows$fidx[r] }
  stopifnot(identical(mg2_sigma(ta, tha), mg2_sigma(tb, thb)),
            max(abs(mg2_delta(tb, thb) - mg2_delta(ta, tha)[, perm])) == 0)
}
# (3) Rows the one-factor designs do not reach: beta and alpha with B != 0, every ptype free, ties
# across groups whose category counts differ (a tau tie would be refused by G3; lambda ties are not).
# 0.3.0 refuses beta beside nu/omega/alpha/tie (G5, O2): this tests the formulas, not the grammar.
mg2_struct_table <- function() {
  Kl <- list(rep(3L, 6), c(3L, 3L, 4L, 3L, 3L, 3L)); rw <- list(); add <- function(x) rw[[length(rw) + 1L]] <<- x
  for (g in 1:2) {
    for (j in 1:6) for (k in seq_len(Kl[[g]][j] - 1L)) add(mg2_row(g, "tau", j, k))
    for (j in 1:3) add(mg2_row(g, "lambda", j, 1L, tie = if (j == 2) 7L else NA_integer_))
    for (j in 4:6) add(mg2_row(g, "lambda", j, 2L, tie = if (j == 5) 8L else NA_integer_))
    add(mg2_row(g, "beta", 2L, 1L)); add(mg2_row(g, "psi", 1L, 1L, free = g == 2L, val = 1))
    add(mg2_row(g, "psi", 2L, 2L)); add(mg2_row(g, "psi", 2L, 1L, free = FALSE, val = 0))
    if (g == 2L) {
      for (j in 1:6) { add(mg2_row(2L, "nu", j)); add(mg2_row(2L, "omega", j)) }
      add(mg2_row(2L, "alpha", 1L)); add(mg2_row(2L, "alpha", 2L))
    }
  }
  mg2_table(Kl, 2L, do.call(rbind, rw), "a")
}
tabS <- mg2_struct_table(); R <- tabS$rows; thS <- numeric(tabS$npar)
for (r in which(R$free)) thS[R$fidx[r]] <- switch(R$type[r],
  tau = (R$j[r] - 1.5) * .8 + .1 * R$i[r], lambda = .5 + .05 * R$i[r], beta = .4, psi = 1,
  nu = (R$i[r] - 3.5) / 20, omega = .85 + .04 * R$i[r], alpha = .15 * R$i[r] - .2)
DlS <- mg2_delta(tabS, thS); JS <- inv_jac(function(t) mg2_sigma(tabS, t), thS)
stopifnot(all(c("alpha", "beta", "lambda", "nu", "omega", "psi", "tau") %in% R$type[R$free]),
          max(abs(DlS - JS)) < MG2_TOL_FD)
# (4) Negative controls: four wrong columns the tolerance must reject (floor 1e3 x MG2_TOL_FD).
o2 <- mg2_off(tabS)[2]; T2 <- sum(tabS$K[[2]] - 1L); col <- function(ty) unique(R$fidx[R$free & R$type == ty & R$g == 2L])
mut <- list(
  omega_thresholds_only = function(D) { D[o2 + T2 + seq_len(15), col("omega")] <- 0; D },   # omega not multiplying rho (inv_model's thresholds reading)
  nu_sign               = function(D) { D[, col("nu")] <- -D[, col("nu")]; D },
  alpha_thresholds_zero = function(D) { D[o2 + seq_len(T2), col("alpha")] <- 0; D },
  beta_thresholds_zero  = function(D) { D[o2 + seq_len(T2), col("beta")] <- 0; D })
mutgap <- sapply(mut, function(f) max(abs(f(DlS) - JS)))
print(signif(mutgap, 3))
stopifnot(mutgap > 1e3 * MG2_TOL_FD)
```

```{r mg2-g1}
# Depends on: mg2-core, delta-core (dj_*), m9-lavaan (fits5).
# The G = 1 reduction (Result MS4): a one-group table with no nu, omega or alpha row is the
# current single-group sigma and Delta. A lavaan fit's matrices become a table (every free or nonzero
# lambda, beta, psi entry a row, the rest absent); theta is in Section 4.8's order.
mg2_g1_table <- function(fit) {
  M <- dj_mats(fit); lr <- dj_rows_lavaan(fit); p <- nrow(M$Lam); m <- ncol(M$Lam)
  ov <- lavNames(fit, "ov"); rn <- rownames(lavInspect(fit, "est")$tau)
  K <- as.integer(table(factor(sub("\\|t[0-9]+$", "", rn), levels = ov))) + 1L
  key <- function(ty, i, j) paste(ty, i, j)
  freek <- vapply(lr$rows, function(r) key(r$type, r$i, r$j), "")
  rw <- list(); add <- function(x) rw[[length(rw) + 1L]] <<- x
  for (j in seq_len(p)) for (k in seq_len(K[j] - 1L)) add(mg2_row(1L, "tau", j, k))
  for (ty in c("lambda", "beta", "psi")) {
    Mx <- switch(ty, lambda = M$Lam, beta = M$B, psi = M$Psi)
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(Mx))) for (j in seq_len(ncol(Mx))) {
      if (ty == "psi" && j > i) next
      fr <- key(ty, i, j) %in% freek
      if (fr || Mx[i, j] != 0) add(mg2_row(1L, ty, i, j, free = fr, val = Mx[i, j]))
    }
  }
  tab <- mg2_table(list(K), m, do.call(rbind, rw), "a")
  th <- numeric(tab$npar); R <- tab$rows
  for (r in which(R$free)) th[R$fidx[r]] <- switch(R$type[r],
    tau = M$tau[mg2_tpos(K, R$i[r], R$j[r])], lambda = M$Lam[R$i[r], R$j[r]],
    beta = M$B[R$i[r], R$j[r]], psi = M$Psi[R$i[r], R$j[r]])
  list(tab = tab, theta = th, M = M, rows = lr$rows)
}
mg2_g1_out <- t(sapply(names(fits5), function(tag) {
  o <- mg2_g1_table(fits5[[tag]]); m <- ncol(o$M$Lam); ord <- dj_theta_order(o$rows)
  sg <- mg2_sigma(o$tab, o$theta); sr <- dj_sigma(o$M)
  Dn <- mg2_delta(o$tab, o$theta); Dr <- dj_delta(o$M, o$rows)[, ord]
  S  <- dj_delta(o$M, o$rows, absval = TRUE)[, ord]; Ts <- length(o$M$tau)
  stopifnot(o$tab$npar == length(o$rows), identical(Dn[1:Ts, 1:Ts], diag(Ts)))   # G = 1: the leading block is the identity
  # Both routes evaluate the same polynomial in the same association and omega = 1 multiplies exactly,
  # so the gap is expected to be 0 (printed). The assertion is budget (A) of @sec-delta, set before measuring.
  c(npar = o$tab$npar, sigma_gap = max(abs(sg - sr)),
    sigma_bitwise = identical(sg, sr),
    sigma_ratio = dj_rat(abs(sg - sr), dj_gam(4 * m) * dj_sigma_abs(o$M)),
    delta_gap = max(abs(Dn - Dr)), delta_bitwise = identical(unname(Dn), unname(Dr)),
    delta_ratio = dj_rat(abs(Dn - Dr), dj_tol_cs(m, S)))
}))
print(signif(mg2_g1_out, 3))
stopifnot(mg2_g1_out[, "sigma_ratio"] <= 1, mg2_g1_out[, "delta_ratio"] <= 1)
```

```{r mg2-structure}
# Depends on: mg2-core, mg2-levels.
# Result MS3. The threshold rows of the stacked s are the selection 1..T_1, D_1+1..D_1+T_2 (G6).
KE <- inv_designs$E
# (a) configural, design E: Delta restricted to the threshold rows and the tau columns is the
# identity under O6 (decided: "a", group-major) and a permutation matrix under "b", which must fail; the threshold
# rows meet every other column in exact zeros (kappa = 0 exactly, so -omega * kappa is -0), and the
# tau columns meet every correlation row in exact zeros.
for (o6 in c("a", "b")) {
  tab <- mg2_level_table(KE, "configural", o6); D0 <- mg2_delta(tab, mg2_start(tab, inv_tau(KE)))
  tr <- mg2_thr_rows(tab); tc <- mg2_tau_cols(tab); X <- D0[tr, tc]
  stopifnot(length(tr) == 22, length(tc) == 22, all(X %in% c(0, 1)), all(rowSums(X) == 1), all(colSums(X) == 1),
            all(D0[tr, setdiff(seq_len(ncol(D0)), tc)] == 0), all(D0[-tr, tc] == 0))
  if (o6 == "a") stopifnot(identical(X, diag(22)), identical(tr, c(1:11, 21 + 1:11)))
  else stopifnot(!identical(X, diag(22)))
}
# (b) disconnected groups (no tie, no nu, omega, alpha row): Delta is block diagonal across groups
tab <- mg2_level_table(KE, "configural", "a"); Dc <- mg2_delta(tab, mg2_point(tab)); Dg <- mg2_Dg(tab)
c1 <- unique(tab$rows$fidx[tab$rows$free & tab$rows$g == 1L]); c2 <- unique(tab$rows$fidx[tab$rows$free & tab$rows$g == 2L])
stopifnot(all(Dc[Dg[1] + seq_len(Dg[2]), c1] == 0), all(Dc[seq_len(Dg[1]), c2] == 0))

# (c) what ties, nu, omega and alpha put into the threshold rows. Entries are read off the closed
# forms at the generic point: tied tau: 1 in group 1's row and omega_2j in group 2's; nu_2j: -omega_2j on
# item j's group-2 thresholds; alpha: -omega_2j L_2j (L = Lambda for B = 0); lambda_2m: -omega_2m kappa_2.
for (l in c("thresholds", "loadings", "intercepts")) {
  tab <- mg2_level_table(KE, l, "a"); th <- mg2_point(tab); D <- mg2_delta(tab, th); P <- mg2_pars(tab, th)
  o <- mg2_off(tab); R <- tab$rows; Tn <- sum(KE - 1L); thr <- mg2_thr_rows(tab)
  rowT <- function(g, j, k) o[g] + mg2_tpos(KE, j, k)
  for (j in seq_along(KE)) for (k in seq_len(KE[j] - 1L)) {
    f <- R$fidx[R$g == 1L & R$type == "tau" & R$i == j & R$j == k]
    col <- D[, f]; want <- numeric(nrow(D)); want[rowT(1L, j, k)] <- 1; want[rowT(2L, j, k)] <- P[[2]]$om[j]
    stopifnot(identical(col, want))                         # a selection with scale entries; zero in every correlation row
  }
  for (j in R$i[R$g == 2L & R$type == "nu"]) {
    f <- R$fidx[R$g == 2L & R$type == "nu" & R$i == j]; want <- numeric(nrow(D))
    want[rowT(2L, j, 1L) - 1L + seq_len(KE[j] - 1L)] <- -P[[2]]$om[j]
    stopifnot(identical(D[, f], want))
  }
  if (l == "intercepts") {
    f <- R$fidx[R$type == "alpha"]; want <- numeric(nrow(D))
    for (j in seq_along(KE)) want[rowT(2L, j, 1L) - 1L + seq_len(KE[j] - 1L)] <- -P[[2]]$om[j] * P[[2]]$Lam[j, 1]
    stopifnot(max(abs(D[, f] - want)) == 0)
    for (m in seq_along(KE)) {                             # the tied lambda column's threshold entries: group 1 none (kappa_1 = 0)
      f <- R$fidx[R$g == 1L & R$type == "lambda" & R$i == m]; k2 <- rowT(2L, m, 1L) - 1L + seq_len(KE[m] - 1L)
      stopifnot(all(D[rowT(1L, m, 1L) - 1L + seq_len(KE[m] - 1L), f] == 0),
                all(D[k2, f] == -P[[2]]$om[m] * P[[2]]$al[1]))
    }
  }
  stopifnot(!identical(D[thr, mg2_tau_cols(tab)], diag(2 * Tn)[, mg2_tau_cols(tab)]))   # no longer the identity selection
}
# (d) at Module 3's starts (omega 1, nu 0, alpha 0) the scale entries are exactly 1 and the lambda
# columns' threshold entries exactly 0, so the threshold part of Delta is a 0/+-1 matrix.
for (l in c("thresholds", "loadings", "intercepts")) {
  tab <- mg2_level_table(KE, l, "a"); D0 <- mg2_delta(tab, mg2_start(tab, inv_tau(KE))); tr <- mg2_thr_rows(tab)
  tc <- mg2_tau_cols(tab); X <- D0[tr, tc]
  stopifnot(all(X %in% c(0, 1)), all(colSums(X) == 2), all(rowSums(X) == 1),   # each tied tau: one 1 per group
            all(D0[tr, tab$rows$fidx[tab$rows$free & tab$rows$type == "lambda"]] == 0))
}
```

```{r mg2-start}
# Depends on: mg2-core, mg2-levels, inv-setup.
# Q-2 changes sigma's dependence on omega at the thresholds level (d rho / d omega = omega_i V_ij is
# not 0 at omega = 1), so Module 3's rank check at the starting values is re-run under it, as
# `inv-start` did for inv_model. Prediction (Result I5 and `inv-start`; stated before this chunk is
# run): full rank at every design x level, and the one exception of Result I5.
mg2_ratio <- function(M) { s <- svd(M, nu = 0, nv = 0)$d; min(s) / max(s) }
for (nm in names(inv_designs)) for (l in inv_levels) {
  K <- inv_designs[[nm]]; tab <- mg2_level_table(K, l)
  D0 <- mg2_delta(tab, mg2_start(tab, inv_tau(K))); Dg <- mg2_delta(tab, mg2_point(tab))
  cat(sprintf("Q-2 start rank %s %-10s %2d of %2d, sv ratio %.3g (generic point %.3g)\n", nm, l,
              inv_rank(D0), tab$npar, mg2_ratio(D0), mg2_ratio(Dg)))          # printed, never asserted
  stopifnot(inv_rank(D0) == tab$npar, inv_rank(Dg) == tab$npar)
}
tabA <- mg2_level_table(inv_designs$A, "intercepts"); x0 <- mg2_start(tabA, as.list(rep(0, 5)))
stopifnot(inv_rank(mg2_delta(tabA, x0)) == tabA$npar - 1L)            # Result I5, balanced binary thresholds
tabE <- mg2_level_table(inv_designs$E, "intercepts"); tE <- c(lapply(1:3, function(j) qnorm(1:3 / 4)), list(0, 0))
stopifnot(inv_rank(mg2_delta(tabE, mg2_start(tabE, tE))) == tabE$npar)   # a polytomous item removes it
```

##### The θ⁽²⁾ rank under groups (O7)   {#sec-mg-start2}

*Drafted by cloud task L (read-only, from `003819a`), whose only run was a Python port, not evidence.
Hypotheses, assertions and the two bounds below were fixed before any run, and each says so.
**Executed 2026-10-10** (R 4.6.0, lavaan 0.7.2; every chunk in document order through `mg2-start`,
then this one): every assertion passed. The draft's covering note predicted a θ⁽²⁾ ratio of about 1e-12
on the deficient cell; the run printed 5.22e-17. That prediction failed and is kept here; no assertion
depended on it.*

**What was owed.** Spec §4.8 *A second point before aborting* (O7, decided 2026-10-09) asks for a chunk
asserting full rank of Δ at θ⁽²⁾ under the literal rule. `mg2-start` measured θ⁽⁰⁾ only.

**The rule as coded** (`mg2_second`). For every free λ, β and ψ entry, in particular a later group's free ψ:
θ⁽²⁾_i = θ⁽⁰⁾_i + 0.1({iφ} − ½), φ = (√5−1)/2. Here i is the element's `fidx`, i.e. its θ position under
O6's (group, row, col) order. A tie is one θ element, so it gets one shift and every member group reads the
same shifted value. Thresholds, ν, ω and α are unchanged. Every shift is at most 0.05 in absolute value.
β is in the rule but is never exercised here: O2 refuses a structural path in every `groups` text, so no
table of this section has a β row. @sec-mg-beta exercises it (Result B7, `mgb-start`): β in the rule is what
lets a tied-β model leave the set at θ⁽²⁾, a case 0.3.0 cannot reach (no β ties, R-Q2).

**What the chunk asserts.**
1. Design × level, 20 cells, from Module 3's starts as `mg2-start` builds them: Δ(θ⁽²⁾) has full column
   rank. The perturbed set is exactly the free λ and ψ θ positions, and every other element is bit-identical
   to θ⁽⁰⁾. On design E the perturbed positions are also hand-written (configural 23–32, thresholds 12–21,
   loadings and intercepts 12–17), so an ordering mutant (row, col, group) or a row-indexed shift fails.
2. Result G4 (ii), constructed. Every binary threshold starts at 0, polytomous ones at their population
   values. Then (A, intercepts) is deficient by exactly one at θ⁽⁰⁾ **and** at θ⁽²⁾, and every other cell is
   full rank at both. The abort is correct there. With the common binary threshold t = 0.3, θ⁽⁰⁾ is
   deficient by one and θ⁽²⁾ is full rank.
3. σ_min/σ_max at θ⁽⁰⁾ and θ⁽²⁾ are printed per cell, never asserted.
4. Negative control: also perturbing ω and α leaves the t = 0 case deficient by one (agrees with the
   decision). ν has no free row at the intercepts level, so it cannot be perturbed there (see below).
   Positive control, **not an adopted rule**: perturbing the thresholds does leave the set. This shows the
   harness can see an escape, so the "stays deficient" assertions are not an artefact of it.
5. Cross-route: on design A at the intercepts level, the rank at the same four points via `inv_model` and
   `inv_jac` equals the rank via `mg2_delta`.

**Tolerances.** Rank uses the existing `INV_TOL = 1e-7` (provisional, set before measuring). The shift
bound `<= 0.05` follows from the rule. The position check at `1e-14` is the rounding of one add and one
subtract of O(1) numbers (set before measuring).

```{r mg2-start2}
# Depends on: inv-setup (INV_TOL, inv_rank, inv_jac, inv_model, inv_tau, inv_designs,
# inv_levels), mg2-core, mg2-levels (mg2_level_table, mg2_start), mg2-start (mg2_ratio).
# Every name defined here starts with mg2_ or MG2_.
stopifnot(exists("mg2_ratio"))
MG2_PHI <- (sqrt(5) - 1) / 2

# Spec 4.8, A second point; O7. i = fidx = the theta position under O6. A tie is one theta element,
# hence one shift. types = the O7 set by default; widened only for the negative/positive controls.
mg2_second <- function(tab, th0, types = c("lambda", "beta", "psi")) {
  R <- tab$rows; i <- sort(unique(R$fidx[R$free & R$type %in% types]))
  th <- th0; th[i] <- th0[i] + 0.1 * ((i * MG2_PHI) %% 1 - 0.5); th
}
mg2_rk <- function(tab, th) { D <- mg2_delta(tab, th); c(rank = inv_rank(D), ratio = mg2_ratio(D)) }

# ---- (1) 20 cells at Module 3's starts: full rank at theta2; the perturbed set and the bound --------
for (nm in names(inv_designs)) for (l in inv_levels) {
  K <- inv_designs[[nm]]; tab <- mg2_level_table(K, l)
  th0 <- mg2_start(tab, inv_tau(K)); th2 <- mg2_second(tab, th0)
  a <- mg2_rk(tab, th0); b <- mg2_rk(tab, th2)
  cat(sprintf("theta2 rank %s %-10s %2d of %2d | sv ratio theta0 %.3g, theta2 %.3g\n", nm, l,
              b[["rank"]], tab$npar, a[["ratio"]], b[["ratio"]]))          # printed, never asserted
  R <- tab$rows; pert <- sort(unique(R$fidx[R$free & R$type %in% c("lambda", "psi")]))
  P <- mg2_pars(tab, th2)
  stopifnot(b[["rank"]] == tab$npar,                                       # the owed assertion
            setequal(which(th2 != th0), pert),                             # thresholds, nu, omega, alpha untouched
            max(abs(th2 - th0)) <= 0.05,                                   # bound of the rule (set before measuring)
            P[[1]]$Psi[1, 1] == 1,                                         # group 1 psi is fixed by the metric
            if (any(R$free & R$type == "psi")) P[[2]]$Psi[1, 1] != 1 else P[[2]]$Psi[1, 1] == 1,
            if (l %in% c("loadings", "intercepts")) identical(P[[1]]$Lam, P[[2]]$Lam) else TRUE)  # a tie: one shift
}
# hand-written theta positions of the perturbed elements, design E (spec G8 / G6 counts: 32, 29, 27, 23)
KE <- inv_designs$E
exp_pos <- list(configural = 23:32, thresholds = 12:21, loadings = 12:17, intercepts = 12:17)
for (l in inv_levels) {
  tab <- mg2_level_table(KE, l); th0 <- mg2_start(tab, inv_tau(KE)); th2 <- mg2_second(tab, th0)
  ip <- exp_pos[[l]]
  stopifnot(identical(as.integer(which(th2 != th0)), as.integer(ip)),
            max(abs((th2 - th0)[ip] - 0.1 * ((ip * MG2_PHI) %% 1 - 0.5))) < 1e-14)   # set before measuring
}

# ---- (2) Result G4 (ii), constructed: every binary threshold starts at 0 --------------------------
mg2_tau0 <- function(K) lapply(K, function(k) if (k == 2L) 0 else qnorm(seq_len(k - 1L) / k))
for (nm in names(inv_designs)) for (l in inv_levels) {
  K <- inv_designs[[nm]]; tab <- mg2_level_table(K, l)
  th0 <- mg2_start(tab, mg2_tau0(K)); th2 <- mg2_second(tab, th0)
  a <- mg2_rk(tab, th0); b <- mg2_rk(tab, th2)
  want <- tab$npar - as.integer(nm == "A" && l == "intercepts")             # prediction from I5 and G4 (ii)
  cat(sprintf("zero-threshold start %s %-10s rank %2d (theta0) %2d (theta2) of %2d | ratio %.3g, %.3g\n",
              nm, l, a[["rank"]], b[["rank"]], tab$npar, a[["ratio"]], b[["ratio"]]))
  stopifnot(a[["rank"]] == want, b[["rank"]] == want)    # deficient by exactly one only on the all-binary intercepts cell
}
tabA <- mg2_level_table(inv_designs$A, "intercepts"); q <- tabA$npar
t0 <- mg2_start(tabA, as.list(rep(0, 5))); t2 <- mg2_second(tabA, t0)
t3 <- mg2_start(tabA, as.list(rep(.3, 5)))                                  # equal NONZERO thresholds
stopifnot(mg2_rk(tabA, t3)[["rank"]] == q - 1L,                             # on I5's set at theta0 ...
          mg2_rk(tabA, mg2_second(tabA, t3))[["rank"]] == q)                # ... and theta2 leaves it: t != 0
cat(sprintf("t = .3: theta0 ratio %.3g, theta2 ratio %.3g (theta2 becomes the start)\n",
            mg2_rk(tabA, t3)[["ratio"]], mg2_rk(tabA, mg2_second(tabA, t3))[["ratio"]]))

# ---- (3) cross-route: inv_model reaches the same ranks (layout tau|lam|om|phi|kap) ----------------
mI <- inv_model(inv_designs$A, "intercepts")
to_inv <- function(th) c(th[1:10], th[12:16], th[11], th[17])               # mg2 theta: tau|lam|psi|om|alpha
for (th in list(t0, t2, t3, mg2_second(tabA, t3)))
  stopifnot(inv_rank(inv_jac(mI$sigma, to_inv(th))) == mg2_rk(tabA, th)[["rank"]])

# ---- (4) controls on the t = 0 case -----------------------------------------------------------------
t4 <- mg2_second(tabA, t0, c("lambda", "beta", "psi", "omega", "alpha", "nu"))   # nu: no free row at this level
stopifnot(all(t4[12:17] != t2[12:17]),                                      # omega, alpha did move: not vacuous
          mg2_rk(tabA, t4)[["rank"]] == q - 1L)                             # negative control: still deficient by one
t5 <- mg2_second(tabA, t0, c("lambda", "psi", "tau"))                       # NOT the adopted rule (declined under O7)
stopifnot(mg2_rk(tabA, t5)[["rank"]] == q)                                  # positive control: an escape exists, and is seen
```

**What this does not establish.**
- **The starts are stand-ins.** `mg2_start` uses population thresholds (group 2's plus 0.05), not Module 3's
  sample thresholds, and Result G4 (i) says the sample values decide membership of I5's set. These cells
  show the rank at those points, not at any particular dataset's start. The zero-threshold sweep stands in
  for "sample thresholds all equal to 0".
- **ν is not covered.** No table here frees ν together with ω, φ and κ at the all-binary intercepts level
  (such a model is not identified), so "adding ν gains nothing" is a claim about ω and α only. The same
  holds for `grd-start`'s `all4`.
- **Scope.** One factor, no cross-loadings, G = 2, and no β row (O2). G > 2 and multi-factor θ⁽²⁾ rank are
  untested. The ranks are at the stated points only, not for all of a neighbourhood.
- **The shift sequence** was chosen without reference to any model (spec). That these 21 particular points
  are full rank is a finding of the chunk, not a property of the rule.
- **Ratios are descriptive.** They carry no cutoff, and `INV_TOL` is still provisional.

```{r mg2-lavaan}
# Depends on: mg2-core, mg2-levels, inv-lavaan (inv_lav: lavaan 0.7.2 fits of
# designs A-E at four levels, delta parameterization, group = 2, WLSMV).
# Hypotheses, frozen by the drafter before this chunk's first run under the pinned versions:
#  H-L1  lavaan's group-g loading IS Q-2's lambda at every level, thresholds included. sigma_g at
#        lavaan's estimates (lambda, delta -> omega, nu, alpha, psi, tau) equals lavInspect(fit,
#        "implied") in both groups, thresholds and correlations.
#  H-L0  (the reading in task K's brief and the 2026-10-09 Q-2 row, since corrected) at the
#        thresholds level a polytomous item's lavaan loading is omega * lambda, so
#        lambda = lambda_lavaan / omega.
#        Under H-L1 this mapped comparison FAILS: it is kept as the negative control.
# Tolerances. MG2_TOL_IMP = 1e-10: exact algebra at given estimates, rounding ~1e-16; looser than
# MG2_TOL_ALG only because lavaan's accessor path is read, not audited. MG2_FLOOR = 1e-3 for the
# negative control, chosen after seeing the drafter's scratch gaps (0.019 to 0.31), about 20x below
# the smallest; the pinned run's gaps are the same range (0.019 to 0.31).
MG2_TOL_IMP <- 1e-10; MG2_FLOOR <- 1e-3

mg2_from_lavaan <- function(tab, fit, div = FALSE) {      # div = TRUE: lambda = lambda_lavaan / omega (H-L0), later groups only
  est <- lavInspect(fit, "est"); R <- tab$rows; th <- rep(NA_real_, tab$npar)
  for (r in which(R$free)) {
    g <- R$g[r]; i <- R$i[r]; j <- R$j[r]; e <- est[[g]]
    v <- switch(R$type[r],
      tau = e$tau[mg2_tpos(tab$K[[g]], i, j), 1],
      lambda = e$lambda[i, j] / (if (div && g > 1L) e$delta[i, 1] else 1),
      psi = e$psi[i, j], nu = e$nu[i, 1], omega = e$delta[i, 1], alpha = e$alpha[i, 1])
    f <- R$fidx[r]
    if (is.na(th[f])) th[f] <- v
    else if (R$type[r] != "lambda" || !div) stopifnot(abs(th[f] - v) < 1e-9)       # tied rows carry one value
  }
  th
}
mg2_lav_implied <- function(fit)                          # lavaan's implied statistics in s's order, group by group
  unlist(lapply(lavInspect(fit, "implied"), function(x) c(x$th, x$cov[lower.tri(x$cov)])))

mg2_imp <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(inv_designs), function(nm) do.call(rbind, lapply(inv_levels, function(l) {
  K <- inv_designs[[nm]]; r <- inv_lav[[nm]][[l]]; tab <- mg2_level_table(K, l)
  imp <- lavInspect(r$fit, "implied")
  stopifnot(r$conv, all(abs(unlist(lapply(imp, function(x) diag(x$cov))) - 1) < 1e-8),   # implied cov is a correlation matrix
            length(mg2_lav_implied(r$fit)) == sum(mg2_Dg(tab)))
  s_l <- mg2_lav_implied(r$fit); om <- lavInspect(r$fit, "est")[[2]]$delta[, 1]
  data.frame(design = nm, level = l,
             gap_raw    = max(abs(mg2_sigma(tab, mg2_from_lavaan(tab, r$fit, FALSE)) - s_l)),
             # H-L0 is a statement about the thresholds level only; elsewhere lambda is tied and the mapping is moot
             gap_mapped = if (l == "thresholds") max(abs(mg2_sigma(tab, mg2_from_lavaan(tab, r$fit, TRUE)) - s_l)) else NA_real_,
             max_dev_omega = max(abs(om - 1)))
}))))
print(mg2_imp, digits = 3)
# H-L1: lavaan's own loading, at every design x level
stopifnot(mg2_imp$gap_raw < MG2_TOL_IMP)
# H-L0's mapping, thresholds level: it coincides with H-L1 on the all-binary design A (omega = 1
# there, no polytomous item) and FAILS on every design that has a polytomous item
thr <- mg2_imp$level == "thresholds"
stopifnot(mg2_imp$gap_mapped[thr & mg2_imp$design == "A"] < MG2_TOL_IMP,
          mg2_imp$gap_mapped[thr & mg2_imp$design != "A"] > MG2_FLOOR)
# How far omega_hat is from 1 where the control bites: the gap of rho_ij is |omega_i omega_j - 1| |lambda_i lambda_j| phi
print(mg2_imp[thr & mg2_imp$design != "A", c("design", "max_dev_omega", "gap_mapped")], digits = 3)
```

```{r mg2-lavdelta}
# Depends on: mg2-core, mg2-levels, mg2-lavaan (mg2_from_lavaan), inv-lavaan (inv_lav).
# Q-2's parameters ARE lavaan's (tau, lambda, psi, nu, delta -> omega, alpha), so the closed-form
# column of every table row is lavaan's Delta column of the matching free parameter. lavTech(fit,
# "delta") has a column per free parameter BEFORE equality constraints (@sec-invariance-id, correction
# 1), which is the row-level object: no equality basis is applied. Budget: the same gamma-form as
# @sec-delta (C), here simply 1e-10 absolute, set before measuring (exact algebra, entries O(1)).
MG2_TOL_LD <- 1e-10
mg2_lavdelta <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(inv_designs), function(nm) do.call(rbind, lapply(inv_levels, function(l) {
  K <- inv_designs[[nm]]; fit <- inv_lav[[nm]][[l]]$fit; tab <- mg2_level_table(K, l)
  pt <- parTable(fit); fr <- pt[pt$free > 0, ]; fr <- fr[order(fr$free), ]; ov <- lavNames(fit, "ov")
  Dl <- do.call(rbind, lavTech(fit, "delta"))
  key_l <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(fr)), function(k) { x <- fr[k, ]; g <- as.integer(x$group)
    switch(x$op, "=~" = paste("lambda", g, match(x$rhs, ov), 1L), "|" = paste("tau", g, match(x$lhs, ov), as.integer(sub("t", "", x$rhs))),
           "~~" = paste("psi", g, 1L, 1L), "~*~" = paste("omega", g, match(x$lhs, ov), 1L),
           "~1" = if (x$lhs %in% ov) paste("nu", g, match(x$lhs, ov), 1L) else paste("alpha", g, 1L, 1L), NA_character_) }, "")
  fr_rows <- which(tab$rows$free); key_o <- with(tab$rows[fr_rows, ], paste(type, g, i, j))
  m <- match(key_l, key_o)
  stopifnot(!anyNA(key_l), !anyNA(m), length(m) == length(fr_rows), anyDuplicated(m) == 0,
            nrow(Dl) == sum(mg2_Dg(tab)), ncol(Dl) == nrow(fr))
  cols <- mg2_dcols(tab, mg2_from_lavaan(tab, fit, FALSE))
  data.frame(design = nm, level = l, ncol = ncol(Dl), gap = max(abs(cols[, m] - Dl)))
}))))
print(mg2_lavdelta, digits = 3)
stopifnot(mg2_lavdelta$gap < MG2_TOL_LD)
```

#### What this hands Modules 5 and 6

- **Module 5** (`dwls_model`): per group, from the group's rows with the absent-row default (`dwlsmv_parvals`
  gathers $v=Z\theta+v_{\rm fixed}$), `Vg = Lam*A*Psi*A'*Lam'`, `cg = Lam*A*alpha`, thresholds
  `om[j]*(tau - nu[j] - cg[j])`, correlations `om*om' :* Vg` (lower triangle, column-major); concatenate groups.
  No level or tie information. Θ is not formed (a derived $\Theta^*_g$ is needed only by admissibility, O15).
- **Module 6** (`dwls_delta`): the table of Result MS2 per row, then sum the columns that share `fidx`. The
  production Δ remains a central difference (2026-09-23); by Lemma MS2.1 it has rounding error only, so the
  step rule is unchanged. This section is the oracle.
- Nothing in the locked boundary changes beyond what O14 already moves (per-group `statmap` vector).

#### What this does not establish

- $G>2$ (group-local, so expected, not run), cross-loadings and several factors beyond the one two-factor table of
  `mg2-delta`, marker-metric models, partial invariance, and any model the 0.3.0 grammar still refuses
  (β beside ν, ω, α or a tie: the structural table tests formulas, not admissibility).
- The Mata routines and their tolerances; production's central difference against these columns.
- Weighting, $T$, ACOV and DIFFTEST: @sec-multigroup-scaling.

#### Open here

Decided 2026-10-09 (spec §4.8, E-026), and how this section uses each: **O6**
(group, row, col), so MS3 item 3 is the identity and `o6 = "b"` is kept only as the ordering that must
fail it; **O3/O4** a tie joins the same τ or λ element across groups, so MS3's sum rule and Lemma
MS2.1 (one member per group) hold as stated; **O5** a tied threshold including group 1 (the only form this section's levels emit; otherwise its lowest member's, spec §4.8 O5, 2026-11-01) starts at group 1's sample
threshold, as `mg2_start` does; **O9** group 1 refuses ν, ω, α lines, while the formulas hold in any
group and an explicit reference row is a no-op (`mg2-sigma` (3)); **O12** ω̂ ≤ 0 is an admissibility
note; Θ_g in the spec means $\Theta^*_g$ (user). **Q-2's output convention:** `mg2-lavaan` confirms
H-L1 under lavaan 0.7.2, so no `nlcom` recipe is needed (correction row, 2026-10-09).

Still open: **O7's** θ⁽²⁾ rank check (decided: λ, β, ψ only) is owed; `mg2-start` measures θ⁽⁰⁾ only.
**O15** (per-group admissibility) is provisional. **v2 note (user):** a reference-valued ν, ω or α has
no table row, so a Sörbom column for it is requested by (type, group, index); the closed form supports
that.

#### Result MS6: exact second derivatives on design E's class {#sec-mg-hessian}

*Added 2026-10-19 by a side session, as step 1 of E-031 (approved by the
user that day). Its verification is step 2, preregistered in E-031
(committed at 6aa6ab3 before any chunk below was written or run). Nothing in `src/`, the tests, their
references or any tolerance changes here. It sits here, not under `@sec-mg-sensitivity-step`, because
its chunks need `mg2-core`. The sensitivity sections point to it.*

**Why.** Two finite differences feed TS4's β₂:
- `dwlsmv_sens_ddelta` takes ∂Δ/∂θ_l as a central difference of production's Δ_c;
- `dwlsmv_sens` (and its copy `dwlsmv_sens_jmat`) takes R in J = P − R as a central difference of
  Δ_c'(w∘r).

Both carry rounding noise that is redrawn whenever θ̂ moves (`@sec-mg-sensitivity-step`, Addenda 2–4).
This result gives both in closed form, on a stated domain only.

**Domain.** The tables certified by three clauses, checked on the table and not on values:
- **(c1)** no ptype 3 (β) row, free or fixed;
- **(c2)** one factor, m = 1;
- **(c3)** each θ element is read by at most one row of any one group.

Design E's four levels satisfy all three (O3/O4 ties join one row per group). **Models with β are not
covered and must be refused, never silently handled.** With B ≠ 0, a β row enters κ and Φ through
(I − B)⁻¹. σ then has degree 2 in a β row (Lemma MS2.1), and the table below has no β entries. A
two-factor model without β is multilinear too, but its entries are not the ones below. Nothing here
establishes it, so (c2) refuses it as well. An exact routine outside the domain refuses (rc 3498 in
Mata, `stop()` here). It does not fall back to a finite difference.

**σ on the domain.** With m = 1 and no β: A = I, κ = α, Φ = ψ, L = λ and V_jk = λ_jλ_kψ. Result MS1 reads,
in group g's table-row values,
$$
\sigma_{gjc}=\omega_j\tau_{jc}-\omega_j\nu_j-\omega_j\lambda_j\alpha,\qquad
\rho_{g,jk}=\omega_j\,\omega_k\,\lambda_j\,\lambda_k\,\psi\quad(j\ne k).
$$
Each entry is a sum of monomials in **distinct** row values, with coefficients ±1, so it is multilinear in
the rows. An absent ν, ω or α reads as its constant default (G4), and a fixed row is a constant.

**θ-level multilinearity is (c3).** v = Zθ + v_fixed, and σ_g reads only group g's rows. A monomial of
σ_g contains distinct rows of group g. Under (c3) these map to distinct θ elements, so σ is multilinear
in θ: ∂²σ_k/∂θ_l² = 0. Without (c3), two rows of one monomial could share a θ element and give a θ².
That is what D4 refuses.

**The Hessian in table rows.** Write $H^v_{k,rr'}=\partial^2\sigma_k/\partial v_r\partial v_{r'}$. It is zero
unless r and r′ are distinct rows of the group that owns entry k, and it is zero on the diagonal. The
nonzero entries ({r, r′} unordered, item i, category c) are:

| {r, r′} | threshold entries σ_gjc (j = i only) | correlation entries ρ_g,jk |
|---|---|---|
| {ω_i, τ_ic} | 1 at (i, c) | 0 |
| {ω_i, ν_i} | −1 on every c | 0 |
| {ω_i, λ_i} | −α | (pairs containing i) ω_kλ_kψ, with k the other item |
| {ω_i, α} | −λ_i | 0 |
| {λ_i, α} | −ω_i | 0 |
| {ω_i, ω_k}, i ≠ k | 0 | λ_iλ_kψ on the pair (i, k) only |
| {λ_i, λ_k}, i ≠ k | 0 | ω_iω_kψ on (i, k) only |
| {ω_i, λ_k}, i ≠ k | 0 | ω_kλ_iψ on (i, k) only |
| {ω_i, ψ} / {λ_i, ψ} | 0 | ω_kλ_iλ_k / ω_iω_kλ_k on every pair (i, k) |

Each correlation entry is the monomial ω_jω_kλ_jλ_kψ with the two differentiated factors removed. Every
pair not listed (τ with anything but its own ω_i, ν or α with λ, and so on) is 0.

**Result MS6.**
$$
H_{k,ij}=\frac{\partial^2\sigma_k}{\partial\theta_i\partial\theta_j}=\sum_{r\in\mathcal R_i}\sum_{r'\in\mathcal R_j}H^v_{k,rr'}
\quad(H_k=Z'H^v_kZ),\qquad
\frac{\partial\Delta}{\partial\theta_l}=H[\cdot,\cdot,l],
$$
$$
R=\sum_k w_kr_kH_k,\qquad J=P-R,\qquad P=\Delta'W\Delta .
$$
Ties sum over member rows on both sides, as Δ's columns do (MS3). Pairs from different groups add 0.
The consequences:
1. **H_k is symmetric, and H[·, l, l] = 0 exactly.**
2. **Block l of ∂Δ/∂θ contains no θ_l.** It is invariant along e_l, exactly, and bitwise in any
   evaluation that never reads θ_l. Third derivatives are nonzero (for example ∂³ρ_jk/∂ω_j∂ω_k∂λ_j =
   λ_kψ), so block l moves along other directions, linearly in each.
3. **The layout is `dwlsmv_sens_ddelta`'s.** Its column (l − 1)q + i is H[·, i, l] (`matrix(H, D, q²)`).
   R is the exact value of the quantity `dwlsmv_sens_jmat` differences: column j of Δ'(w∘r) differentiated
   in θ_j with r held fixed. That R is symmetric without symmetrization.

*Proof.* Differentiate the two displayed forms twice. The table is the list of pairs of distinct factors
in each monomial. The θ form is the chain rule through the linear map v = Zθ + v_fixed. □

##### Verification

Items and thresholds are the preregistration's (§4 of `predictions.md`). There are 14 points: g, i and s
at each level, and R's two fit points f. The residual is r = `sv_s` − σ and the weights are w = `t3_w0`. The
emulations (Δ_c, dD_fd, J_fd) are R's model of production's arithmetic, not Stata's.

```{r mg2h-core}
# Depends on: mg2-core, mg2-levels, mg-sens-setup (sv_jac, sv_s), the T3 chunks (t3_w0, t3_lev).
# Result MS6. Names start with mg2h_. `mut` selects a preregistered mutant (M1-M5); "" is the derivation.
mg2h_domain <- function(tab) {                      # the clauses that fail; character(0) = certified
  R <- tab$rows; fr <- R[R$free, ]; why <- character(0)
  if (any(R$type == "beta")) why <- c(why, "c1: a ptype 3 (beta) row")
  if (tab$m != 1L) why <- c(why, "c2: more than one factor")
  if (any(duplicated(fr[, c("g", "fidx")]))) why <- c(why, "c3: a theta element read by two rows of one group")
  why
}
# d2 sigma_g / d v_a d v_b for two distinct rows a, b of group g (one-row data frames), length D_g.
mg2h_d2 <- function(Pg, Kg, a, b, mut = "") {
  p <- nrow(Pg$Lam); lam <- Pg$Lam[, 1]; om <- Pg$om; psi <- Pg$Psi[1, 1]; al <- Pg$al[1]
  itm <- rep(seq_len(p), Kg - 1L); dth <- numeric(sum(Kg - 1L))
  ty <- c(a$type, b$type); ii <- c(a$i, b$i)
  pick <- function(t) which(ty == t)[1]
  if (all(c("omega", "tau") %in% ty) && ii[pick("omega")] == ii[pick("tau")])
    dth[mg2_tpos(Kg, ii[pick("tau")], c(a$j, b$j)[pick("tau")])] <- 1
  if (all(c("omega", "nu") %in% ty) && ii[1] == ii[2])
    dth[itm == ii[1]] <- if (mut == "M2") 1 else -1
  if (all(c("omega", "lambda") %in% ty) && ii[1] == ii[2]) dth[itm == ii[1]] <- -al
  if (all(c("omega", "alpha") %in% ty)) dth[itm == ii[pick("omega")]] <- -lam[ii[pick("omega")]]
  if (all(c("lambda", "alpha") %in% ty)) dth[itm == ii[pick("lambda")]] <- if (mut == "M1") 0 else -om[ii[pick("lambda")]]
  # correlations: the monomial om_j om_k lam_j lam_k psi with the two differentiated factors removed
  lab <- function(t, i) switch(t, omega = paste0("o", i), lambda = paste0("l", i), psi = "p", NA)
  la <- c(lab(a$type, a$i), lab(b$type, b$i))
  jk <- which(lower.tri(diag(p)), arr.ind = TRUE)
  drho <- if (anyNA(la)) numeric(nrow(jk)) else apply(jk, 1, function(z) {
    j <- z[1]; k <- z[2]
    labs <- c(paste0("o", j), paste0("o", k), paste0("l", j), paste0("l", k), "p")
    vals <- c(om[j], om[k], lam[j], lam[k], psi); ia <- match(la, labs)
    if (anyNA(ia)) return(0)
    if (mut == "M3" && all(substr(la, 1, 1) == "o")) return(lam[j] * lam[k])
    prod(vals[-ia]) })
  c(dth, drho)
}
# H: D x q x q, the derivation's sum over member rows. Refuses outside the domain; no fallback.
mg2h_hess <- function(tab, theta, mut = "") {
  why <- mg2h_domain(tab)
  if (length(why)) stop("outside Result MS6's domain, refused: ", paste(why, collapse = "; "))
  P <- mg2_pars(tab, theta); Dg <- mg2_Dg(tab); off <- mg2_off(tab); q <- tab$npar
  R <- tab$rows; fr <- which(R$free)
  if (mut == "M4") fr <- fr[!duplicated(R$fidx[fr])]           # M4: ties not summed
  H <- array(0, c(sum(Dg), q, q))
  for (a in fr) for (b in fr) {
    if (a == b || R$g[a] != R$g[b]) next
    g <- R$g[a]; idx <- off[g] + seq_len(Dg[g])
    H[idx, R$fidx[a], R$fidx[b]] <- H[idx, R$fidx[a], R$fidx[b]] +
      mg2h_d2(P[[g]], tab$K[[g]], R[a, ], R[b, ], mut)
  }
  H
}
# R = sum_k w_k r_k H_k and J = P - R, P from the closed Delta (MS2).
mg2h_RJ <- function(tab, theta, s, w, mut = "", H = mg2h_hess(tab, theta, mut)) {
  q <- tab$npar; wr <- if (mut == "M5") s - mg2_sigma(tab, theta) else w * (s - mg2_sigma(tab, theta))
  Rm <- matrix(crossprod(matrix(H, dim(H)[1]), wr), q, q)
  D <- mg2_delta(tab, theta); P <- crossprod(D, w * D)
  list(H = H, R = Rm, P = P, J = P - Rm)
}
mg2h_rel <- function(X, Y) max(abs(X - Y)) / max(1, max(abs(Y)))
mg2h_eta <- function(x) 0.1 * max(1, abs(x))
# Controls (section 2): complex-step Delta, and closed Delta, central-differenced at eta.
mg2h_ctrl <- function(tab, th, s, w) {
  sig <- function(x) mg2_sigma(tab, x); q <- length(th); r <- s - sig(th); wr <- w * r
  D0 <- sv_jac(sig, th); Hc <- Hd <- array(0, c(length(r), q, q)); Rc <- matrix(0, q, q)
  for (l in seq_len(q)) { e <- replace(numeric(q), l, mg2h_eta(th[l]))
    Dp <- sv_jac(sig, th + e); Dm <- sv_jac(sig, th - e)
    Hc[, , l] <- (Dp - Dm) / (2 * e[l]); Rc[, l] <- (crossprod(Dp, wr) - crossprod(Dm, wr)) / (2 * e[l])
    Hd[, , l] <- (mg2_delta(tab, th + e) - mg2_delta(tab, th - e)) / (2 * e[l]) }
  P <- crossprod(D0, w * D0)
  list(H = Hc, Hd = Hd, R = Rc, J = P - Rc)
}
# Emulations (section 3). Delta_c: lambda/beta/psi correlation rows by central differences of V at
# h = 1e-5 max(1, |v|), scaled by om_j om_k after differencing; everything else closed form; ties summed.
mg2h_deltac <- function(tab, th) {
  R <- tab$rows; fr <- which(R$free); Dg <- mg2_Dg(tab); off <- mg2_off(tab)
  cols <- mg2_dcols(tab, th, fr); lt <- lower.tri(diag(tab$p))
  Vg <- function(x, g) { Pg <- mg2_pars(tab, x)[[g]]; A <- solve(diag(tab$m) - Pg$B)
    (Pg$Lam %*% A %*% Pg$Psi %*% t(A) %*% t(Pg$Lam))[lt] }
  for (k in seq_along(fr)) { r <- fr[k]; if (!(R$type[r] %in% c("lambda", "beta", "psi"))) next
    g <- R$g[r]; f <- R$fidx[r]; h <- 1e-5 * max(1, abs(th[f]))
    om <- mg2_pars(tab, th)[[g]]$om
    rows <- off[g] + sum(tab$K[[g]] - 1L) + seq_len(sum(lt))
    cols[rows, k] <- tcrossprod(om)[lt] *
      ((Vg(replace(th, f, th[f] + h), g) - Vg(replace(th, f, th[f] - h), g)) / (2 * h)) }
  Dl <- matrix(0, nrow(cols), tab$npar)
  for (k in seq_along(fr)) { f <- R$fidx[fr[k]]; Dl[, f] <- Dl[, f] + cols[, k] }
  Dl
}
mg2h_ddfd <- function(tab, th) { q <- length(th)                 # dwlsmv_sens_ddelta, D x q^2
  do.call(cbind, lapply(seq_len(q), function(l) { h <- 1e-4 * max(1, abs(th[l])); e <- replace(numeric(q), l, h)
    (mg2h_deltac(tab, th + e) - mg2h_deltac(tab, th - e)) / (2 * h) })) }
mg2h_jfd <- function(tab, th, s, w) { q <- length(th)            # dwlsmv_sens_jmat / dwlsmv_sens's J
  D <- mg2h_deltac(tab, th); wr <- w * (s - mg2_sigma(tab, th)); P <- crossprod(D, w * D)
  Rm <- sapply(seq_len(q), function(j) { h <- .Machine$double.eps^(1/3) * max(1, abs(th[j]))
    e <- replace(numeric(q), j, h)
    (crossprod(mg2h_deltac(tab, th + e), wr) - crossprod(mg2h_deltac(tab, th - e), wr)) / (2 * h) })
  Rm <- (Rm + t(Rm)) / 2
  list(R = Rm, J = P - Rm)
}
# The 14 preregistered points (section 1).
mg2h_pts <- local({ out <- list()
  for (L in inv_levels) { tab <- mg2_level_table(KE, L); m <- inv_model(KE, L)
    out[[paste0("g_", L)]] <- list(tab = tab, th = mg2_point(tab))
    out[[paste0("i_", L)]] <- list(tab = tab, th = mg2_from_inv(tab, KE, L, inv_point(m, inv_tau(KE), inv_lam)))
    out[[paste0("s_", L)]] <- list(tab = tab, th = mg2_start(tab, inv_tau(KE))) }
  for (L in names(t3_lev)) { tab <- mg2_level_table(KE, L)
    out[[paste0("f_", L)]] <- list(tab = tab, th = mg2_from_inv(tab, KE, L, t3_lev[[L]]$th)) }
  out })
stopifnot(length(mg2h_pts) == 14L, all(sapply(mg2h_pts, function(z) length(mg2_sigma(z$tab, z$th)) == length(sv_s))))
```

```{r mg2h-check}
# Depends on: mg2h-core. D0-D4, V0-V4 of the preregistration.
mg2h_res <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(mg2h_pts), function(nm) {
  z <- mg2h_pts[[nm]]; tab <- z$tab; th <- z$th; q <- length(th)
  sig <- function(x) mg2_sigma(tab, x); s0 <- sig(th)
  d0 <- max(sapply(seq_len(q), function(l) { e <- replace(numeric(q), l, 1)
    max(abs(sig(th + e) - 2 * s0 + sig(th - e))) })) / max(abs(s0))
  ex <- mg2h_RJ(tab, th, sv_s, t3_w0); H <- ex$H; ct <- mg2h_ctrl(tab, th, sv_s, t3_w0)
  v0_sym <- identical(H, aperm(H, c(1, 3, 2))); v0_diag <- all(sapply(seq_len(q), function(l) all(H[, l, l] == 0)))
  v0_inv <- all(sapply(seq_len(q), function(l) {
    identical(mg2h_hess(tab, replace(th, l, th[l] + mg2h_eta(th[l])))[, , l], H[, , l]) }))
  dd <- mg2h_ddfd(tab, th); jf <- mg2h_jfd(tab, th, sv_s, t3_w0)
  mut <- sapply(paste0("M", 1:5), function(m) { mx <- mg2h_RJ(tab, th, sv_s, t3_w0, mut = m)
    max(mg2h_rel(mx$H, ct$H), mg2h_rel(mx$R, ct$R), mg2h_rel(mx$J, ct$J)) })
  data.frame(point = nm, q = q, D0 = d0, V0_sym = v0_sym, V0_diag = v0_diag, V0_inv = v0_inv,
    V1 = mg2h_rel(H, ct$H), V1b = mg2h_rel(H, ct$Hd), V2_R = mg2h_rel(ex$R, ct$R), V2_J = mg2h_rel(ex$J, ct$J),
    V3a = mg2h_rel(dd, matrix(H, dim(H)[1])), V3c = mg2h_rel(jf$J, ex$J),
    V3d = max(abs(jf$R - ex$R)) / max(abs(ex$R)), t(mut))
}))
print(format(mg2h_res, digits = 3), row.names = FALSE)
# D1-D4: the domain check
mg2h_ref <- function(tab, th) tryCatch({ mg2h_hess(tab, th); "accepted" }, error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
mg2h_d1 <- sapply(inv_levels, function(L) length(mg2h_domain(mg2_level_table(KE, L))) == 0L)
mg2h_t2 <- local({ rw <- list(); add <- function(x) rw[[length(rw) + 1L]] <<- x   # two factors, beta F1 -> F2
  for (g in 1:2) { for (j in 1:5) for (k in seq_len(KE[j] - 1L)) add(mg2_row(g, "tau", j, k))
    for (j in 1:5) add(mg2_row(g, "lambda", j, if (j <= 2) 1L else 2L))
    add(mg2_row(g, "psi", 1L, 1L, free = FALSE, val = 1)); add(mg2_row(g, "psi", 2L, 2L, free = FALSE, val = 1))
    add(mg2_row(g, "beta", 2L, 1L)) }
  do.call(rbind, rw) })
mg2h_tb  <- mg2_table(list(KE, KE), 2L, mg2h_t2)
mg2h_tnb <- mg2_table(list(KE, KE), 2L, mg2h_t2[mg2h_t2$type != "beta", ])
mg2h_tdu <- local({ tab <- mg2_level_table(KE, "configural"); R <- tab$rows[, names(tab$rows) != "fidx"]
  R$tie[R$g == 1 & R$type == "lambda" & R$i %in% 1:2] <- 777L; mg2_table(tab$K, 1L, R) })
mg2h_dom <- c(D2 = mg2h_ref(mg2h_tb, rep(.3, mg2h_tb$npar)), D3 = mg2h_ref(mg2h_tnb, rep(.3, mg2h_tnb$npar)),
              D4 = mg2h_ref(mg2h_tdu, rep(.3, mg2h_tdu$npar)))
cat("D1 certified:", mg2h_d1, "\n"); print(mg2h_dom)
mg2h_v3b <- mg2h_res$V3a[!grepl("^s_", mg2h_res$point)]
cat(sprintf("V3b (reported at s points): min over g, i, f points %.3g; s points %s\n", min(mg2h_v3b),
            paste(signif(mg2h_res$V3a[grepl("^s_", mg2h_res$point)], 3), collapse = ", ")))
cat("V4 max gap per mutant over points:", signif(apply(mg2h_res[, paste0("M", 1:5)], 2, max), 3), "\n")
stopifnot(all(mg2h_res$D0 <= 1e-13),                                                    # D0
          all(mg2h_d1),                                                                 # D1
          grepl("c1", mg2h_dom[["D2"]]), grepl("c2", mg2h_dom[["D3"]]), grepl("c3", mg2h_dom[["D4"]]),  # D2-D4
          all(mg2h_res$V0_sym), all(mg2h_res$V0_diag), all(mg2h_res$V0_inv),           # V0
          all(mg2h_res$V1 <= 1e-12), all(mg2h_res$V1b <= 1e-12),                        # V1, V1b
          all(mg2h_res$V2_R <= 1e-12), all(mg2h_res$V2_J <= 1e-12),                     # V2
          all(mg2h_res$V3a <= 1e-6), all(mg2h_v3b >= 1e-10), all(mg2h_res$V3c <= 1e-7), # V3a-c
          all(apply(mg2h_res[, paste0("M", 1:5)], 2, max) >= 1e-9))                     # V4
```

**Outcomes (R 4.5.2, one recorded run, 2026-10-19; no chunk changed after it). Every item held.**

| Item | Outcome |
|---|---|
| D0 | held: ≤ 5.4e-16·max\|σ\| |
| D1–D4 | held: E certified at all four levels; the β table is refused naming c1 (and c2), the two-factor table without β names c2, and the within-group tie names c3 |

**What this shows.** The closed form agrees with two independent controls to rounding. Both
finite-difference routines differ from it by their measured noise, about 1e-8 (as TS4 placed it). The
domain check refuses β. These are R figures on design E's points, not Stata's.

**Coordinates.** `test_sens_t3`'s metric and scalar fits use `dwlsmv_levelgen`'s metric and scalar
