**The pieces, from the export:** θ̂; s; w = 1/diag(Ω), as `dwlsmv_sens_t3_core`; Δ_c (`Dl`); Ē (`Eb`, ε₅ = 2u);
J (`Jm`, exact path); ∂Δ (`dD`, exact path); a (`shift_a`); n_T = N − G; ε_max = max|eps|.
**From R, labelled:**
- the closed-form Δ (`mg2_delta`) at θ̂;
- the emulations used only for the synthetic redraw at θ′: `mg2h_deltac` for production's Δ_c and `tg_Ebar`
  for `dwlsmv_sens_ebar`. Their gap to Stata's at θ̂ is reported (`Dc_emul`, `Eb_emul`).

Ē↑, |r|↑ and |Δ_c|↑ are first-order upper values over ‖θ′ − θ‖∞ ≤ δ∞, and |Δ_c|↑ includes Δ_c's own redraw.
B_g's form, constants, grid, seeds and pass rule are unchanged from the first run.

```{r tg-sens-setup}
# Depends on: mg-t3-setup, mg2-levels, mg2-sigma, mg2h-core. Production coordinates throughout.
tg_lev <- c(metric = "loadings", scalar = "intercepts")       # Stata's level -> this file's (export_sens_hess_ref.R)
tg_case <- c(metric_full = "metric", scalar_full = "scalar", metric_none = "metric", metric_bigeps = "metric")
tg_ref_theta <- function(file, cs) {                           # Stata's Theta from a committed reference
  L <- readLines(file); i0 <- grep("^real colvector st3_ref_theta", L)
  ln <- grep(sprintf('cs == "%s"', cs), L[i0:length(L)], value = TRUE, fixed = TRUE)[1]
  as.numeric(strsplit(sub(".*return\\(\\((.*)\\)'\\).*", "\\1", ln), ", ")[[1]])
}
tg_ref4 <- "../../tests/unit/sens_t3_ref_s18_p4.mata"            # the reference of the export point (s18, 4 processors)
tg_in   <- function(cs) file.path("../../docs/notes/tg-sens", paste0("in_", cs, ".csv"))
tg_md5  <- c(metric_full = "7212e4b036639da8325839c85615a316", scalar_full = "745ebb8a5400f22cba9036e4c4865eb0",
             metric_none = "d37e3c6c3b200a45ea9b67bebaf683c2", metric_bigeps = "73efb591940bb1f8fcb87233ebd20407")
tg_hx <- function(s) vapply(s, function(z) {                     # Stata's %21x, as tools/export_sens_t3_ref.R reads it
  m <- regmatches(z, regexec("^([+-])([01])\\.([0-9a-f]+)X([+-][0-9a-f]+)$", z))[[1]]
  dg <- strtoi(strsplit(m[4], "")[[1]], 16L)
  if (m[3] == "0" && all(dg == 0)) return(0)
  ex <- if (m[3] == "0") -1022 else strtoi(substring(m[5], 2), 16L) * (if (substr(m[5], 1, 1) == "-") -1 else 1)
  (if (m[2] == "-") -1 else 1) * (as.integer(m[3]) + sum(dg * 16^-seq_along(dg))) * 2^ex }, 0, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
stopifnot(tg_hx(c("+1.0000000000000X+000", "-1.8000000000000X-001", "+0.0000000000000X-3ff")) == c(1, -0.75, 0))
tg_rd <- function(f) {                                         # the export, one matrix per name
  d <- read.csv(f, header = FALSE, colClasses = "character", col.names = c("nm", "i", "j", "hex"))
  d$i <- as.integer(d$i); d$j <- as.integer(d$j); d$v <- tg_hx(d$hex)
  lapply(split(d, d$nm), function(z) { M <- matrix(NA_real_, max(z$i), max(z$j)); M[cbind(z$i, z$j)] <- z$v
    stopifnot(!anyNA(M)); M })
}
tg_Ebar <- function(tab, th, Dc, epsV = 2 * t3_u) {            # dwlsmv_sens_ebar, line for line
  R <- tab$rows; Dg <- mg2_Dg(tab); off <- mg2_off(tab); sg <- mg2_sigma(tab, th)
  Eb <- matrix(0, length(sg), tab$npar)
  for (i in which(R$free & R$type %in% c("lambda", "psi", "beta"))) {
    g <- R$g[i]; j <- R$fidx[i]; h <- 1e-5 * max(1, abs(th[j])); nTg <- sum(tab$K[[g]] - 1L)
    rws <- off[g] + nTg + seq_len(Dg[g] - nTg)
    Eb[rws, j] <- Eb[rws, j] + (epsV * abs(sg[rws]) + t3_u * (abs(th[j]) + h) * abs(Dc[rws, j])) / h
  }
  Eb
}
tg_Ebar_up <- function(tab, th, Dcu, sgu, dinf, epsV = 2 * t3_u) {   # Ebar's upper value over ||theta'-theta|| <= dinf
  R <- tab$rows; Dg <- mg2_Dg(tab); off <- mg2_off(tab); Eb <- matrix(0, length(sgu), tab$npar)
  for (i in which(R$free & R$type %in% c("lambda", "psi", "beta"))) {
    g <- R$g[i]; j <- R$fidx[i]; nTg <- sum(tab$K[[g]] - 1L); rws <- off[g] + nTg + seq_len(Dg[g] - nTg)
    hu <- 1e-5 * max(1, abs(th[j]) + dinf); hl <- 1e-5 * max(1, abs(th[j]) - dinf)
    Eb[rws, j] <- Eb[rws, j] + (epsV * sgu[rws] + t3_u * (abs(th[j]) + dinf + hu) * Dcu[rws, j]) / hl
  }
  Eb
}
tg_gbar <- function(tab, th, Dc, w, Eb, emax, s) {
  r <- s - mg2_sigma(tab, th)
  abs(drop(crossprod(Dc, w * r))) + drop(crossprod(Eb, w * abs(r))) + emax * drop(crossprod(abs(Dc), w * abs(r)))
}
tg_parts <- function(cs, Th = tg_ref_theta(tg_ref4, cs)) {     # Stata's own point: the export, and every fixed piece
  f <- tg_in(cs); stopifnot(unname(tools::md5sum(f)) == tg_md5[[cs]])
  X <- tg_rd(f); tab <- mg2_level_table(KE, tg_lev[[tg_case[[cs]]]])
  th <- drop(X$th); s <- drop(X$s); w <- 1 / diag(X$Om)        # W = 1/diag(Omega), as dwlsmv_sens_t3_core
  q <- length(th); Dc <- X$Dl                                    # production's Delta_c at theta-hat
  aDd <- Reduce(`+`, lapply(seq_len(q), function(l) abs(X$dD[, ((l - 1) * q + 1):(l * q)])))   # sum_l |dDelta/dtheta_l| (exact path)
  emax <- max(abs(X$eps)); Eb <- X$Eb
  list(cs = cs, tab = tab, th = th, s = s, w = w, Dc = Dc, D = mg2_delta(tab, th), r = s - mg2_sigma(tab, th),
       aDd = aDd, Eb = Eb, emax = emax, J = X$Jm, a = X$shift_a[1, 1], nT = X$N[1, 1] - X$G[1, 1], Th = Th,
       gb = tg_gbar(tab, th, Dc, w, Eb, emax, s), sg = drop(X$sg), T3 = X$T3[1, 1])
}
tg_bracket <- function(p, dinf, einf, w = p$w) {              # per l: the bracket of B_g / (2 a nT); $floor its redraw part
  q <- length(p$th); one <- rep(1, q); aD <- abs(p$D); ar <- abs(p$r)
  dr  <- drop(aD %*% one) * dinf; aru <- ar + dr                 # |r| upper value
  sgu <- abs(mg2_sigma(p$tab, p$th)) + dr
  # Ebar' reads |Delta_c'| <= |Delta_c| + aDd dinf + Ebar + Ebar': linear in Ebar' with coefficient
  # bm = max_j u (|theta_j| + dinf + h_j) / h_j, so Ebar' <= Ebar_up(|Delta_c| + aDd dinf + Ebar) / (1 - bm)
  hu <- 1e-5 * pmax(1, abs(p$th) + dinf); hl <- 1e-5 * pmax(1, abs(p$th) - dinf)
  bm <- max(t3_u * (abs(p$th) + dinf + hu) / hl)
  D0u <- abs(p$Dc) + p$aDd * dinf
  Ebu <- tg_Ebar_up(p$tab, p$th, D0u + (dinf > 0) * p$Eb, sgu, dinf) / (1 - bm)
  Dcu <- D0u + (dinf > 0) * (p$Eb + Ebu)                         # |Delta_c| upper value: smooth move plus its redraw
  fl  <- (dinf > 0) * drop(crossprod(p$Eb + Ebu, w * aru))       # (E' - E)'W r': the zeroth-order redraw
  br  <- drop(abs(p$J) %*% one) * dinf + fl +
         drop(crossprod(p$Eb, w * dr)) +                         # E'W(r' - r)
         einf * drop(crossprod(Dcu, w * aru)) +                  # Delta_c'(eps o w o r')
         drop(crossprod(Ebu - p$Eb, w * aru)) + drop(crossprod(p$Eb, w * dr)) +   # delta(Ebar'W|r|)
         einf * drop(crossprod(Ebu, w * aru)) +
         p$emax * (drop(crossprod(Dcu - abs(p$Dc), w * aru)) + drop(crossprod(abs(p$Dc), w * dr)) +
                   einf * drop(crossprod(Dcu, w * aru)))         # emax delta(|Delta_c|'W|r|)
  list(br = br, floor = fl)
}
tg_B <- function(p, dinf, einf) { b <- tg_bracket(p, dinf, einf); c(B = sum(p$Th * b$br), F = sum(p$Th * b$floor)) }
tg_P <- setNames(lapply(names(tg_case), tg_parts), names(tg_case))
# The correspondence and F5, executable: npar = length(theta-hat) = length(Theta); sigma at Stata's theta-hat
# (mg2_sigma) against Stata's own sg (F5, parameterization-free). Reported, not asserted: the R emulations
# the synthetic redraw uses (mg2h_deltac, tg_Ebar) against Stata's Delta_c and Ebar at the same point, and
# Stata's ghat_c.
tg_corr <- t(sapply(tg_P, function(p) {
  c(npar = p$tab$npar, nth = length(p$th), nTheta = length(p$Th),
    F5_sigma = max(abs(mg2_sigma(p$tab, p$th) - p$sg)) / max(abs(p$sg)),
    Dc_emul = max(abs(mg2h_deltac(p$tab, p$th) - p$Dc)) / max(abs(p$Dc)),
    Eb_emul = max(abs(tg_Ebar(p$tab, p$th, p$Dc) - p$Eb)) / max(abs(p$Eb)),
    gh_c = max(abs(crossprod(p$Dc, p$w * p$r))), emax = p$emax) }))
print(signif(tg_corr, 3))
stopifnot(tg_corr[, "npar"] == tg_corr[, "nth"], tg_corr[, "npar"] == tg_corr[, "nTheta"],
          tg_corr[c("metric_full", "scalar_full"), "npar"] == c(27, 23), tg_corr[, "F5_sigma"] < 1e-6)   # F5
```

```{r tg-sens-synthetic}
# TG-D, the implementation's validation: random directions at ||delta||_inf = d, Delta_c redrawn at theta'
# (mg2h_deltac), w moved by up to 3 ulps; |delta m| <= B_g / (2 a nT) on every draw. Reported: the redraw
# floor's share of B_g, the relative change |delta m| / m, and the most signs of ghat_c that flip.
tg_syn <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tg_P, function(p) {
  m0 <- sum(p$gb * p$Th); gh0 <- drop(crossprod(p$Dc, p$w * p$r))
  do.call(rbind, lapply(c(0, 1e-15, 1e-14, 1e-13, 1e-12, 1e-11, 1e-10), function(d) {
    set.seed(4100 + round(-log10(max(d, 1e-17))))
    z <- t(replicate(50, {
      u <- runif(length(p$th), -1, 1); th2 <- p$th + d * u / max(abs(u))
      w2 <- p$w * (1 + 3 * t3_u * sample(c(-1, 0, 1), length(p$w), TRUE))
      Dc2 <- if (d > 0) mg2h_deltac(p$tab, th2) else p$Dc
      Eb2 <- if (d > 0) tg_Ebar(p$tab, th2, Dc2) else p$Eb
      m2 <- sum(tg_gbar(p$tab, th2, Dc2, w2, Eb2, p$emax, p$s) * p$Th)
      gh2 <- drop(crossprod(Dc2, w2 * (p$s - mg2_sigma(p$tab, th2))))
      c(dm = abs(m2 - m0), flips = sum(sign(gh2) != sign(gh0)))
    }))
    b <- tg_B(p, d, 3 * t3_u)
    data.frame(case = p$cs, d = d, max_over_B = max(z[, "dm"]) / b[["B"]], rel_change = max(z[, "dm"]) / m0,
               floor_share = b[["F"]] / b[["B"]], flips = max(z[, "flips"]))
  }))
}))
print(tg_syn, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
stopifnot(all(tg_syn$max_over_B <= 1))                                       # TG-D (set before running)
```

```{r tg-sens-records}
# TG-R and TG-F, in check 6's units: B_g / (1 + |T3|) against s_g x (relative beta_2 change) x beta_2.
# The rows are prior information, read before the freeze (E-041 section 2).
# Base fit of R1 and R2: s16 scalar_full at 1 processor; every point is a refit on F1's Stage 1, so eps = 0.
tg_rows <- local({ b2 <- 2.9557686010699719e-12; T3 <- 17.422315807072589
  p <- tg_P$scalar_full; ulp <- function(x) 2^-52 * 2^floor(log2(x))
  rbind(
    data.frame(item = "R1", case = "scalar_full", dlo = 1.7e-12, dhi = 1.7e-12 * (1 + max(abs(p$th))),
               gap = 2.72e-11, sglo = 0.90, sghi = 0.90, beta2 = b2, T3 = T3, floor_item = FALSE),
    data.frame(item = paste0("R2.", 1:7), case = "scalar_full",
               dlo = c(ulp(min(abs(p$th))), 1e-15, 1e-14, 1e-13, 1e-12, 1e-11, 1e-10),
               dhi = c(ulp(max(abs(p$th))), 1e-15, 1e-14, 1e-13, 1e-12, 1e-11, 1e-10),
               gap = c(4.5e-10, 4.8e-10, 1.5e-11, 7.5e-10, 1.4e-9, 1.9e-9, 2.15e-8),
               sglo = c(0, rep(0.49, 6)), sghi = 1, beta2 = b2, T3 = T3, floor_item = c(rep(TRUE, 4), rep(FALSE, 3))))
})
tg_classify <- function(rows, P = tg_P, einf = 0) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(rows)), function(i) { x <- rows[i, ]; p <- P[[x$case]]
    k <- 2 * p$a * p$nT / (1 + abs(x$T3)); lo <- k * tg_B(p, x$dlo, einf); hi <- k * tg_B(p, x$dhi, einf)
    olo <- x$sglo * x$gap * x$beta2; ohi <- x$sghi * x$gap * x$beta2
    r <- if (ohi <= lo[["B"]]) "holds" else if (olo > hi[["B"]] * (1 + 1e-9)) "fails" else "unresolved"
    f <- if (!x$floor_item) NA else if (ohi <= lo[["F"]]) "floor-explained" else
         if (olo > hi[["F"]] * (1 + 1e-9)) "floor-unexplained" else "unresolved"
    data.frame(item = x$item, obs_lo = olo, obs_hi = ohi, B_lo = lo[["B"]], B_hi = hi[["B"]],
               F_lo = lo[["F"]], F_hi = hi[["F"]], TG_R = r, TG_F = f)
  }))
}
tg_reading <- function(cl) {                                   # prereg section 5's partition
  R <- if (any(cl$TG_R == "fails")) "fails" else if (all(cl$TG_R == "holds")) "holds" else "unresolved"
  ff <- cl$TG_F[!is.na(cl$TG_F)]
  Fr <- if (any(ff == "floor-unexplained")) "floor-unexplained" else
        if (all(ff == "floor-explained")) "floor-explained" else "unresolved"
  c(TG_R = R, TG_F = Fr, settled = R == "holds" && Fr == "floor-explained")
}
# Smoke (F1): every observed change set to 0 must read holds and floor-explained.
tg_smoke <- tg_classify(transform(tg_rows, gap = 0)); print(tg_smoke, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
stopifnot(all(tg_smoke$TG_R == "holds"), all(tg_smoke$TG_F[tg_rows$floor_item] == "floor-explained"),
          tg_reading(tg_smoke)[["settled"]] == "TRUE")
# F5 is tg-sens-setup's F5_sigma (asserted there). The point is the StataMP 18 four-processor export,
# standing in for the Stata 16 one-processor fit of R1 and R2 (A6: s16_p4 and s18_p4 agree to about 1e-14).
tg_read <- FALSE                                               # TRUE only at the frozen run
if (tg_read) {
  tg_cl <- tg_classify(tg_rows); print(tg_cl, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE); print(tg_reading(tg_cl))
}
```

### β under multiple groups: identification, rank, scale and inference {#sec-mg-beta}

*Drafted by cloud task R (read-only) from `5b6fd34`. Its own runs (a numpy port of `mg2_*`; then the chunks once in R 4.3.3 with
lavaan 0.6.17 and a shim for `lav_con_eq_basis`) are not evidence. The hypotheses and bounds in the chunk headers were written
into the chunks before the main session's run, after the drafter's exploration; labels say which bounds were set before
measuring and which after the drafter's numpy scratch. One hypothesis (H-I3) was restated after the drafter's scratch run showed
its first form wrong; the chunk header records both.*

*Executed record (2026-10-10, main session, R 4.6.0, lavaan 0.7.2, after every earlier chunk of this document): every
preregistered assertion held except **H-L5** (`mgb-lavaan`), which failed and is kept as a failure in its chunk.
`mgb-infer` and `mgb-checks` first ran after that failure, in diagnostic mode; what they show held as predicted but is not
preregistered evidence. Evidence: E-005, 2026-10-10.*

**Decisions taken on this section (user, 2026-10-10; spec §4.8 O2, O4).** R-Q1: a later group's endogenous $\psi$ follows
the $B=0$ rule in generated and carried-forward texts; user texts get no Module 3 rule, the rank check arbitrates. R-Q2: no
$\beta$ ties in 0.3.0 (O4 stays $\tau$, $\lambda$); cross-group $\beta$ comparison is a Wald test on `e(b)`, `e(V)`. R-Q3: untied
$\beta$ is admitted in user-written `groups` texts at any level, Module 3 checking no level condition (scope (B) revised on
`mgb-rank`). R-Q4: deferred with any $\beta$-tie lift. R-Q5: $\alpha$ posted as stored, $\kappa$ not posted. R-Q6: help text only for
the SE inflation of Result B5. **The tied-$\beta$ material below (B3 (ii), B6's tie, B7's escape, H-B5d, check 8's closure)
is mathematics kept for a later lift; no 0.3.0 text can reach it.**

This section is the derivation behind lifting O2 for β (spec §4.8 O2, scope (B), decided 2026-10-10; Module 12 *Architecture
principles* 3): identification and rank under groups with $B\neq0$ at the metric and scalar levels, a reference-tool check,
the guard's range, and what check 8 and check 11 see. It does not touch DIFFTEST's validity, which is task S's.

**Scope.** Delta parameterization; $G=2$; the four levels of @sec-invariance-id (its "loadings" level is called *metric* here
and its "intercepts" level *scalar*); simple structure, one free loading per item (tied where the level ties it); $F\ge2$ factors;
structural paths $B_g$ recursive (acyclic), disturbance covariances fixed at 0 (no off-diagonal $\psi$ row); each $\beta$ row free
in both groups (**free**), one $\theta$ element across groups (**tied**; needs O4 lifted), free in one group, or fixed. Group 1 is the
reference with $\psi_{1ff}=1$ **fixed, the disturbance variance** (spec §4.8). For $g\ge2$: $\nu,\omega,\alpha$ and $\psi_{gff}$ as the level
table, **with $\psi_{gff}$ the disturbance variance of factor $f$**. Conditional, as in @sec-invariance-id, on the configural model being
locally identified. Not covered: $G>2$, cross-loadings, $\psi_{fh}$ free beside $\beta$ (Finding 4), marker metric, non-recursive $B$.

#### Notation

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $\mathrm{pa}(f)$ | the factors with a path into $f$ in the table (free, tied or nonzero) |
| $A_g=(I-B_g)^{-1}$, $\Phi_g=A_g\Psi_gA_g'$, $\kappa_g=A_g\alpha_g$ | as @sec-mg-sigma-delta; $\Psi_g$ diagonal |
| mode factor | a factor $f$, $g\ge2$, with no polytomous item and (metric) $\psi_{gff}$ free, or (scalar) its binary thresholds on I5's set |
| scale mode $n_{gf}$ | the null direction of rescaling factor $f$ in group $g$ (Result B5) |
| $c_{gf}$ | the *convention scale* of $f$ in group $g$ (Result B6): 1 if $f$ has a polytomous item, $\sqrt{\psi^0_{gff}}$ if all binary |

#### Results

**Result B1 (reduction).** By MS1, $\sigma_g$ depends on $(B_g,\Psi_g,\alpha_g)$ only through $(\Phi_g,\kappa_g)$ (and on $\Lambda_g,\omega_g,\nu_g,\tau$).
Hence $\Delta=\Delta_{(\Phi,\kappa)}\,J$ with $J=\partial(\Phi,\kappa)/\partial(\beta,\psi,\alpha)$ (ties summed, MS3), and
$\alpha$ of an endogenous factor is an **intercept**: $\kappa_g=(I-B_g)^{-1}\alpha_g$, so with one path $1\to2$, $\kappa_{g,2}=\alpha_{g,2}+\beta_g\alpha_{g,1}$. The
threshold part of a $\beta_{ab}$ column in MS2, $-\omega_j\kappa_b(L)_{ja}$, is $\kappa_b$ times the threshold part of $\alpha_a$'s column, $-\omega_j(L)_{ja}$.

**Lemma B2 (recursive regressions are injective).** For acyclic $B_g$ and diagonal $\Psi_g$, $(\beta,\psi,\alpha)\mapsto(\Phi,\kappa)$ has a smooth left inverse
on positive definite $\Phi$, so $J$ has full column rank. *Proof.* In a topological order, $\zeta_f$ is uncorrelated with every factor that is not a descendant of $f$
(it is a function of $\zeta$'s of its own ancestors, and $\Psi$ is diagonal), so the normal equations of $F_f$ on its parents involve $\Phi$ only:
$\beta_{f,\mathrm{pa}}=\Phi_{\mathrm{pa},\mathrm{pa}}^{-1}\Phi_{\mathrm{pa},f}$, $\psi_{ff}=\Phi_{ff}-\beta_{f,\mathrm{pa}}'\Phi_{\mathrm{pa},f}$, and $\alpha=(I-B)\kappa$. $\square$ (A tie is a linear selection of columns, so
injectivity survives it.)

**Result B3 (rank, and the null space when it is deficient).** *Assumption (A)* (the factor-wise extension of Results I2, I3, I5 to factors with free covariances;
used to explain the deficiency counts, which the grid measures rather than proves for every graph): in the level-$L$ model whose $\Phi_g$ ($g\ge2$) is an
unrestricted positive definite matrix and whose every $\Phi_{gff}$ is free, the null space of $\Delta$ at a generic point is spanned by the scale modes $n_{gf}$ of
the all-binary factors (metric level), and at the scalar level only at points where the factor's binary thresholds satisfy $\tau_j/\lambda_j=c$ (I5).
Then, by B1 and B2, the null space of the $\beta$ model is $\{\sum_f u_f\,n_{gf}\}$ restricted to the $u$ for which $J^{-1}\sum u_fn_{gf}$ respects the table:
(i) $u_f=0$ if $\psi_{gff}$ is fixed, because $n_{gf}$ moves $\psi_{gff}$ by $-2u_f\psi_{gff}$; (ii) along a tied path $a\leftarrow b$ with $\beta\neq0$, $u_a=u_b$, because the modes move
$\beta_{ab}$ by $-\beta_{ab}(u_a-u_b)$ in group 2 only; (iii) no other constraint. With the **generator's rule** ($\psi_{gff}$ free iff $f$ has a polytomous item) there is
no mode factor at the metric level, so $\Delta$ has full column rank for every $\beta$ mode of the table (free, tied, one group, fixed). **Lost ranks**
$=$ the number of connected sets of mode factors under the tied nonzero paths that contain no factor outside the mode set (`mgb_def_pred`); with untied or one-group $\beta$ (or $\beta=0$) it is the number of mode factors.
An exogenous all-binary factor with $\psi_{gff}$ free loses a rank at the metric level exactly as in Result I2; the outcome factor is no exception.

**Result B4 (degrees of freedom).** With $\mathrm{df}^{(0)}_L$ the value of Result I4 for the table without $\beta$ rows ($F$ factors, simple structure), and $n_\beta$ the number of $\theta$ elements the $\beta$ rows add
($G$ per path untied, 1 tied, 1 in one group, 0 fixed),
$$\mathrm{df}_L=\mathrm{df}^{(0)}_L-n_\beta,\qquad
\mathrm{df}^{(0)}=G(p^*-p),\ +(G-1)\sum_j\max(C_j-2,0)\ (\text{thr}),\ +(G-1)(|\mathcal P|-F_+)\ (\text{metric, from thr}),\ +(G-1)(T-2F)\ (\text{scalar, from conf}),$$
with $F$ the number of factors including the endogenous ones (each has a $\psi_{gff}$ and an $\alpha_{gf}$). The loadings step is empty ($d=0$, an equivalent model) exactly when every factor has one polytomous item, with or without $\beta$; a tie adds a step of $d=n_\beta$.

**Result B5 (the scale mode, closed form).** In group 2, let $f$ be a mode factor on I5's set with common ratio $c=\tau_j/\lambda_j$ at the scalar level (at the metric level, no $c$ and no $\alpha$ part). Rescale $F_f\to e^{-u}F_f$ in group 2 only,
$\omega_{2j}\to\omega_{2j}e^{u}$ for $j$ on $f$, and compensate the location by $\kappa_{2f}\mapsto c-e^{-u}(c-\kappa_{2f})$. This leaves every $\sigma$ entry unchanged: $\omega_j(\tau_j-\lambda_j\kappa_f)$ with $\tau_j=c\lambda_j$ is $\omega_j\lambda_j(c-\kappa_f)$, and $\omega e^{u}\cdot e^{-u}$ cancels; $\rho_{ij}=\omega_i\omega_j\lambda_i\lambda_j\Phi_{fh}$ is unchanged because $\Phi_{ff}\to e^{-2u}\Phi_{ff}$, $\Phi_{fh}\to e^{-u}\Phi_{fh}$. To first order in $u$:
$$d\omega_{2j}=\omega_{2j}u\ (j\text{ on }f),\quad d\psi_{2ff}=-2\psi_{2ff}u,\quad d\beta_{2,fh}=-\beta_{2,fh}u\ (\text{paths in}),\quad d\beta_{2,kf}=+\beta_{2,kf}u\ (\text{paths out}),$$
$$d\alpha_{2f}=(c-\alpha_{2f})u,\qquad d\alpha_{2k}=-\beta_{2,kf}\,c\,u\ (\text{children }k\text{ of }f),$$
and zero elsewhere. It is a null vector of $\Delta$. *Derivation:* $\kappa$ is held fixed for every $h\neq f$, so $d\alpha_f=d\kappa_f-\sum_h(d\beta_{fh}\kappa_h)=(c-\kappa_f)u+u\sum_h\beta_{fh}\kappa_h=(c-\alpha_f)u$ and
$d\alpha_k=-(d\beta_{kf}\kappa_f+\beta_{kf}d\kappa_f)=-u\beta_{kf}c$. The outcome's $\beta$ and $\psi$ are in the null vector: near the set their standard errors inflate (by G3's argument, with this vector in place of I5's), so a harm criterion on $\hat\kappa$ alone would miss the loading on the structural parameters of interest.

**Result B6 (what a tied β compares: the answer to the question left open at O2).** Take the untied metric model with the generator's rule, and a true structure $(B^0_g,\Psi^0_g)$ that satisfies metric invariance, with group 1 on the convention ($\psi^0_{1ff}=1$). In group 2 an all-binary
factor $f$ has its scale fixed by $\psi_{2ff}=1$, not by the data: the fitted model is the truth with $F_f$ replaced by $F_f/c_{2f}$, $c_{2f}=\sqrt{\psi^0_{2ff}}$ (the *disturbance* SD, also for an outcome), and $\omega_{2j}$ replaced by $\omega_{2j}c_{2f}$. A factor with a polytomous item keeps its true scale, $c=1$.
Hence the fitted slope on a path $a\leftarrow b$ is $\beta^0_{2,ab}\,c_{2b}/c_{2a}$, and a tie $\beta_{1,ab}=\beta_{2,ab}$ is the hypothesis
$$\beta^0_{1,ab}=\beta^0_{2,ab}\;c_{2b}/c_{2a}.$$
It is raw equality of slopes iff $c_{2b}=c_{2a}$, which holds when both factors have a polytomous item. With both factors all binary and $\psi_{1}=\psi_2=1$ it is equality of the latent correlation. **At the scalar level** every factor off its I5 set has
$\Phi_{gff}$ identified (Result I3), so $c\equiv1$ and the tie is raw equality. *Identification of the model is therefore not the same as identification of the comparison:* the former holds in every cell of the grid; the latter needs a polytomous item (metric) or an r-spread (scalar) on both factors of the path. The same scale argument
applies to a raw difference $\hat\beta_{1}-\hat\beta_{2}$ of untied slopes (the Wald route of R-Q2): comparability is a property of the
path's two factors, not of the level, and the scalar level alone does not guarantee it (R-Q3's help wording).

**Result B7 (Module 3's rank check).** The starts are $\lambda=.7$, $\beta=0$, $\psi=1$, $\nu=0$, $\omega=1$, $\alpha=0$, $\tau$ at group 1's sample thresholds; $\theta^{(2)}$ perturbs every free $\lambda,\beta,\psi$ (O7, literal), $\beta$ included. By B3: at the metric level the generator's rule is full rank at both points for every threshold; at the scalar level
$\theta^{(0)}$ is deficient exactly when the sample thresholds of an all-binary factor's items give equal $\tau_j/\lambda_j$ (with $\lambda=.7$: equal sample thresholds), by the number of such factors; $\theta^{(2)}$ leaves the set when the common threshold is nonzero (the $\lambda$ shifts), and for a **tied** $\beta$ also when it is zero,
because $\theta^{(2)}$ has $\beta\neq0$ (condition (ii)). A tied-$\beta$ model that passes only at $\theta^{(2)}$ is identified only off $\beta=0$; its conditioning is proportional to $|\beta|$ near 0 (chunk `mgb-start`) and Module 10's criterion ($10^{-8}$) trips only for $|\beta|$ below about $10^{-7}$ (extrapolating $\sigma_{\min}/\sigma_{\max}\approx.13|\beta|$). Perturbing $\lambda,\psi$ but not $\beta$ leaves the tied model deficient (`mgb-start`, H-B5d): the escape is the $\beta$ entries of the O7 rule. In 0.3.0 no tied $\beta$ can be written (R-Q2), so for every admissible text $\theta^{(0)}$ and $\theta^{(2)}$ are deficient alike (`mgb-start`, untied rows) and the escape is unreachable (R-Q4 deferred).

**Result B8 (inference).** $T=(N-G)F$, $\mathrm{e}(V)=\mathrm{ACOV}/(N-G)$ and weighting (a) are unchanged: MG1–MG6 use $\Delta$ only as a stacked matrix with tied columns, and B1 changes its columns, not their role. $T_3=aT+b$ depends on $\Delta$ through $\operatorname{col}(\Delta)$ alone ($U$ projects it off), the traces being $q\times q$ reductions (MG4) invariant to a reparameterization of the columns; $\mathrm{vcov}$ depends on the columns. T3 and `e(V)` for untied $\beta$ ($G=2$) are established by the preregistered `mgb-infer-prereg` (2026-10-10, gate passed; the earlier `mgb-infer` run was diagnostic). MG7's $\hat h$ weighting for $\beta$ pairs is not established: task S (2026-10-10, E-004) read `REPRODUCED: A` in all four primary cells, but its lift criterion failed on agreement in design M (near-zero statistics against lavaan values rounded to $10^{-10}$), so a new preregistered study decides it. The follow-up (2026-10-10, E-004) again read `REPRODUCED: A` in all four, with every size cell inside, but its criterion was not met: one replication at a statistic of $1.08	imes10^{-7}$ exceeded the relative tolerance (MIXED).

**Result B9 (checks 11 and 8).** *Check 11.* Rule (a) tests $\Psi_g$ (disturbances), and $\Phi_g=A_g\Psi_gA_g'$ is singular iff $\Psi_g$ is, so an endogenous unit-variance factor is right already. Rule (b) uses $\Theta_{g,jj}=1-\omega_{gj}^2(\Lambda\Phi_g\Lambda')_{jj}$ with group $g$'s own $B_g$ and $\mathrm{Anc}_j$; a tied $\beta$ is free and so never determined (G2), and a boundary
forced through a free $\beta$ is not refused. C11-4 is about generated, $B=0$ chains and is unchanged. *Check 8.* Principle 5's "tied in $H_0$, untied in $H_1$" is nested with $d=n_\beta$ if rows are keyed by (group, ptype, row, col), absent rows read at the type default (G4), and the **closure rule** holds: rows that share a $\theta$ element in $H_1$ share one, or are fixed at
the same value, in $H_0$. Without closure a pair that is not a restriction can pass a count-and-status check (chunk `mgb-checks`). The level steps are not restrictions of the previous level (they free $\nu,\omega$ rows), so the generated-chain exemption stays.

#### Where this falls outside the singular-case guard's range (principle 3)

The calibration is one all-binary factor, $G=2$, $p\in\{4,6\}$, $B=0$, generated. Every $\beta$ model is outside it: (1) two or more factors; (2) $S_{1w}$'s units are group-1 factor SDs, and an endogenous factor's group-1 metric is the disturbance SD (differing by $\sqrt{\Phi_{1ff}}$);
(3) I5's set is per all-binary factor, endogenous included (B3), up to $F$ lost ranks; (4) a tied $\beta$ cures the set off $\beta=0$ and leaves it at $\beta=0$, with conditioning $\propto|\beta|$; (5) a metric-level conditionally identified case exists (free $\psi$ on an all-binary factor with a tied $\beta$); (6) the null vector (B5) loads on the outcome's $\beta$, $\psi$ and on $\alpha$, not only on $\kappa$, so a $\kappa$-based harm criterion would miss them. No cutoff is proposed.

#### What this section does not establish

$G>2$; cross-loadings; marker metric; non-recursive $B$; $\psi_{fh}$ free beside $\beta$ in a group (Finding 4's deficiency, expected per group, not run); a single-indicator factor; assumption (A) beyond the measured designs; the df count beyond simple structure; lavaan 0.7.2 behaviour beyond the chunks; which of our levels lavaan's `group.equal` route corresponds to (H-L5 failed); the finite-sample validity of the Wald comparison (R-Q2);
DIFFTEST for $\beta$ pairs (task S and its follow-up ran 2026-10-10; neither met the lift criterion); standardised solutions (O17); finite-sample behaviour near a mode.

#### Verification

Chunks in document order, after `mg2-lavdelta`. Designs (`MGB_DESIGNS`, $K$ per item; items 1–3 on $F_1$, the rest on $F_2$ unless stated): **P** all $K=4$; **M** $K=(4,4,2\,|\,4,2,2)$; **B** $F_2$ all binary; **S** $F_1$ all binary; **W** one polytomous item per factor; **Z** all binary, 4 + 4 items; **Y** three factors, $F_1$ polytomous, paths $2\leftarrow1$, $3\leftarrow2$.

Mutants these chunks are built to kill (a mutant that passes is a finding): ψ freed for every factor (`mgb-rank` H-B3); the tie ignored at β = 0 (`mgb-rank` H-B4/`mgb-start`); β left out of θ⁽²⁾ (`mgb-start` H-B5d); α part dropped from the null vector (`mgb-null`);
total-variance instead of disturbance convention for an endogenous binary factor (`mgb-pop`, rows B/TR3 and Z/TR4); zeroed β threshold entries (`mgb-infer`); check 8 without closure (`mgb-checks`).

```{r mgb-core}
# Depends on: inv-setup (INV_TOL, inv_rank, inv_tau), mg2-core (mg2_row, mg2_table, mg2_pars, mg2_sigma,
# mg2_delta, mg2_dcols, mg2_Dg, mg2_off, mg2_thetastar, mg2_thr_rows), mg2-start (mg2_ratio),
# mg2-start2 (MG2_PHI, mg2_second, mg2_rk, mg2_tau0). Every name defined here starts with mgb_ or MGB_.
# Executed 2026-10-10 by the main session (R 4.6.0, lavaan 0.7.2); held as predicted.
stopifnot(exists("mg2_second"), exists("mg2_rk"), exists("mg2_tau0"), exists("inv_tau"))

# Designs (G = 2 throughout). fac maps items to factors; every design is simple structure.
MGB_DESIGNS <- list(
  P = list(K = rep(4L, 6),                  fac = c(1L, 1L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 2L)),                # all polytomous
  M = list(K = c(4L, 4L, 2L, 4L, 2L, 2L),   fac = c(1L, 1L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 2L)),                # mixed: each factor has a polytomous and a binary item
  B = list(K = c(4L, 4L, 4L, 2L, 2L, 2L),   fac = c(1L, 1L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 2L)),                # the outcome F2 is all binary
  S = list(K = c(2L, 2L, 2L, 4L, 4L, 4L),   fac = c(1L, 1L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 2L)),                # the predictor F1 is all binary
  W = list(K = c(4L, 2L, 2L, 4L, 2L, 2L),   fac = c(1L, 1L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 2L)),                # exactly one polytomous item per factor (the empty loadings step)
  Z = list(K = rep(2L, 8),                  fac = c(1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L)),         # every item binary, two factors
  Y = list(K = c(4L, 4L, 4L, rep(2L, 6)),   fac = rep(1:3, each = 3L)))                       # three factors; F1 polytomous; paths 2<-1, 3<-2
MGB_YPATHS <- list(c(2L, 1L), c(3L, 2L))
MGB_LEVELS <- c("configural", "thresholds", "metric", "scalar")

# The table of a user-written beta text. paths: list of c(to, from). beta, one entry per path (recycled):
#   free   a free beta in each group, untied     tied   one theta element, tied across the groups (needs O4 lifted)
#   g2only free in group 2, absent in group 1    g1only the reverse     none  no row     fixed  fixed at bval in both
# psi (metric level only): "gen" = a later group's psi_ff is free iff factor f has a polytomous item (the
# generator's rule for an exogenous factor, with psi read as the DISTURBANCE variance); "fixed", "free", or a
# logical vector with one entry per factor. fixlam = list(item, val): that loading fixed in every group, untied.
mgb_table <- function(K, fac, level, beta = "free", paths = list(c(2L, 1L)), psi = "gen",
                      fixlam = NULL, nfac = max(fac), bval = 0.4) {
  stopifnot(level %in% MGB_LEVELS)
  beta <- rep_len(beta, length(paths)); stopifnot(all(beta %in% c("free", "tied", "g2only", "g1only", "none", "fixed")))
  p <- length(K); C <- K - 1L
  poly <- vapply(seq_len(nfac), function(f) any(K[fac == f] > 2L), NA)
  tied_tau <- level != "configural"; tied_lam <- level %in% c("metric", "scalar")
  tid <- function(j, k) 1000L * j + k; lid <- function(j) 90000L + j; bid <- function(a, b) 95000L + 10L * a + b
  rw <- list(); add <- function(x) rw[[length(rw) + 1L]] <<- x
  for (g in 1:2) {
    for (j in seq_len(p)) for (k in seq_len(C[j]))
      add(mg2_row(g, "tau", j, k, tie = if (tied_tau) tid(j, k) else NA_integer_))
    for (j in seq_len(p)) {
      fx <- !is.null(fixlam) && j == fixlam$item
      add(mg2_row(g, "lambda", j, fac[j], free = !fx, val = if (fx) fixlam$val else 0,
                  tie = if (tied_lam && !fx) lid(j) else NA_integer_))
    }
    for (ip in seq_along(paths)) {
      a <- paths[[ip]][1]; b <- paths[[ip]][2]; bm <- beta[ip]
      if (bm == "none" || (bm == "g2only" && g == 1L) || (bm == "g1only" && g == 2L)) next
      if (bm == "fixed") add(mg2_row(g, "beta", a, b, free = FALSE, val = bval))
      else add(mg2_row(g, "beta", a, b, tie = if (bm == "tied") bid(a, b) else NA_integer_))
    }
    for (f in seq_len(nfac)) {
      if (g == 1L) add(mg2_row(1L, "psi", f, f, free = FALSE, val = 1))
      else {
        fr <- switch(level, scalar = TRUE,
                     metric = if (is.logical(psi)) psi[f] else switch(psi, gen = poly[f], fixed = FALSE, free = TRUE),
                     FALSE)
        add(mg2_row(2L, "psi", f, f, free = fr, val = 1))
      }
    }
    if (g == 2L) {
      if (level %in% c("thresholds", "metric")) for (j in seq_len(p)) add(mg2_row(2L, "nu", j))
      for (j in switch(level, configural = integer(0), thresholds = which(K > 2L), seq_len(p)))
        add(mg2_row(2L, "omega", j))
      if (level == "scalar") for (f in seq_len(nfac)) add(mg2_row(2L, "alpha", f))
    }
  }
  mg2_table(list(K, K), nfac, do.call(rbind, rw))
}

# Result B2 as code: df of the beta model = df of the same table without beta rows (Result I4, F factors,
# simple structure, G = 2) minus the theta elements the beta rows add (2 per path untied, 1 tied or one group).
mgb_df <- function(K, fac, level, nb, G = 2L) {
  p <- length(K); C <- K - 1L; nfac <- max(fac); Pi <- sum(C >= 2L)
  Fp <- sum(vapply(seq_len(nfac), function(f) any(K[fac == f] > 2L), NA))
  inc <- switch(level, configural = 0, thresholds = sum(pmax(C - 2L, 0L)),
                metric = sum(pmax(C - 2L, 0L)) + Pi - Fp, scalar = sum(C) - 2L * nfac)
  G * (p * (p - 1) / 2 - p) + (G - 1L) * inc - nb
}
mgb_nb <- function(beta, np) sum(c(free = 2L, tied = 1L, g2only = 1L, g1only = 1L, none = 0L, fixed = 0L)[rep_len(beta, np)])

# A generic point (deterministic; Theta* > 0 in both groups, asserted where it is used) and Module 3's starts.
mgb_point <- function(tab, bval = 0.4) {
  R <- tab$rows; th <- numeric(tab$npar)
  for (r in which(R$free)) {
    g <- if (is.na(R$tie[r])) R$g[r] else 1L
    th[R$fidx[r]] <- switch(R$type[r],
      tau = -0.8 + 0.55 * R$j[r] + 0.1 * R$i[r] + if (g == 2L) 0.05 else 0,
      lambda = 0.5 + 0.03 * R$i[r], beta = bval, psi = 1, nu = -0.15 + 0.03 * R$i[r],
      omega = 0.9 + 0.02 * R$i[r], alpha = 0.25)
  }
  th
}
mgb_start <- function(tab, tauK) {            # lambda .7, beta 0, psi 1, nu 0, omega 1, alpha 0; a tied tau at group 1's
  R <- tab$rows; th <- numeric(tab$npar)
  for (r in which(R$free)) {
    g <- if (is.na(R$tie[r])) R$g[r] else 1L
    th[R$fidx[r]] <- switch(R$type[r], tau = tauK[[R$i[r]]][R$j[r]] + if (g == 2L) 0.05 else 0,
                            lambda = 0.7, beta = 0, psi = 1, nu = 0, omega = 1, alpha = 0)
  }
  th
}
mgb_def <- function(tab, th) tab$npar - inv_rank(mg2_delta(tab, th))     # rank deficiency at th

# Result B3 as code: the number of lost ranks when the scale of a later group's factor is a free direction.
# modes: factors whose group-2 scale is free (no polytomous item, and psi free at the metric level or on
# I5's set at the scalar level); tied: the paths (to, from) tied across groups whose beta is nonzero at the
# point. A tied nonzero beta forces equal scale factors on its two factors, so a connected set of factors
# keeps one mode if every factor in it is a mode, and none otherwise.
mgb_def_pred <- function(modes, tied, nfac) {
  if (!length(modes)) return(0L)
  comp <- seq_len(nfac)
  for (e in tied) { a <- comp[e[1]]; b <- comp[e[2]]; comp[comp == b] <- a }
  sum(vapply(unique(comp[modes]), function(cc) all(which(comp == cc) %in% modes), NA))
}
MGB_LAM <- function(i) 0.5 + 0.03 * i                                      # mgb_point's loading of item i
```

```{r mgb-rank}
# Depends on: mgb-core, inv-setup (inv_rank, INV_TOL), mg2-core (mg2_delta, mg2_thetastar).
# Executed 2026-10-10 by the main session (R 4.6.0, lavaan 0.7.2); held as predicted.
# Hypotheses H-B1 (rank = npar) and H-B2 (df = Result B2), frozen before any run: every cell of designs P, M, B, S, W, Z
# (two factors, path 2<-1) and Y (three factors, paths 2<-1, 3<-2), four levels, beta in {none, free, tied,
# g2only, g1only, fixed}, with the generator's psi rule, at a generic point. Exact integers, no tolerance
# beyond INV_TOL (1e-7, the existing provisional rank ratio).
mgb_cells <- function() {
  out <- list()
  for (dn in names(MGB_DESIGNS)) {
    d <- MGB_DESIGNS[[dn]]; paths <- if (dn == "Y") MGB_YPATHS else list(c(2L, 1L))
    for (l in MGB_LEVELS) for (bm in c("none", "free", "tied", "g2only", "g1only", "fixed"))
      out[[length(out) + 1L]] <- list(dn = dn, K = d$K, fac = d$fac, level = l, beta = bm, paths = paths)
  }
  out
}
mgb_grid <- do.call(rbind, lapply(mgb_cells(), function(ce) {
  tab <- mgb_table(ce$K, ce$fac, ce$level, ce$beta, ce$paths); th <- mgb_point(tab)
  D <- mg2_delta(tab, th)
  stopifnot(all(unlist(mg2_thetastar(tab, th)) > 0))                         # the point is a legal one in both groups
  data.frame(design = ce$dn, level = ce$level, beta = ce$beta, npar = tab$npar, rank = inv_rank(D),
             df = nrow(D) - tab$npar, df_B2 = mgb_df(ce$K, ce$fac, ce$level, mgb_nb(ce$beta, length(ce$paths))),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
stopifnot(mgb_grid$rank == mgb_grid$npar,                                    # H-B1: every cell locally identified
          mgb_grid$df == mgb_grid$df_B2)                                     # H-B2: Result B2
cat(sprintf("mgb-rank: %d cells, rank = npar and df = Result B2 in every one\n", nrow(mgb_grid)))
# The loadings step is empty (d = 0, an equivalent model) when every factor has exactly one polytomous item
# (|P| - F_+ = 0, Result I2's bullet with F factors); beta rows leave that unchanged. Design W, every beta mode.
stopifnot(mgb_grid$df[mgb_grid$design == "W" & mgb_grid$level == "metric"] ==
            mgb_grid$df[mgb_grid$design == "W" & mgb_grid$level == "thresholds"],
          mgb_grid$df[mgb_grid$design == "M" & mgb_grid$level == "metric"] -
            mgb_grid$df[mgb_grid$design == "M" & mgb_grid$level == "thresholds"] == 1L)   # M: |P| - F_+ = 3 - 2, a real step
# Result I4 by hand for design P without beta (F = 2, p = 6, K = 4, T = 18, G = 2): 18, 24, 28, 32
# (configural; + sum(C - 2) = 6; + |P| - F_+ = 6 - 2; + T - 2F = 14 from configural)
stopifnot(mgb_grid$df[mgb_grid$design == "P" & mgb_grid$beta == "none"] == c(18, 24, 28, 32))

# A generic point with the group-1 thresholds of the binary items of the factors in `set` moved onto tau_j = cval * lambda_j.
mgb_set <- function(tab, K, fac, set, cval, bval) {
  th <- mgb_point(tab, bval); R <- tab$rows
  for (r in which(R$free & R$type == "tau" & R$g == 1L & K[R$i] == 2L & fac[R$i] %in% set))
    th[R$fidx[r]] <- cval * MGB_LAM(R$i[r])
  th
}
local({
# H-B3, negative controls (predicted before the run): the generator's rule frees a later group's psi_ff only for
# a factor with a polytomous item. Freeing it on an all-binary factor, an OUTCOME factor included, loses one
# rank per such factor when beta is untied (Result I2's counterexample, with psi the disturbance variance).
# With beta tied across groups and nonzero it is identified through the tie; at beta = 0 the tie is vacuous.
mgb_neg <- list(
  list(d = "B", psi = c(FALSE, TRUE), modes = 2L),                           # outcome all binary, psi_22 free
  list(d = "S", psi = c(TRUE, FALSE), modes = 1L),                           # predictor all binary, psi_11 free
  list(d = "Z", psi = c(TRUE, TRUE),  modes = 1:2))                          # both
for (ng in mgb_neg) {
  d <- MGB_DESIGNS[[ng$d]]
  for (bm in c("free", "g2only", "tied")) for (bv in c(0.4, 0)) {
    tab <- mgb_table(d$K, d$fac, "metric", bm, psi = ng$psi); th <- mgb_point(tab, bv)
    want <- mgb_def_pred(ng$modes, if (bm == "tied" && bv != 0) list(c(2L, 1L)) else list(), 2L)
    stopifnot(mgb_def(tab, th) == want)
  }
}
# the generator's rule on the same designs is full rank at beta = 0 and at beta = .4 (H-B1 ran it at .4)
for (ng in mgb_neg) { d <- MGB_DESIGNS[[ng$d]]
  for (bm in c("free", "tied")) { tab <- mgb_table(d$K, d$fac, "metric", bm); stopifnot(mgb_def(tab, mgb_point(tab, 0)) == 0L) } }

# H-B4: the scalar level. Result I5's set, per factor: an all-binary factor whose binary items share one
# ratio tau_j / lambda_j = c. Set the group-1 thresholds of the listed factors' items on it (tied tau: one theta
# element). Prediction: one lost rank per such factor with beta untied or in one group only; with beta tied and
# nonzero, one per connected set of such factors that contains no other factor; beta = 0 as untied. A factor
# with a polytomous item is never on the set (Result I3), so design M and P are full rank whatever c.
mgb_cells2 <- list(list(d = "Z", set = 1:2), list(d = "Z", set = 2L), list(d = "Z", set = 1L),
              list(d = "B", set = 2L), list(d = "S", set = 1L), list(d = "M", set = 1:2), list(d = "P", set = 1:2))
for (ce in mgb_cells2) {
  d <- MGB_DESIGNS[[ce$d]]
  allbin <- vapply(1:2, function(f) all(d$K[d$fac == f] == 2L), NA)
  modes <- ce$set[allbin[ce$set]]
  for (cval in c(0.4, -0.3, 0)) for (bm in c("free", "g2only", "tied")) for (bv in c(0.4, 0)) {
    tab <- mgb_table(d$K, d$fac, "scalar", bm); th <- mgb_set(tab, d$K, d$fac, ce$set, cval, bv)
    want <- mgb_def_pred(modes, if (bm == "tied" && bv != 0) list(c(2L, 1L)) else list(), 2L)
    stopifnot(mgb_def(tab, th) == want)
  }
}
# a negative control for the prediction itself: moving one item's threshold off the set restores full rank
d <- MGB_DESIGNS$Z; tab <- mgb_table(d$K, d$fac, "scalar", "free"); th <- mgb_set(tab, d$K, d$fac, 1:2, 0.4, 0.4)
r1 <- which(tab$rows$free & tab$rows$type == "tau" & tab$rows$g == 1L & tab$rows$i == 1L)
th2 <- th; th2[tab$rows$fidx[r1]] <- th2[tab$rows$fidx[r1]] + 0.2
stopifnot(mgb_def(tab, th) == 2L, mgb_def(tab, th2) == 1L)
})
```

```{r mgb-rank-y}
# Executed 2026-10-11 by the main session (R 4.6.0, lavaan 0.7.2), once, in a full re-run after the freeze
# (4d50b7d): held as predicted, 24 of 24 cells (E-050).
# Frozen 2026-10-11 before any run. Rank prerequisite of the one-group beta study (user's proposal,
# 2026-10-11): mgb-rank applies ONE beta mode to both of Y's paths, so it covers Y's patterns 5 (g2only, g2only) and
# 6 (g1only, g1only) only. This chunk adds the other six, a mode per path (path 1 = 2<-1, path 2 = 3<-2):
#   1 (g2only, free)  2 (free, g2only)  3 (g1only, free)  4 (free, g1only)  7 (g2only, g1only)  8 (g1only, g2only)
# at the four levels, with the generator's psi rule, at mgb_point's generic point. Hypotheses as mgb-rank, frozen
# here: H-B1 rank = npar; H-B2 df = Result B2 (mgb_df with mgb_nb summed per path: 1 + 2 = 3 for 1-4, 2 for 7, 8);
# and Theta* > 0 in both groups at the point (as mgb-rank asserts). Exact integers, INV_TOL as in mgb-rank.
MGB_YPAT <- list(c("g2only", "free"), c("free", "g2only"), c("g1only", "free"), c("free", "g1only"),
                 c("g2only", "g1only"), c("g1only", "g2only"))
names(MGB_YPAT) <- c("1", "2", "3", "4", "7", "8")
mgb_grid_y <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(MGB_YPAT), function(pn) do.call(rbind, lapply(MGB_LEVELS, function(l) {
  d <- MGB_DESIGNS$Y; bm <- MGB_YPAT[[pn]]
  tab <- mgb_table(d$K, d$fac, l, bm, MGB_YPATHS); th <- mgb_point(tab)
  stopifnot(all(unlist(mg2_thetastar(tab, th)) > 0))
  D <- mg2_delta(tab, th)
  data.frame(pattern = pn, level = l, npar = tab$npar, rank = inv_rank(D), df = nrow(D) - tab$npar,
             df_B2 = mgb_df(d$K, d$fac, l, mgb_nb(bm, 2L)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))))
print(mgb_grid_y)
stopifnot(nrow(mgb_grid_y) == 24L, mgb_grid_y$rank == mgb_grid_y$npar, mgb_grid_y$df == mgb_grid_y$df_B2)
cat("mgb-rank-y: 24 cells, rank = npar and df = Result B2 in every one\n")
```

```{r mgb-start}
# Depends on: mgb-core, mgb-rank (mgb_set), mg2-start2 (mg2_second, mg2_rk, mg2_tau0), inv-setup (inv_tau, inv_rank).
# Executed 2026-10-10 by the main session (R 4.6.0, lavaan 0.7.2); held as predicted.
# Module 3's rank check with beta (spec 4.8, "A second point before aborting", O7). Hypotheses, frozen before any run:
#  H-B5a  at theta0 (beta = 0, thresholds generic) every cell with the generator's psi rule is full rank at
#         the metric and scalar levels, beta free, tied or in one group;
#  H-B5b  with every binary threshold at 0 (Result G4 (ii) for the start) the scalar level is deficient at theta0
#         by the number of all-binary factors; at theta2 (beta perturbed: the literal O7 rule) by the same
#         number if beta is untied or in one group, and by mgb_def_pred(modes, tied paths) if tied;
#  H-B5c  with one common nonzero binary threshold t = .3 theta0 is deficient by the same number and theta2 is
#         full rank (lambda perturbed leaves the set), tied or not;
#  H-B5d  negative control: perturbing lambda and psi but NOT beta leaves the tied model deficient at theta2
#         exactly as at theta0. The escape in H-B5b is therefore the beta entries of the literal rule.
MGB_TAU_T <- function(K, t) lapply(K, function(k) if (k == 2L) t else qnorm(seq_len(k - 1L) / k))
mgb_cases <- list(list(d = "B", paths = list(c(2L, 1L))), list(d = "S", paths = list(c(2L, 1L))),
                  list(d = "Z", paths = list(c(2L, 1L))), list(d = "M", paths = list(c(2L, 1L))),
                  list(d = "P", paths = list(c(2L, 1L))), list(d = "Y", paths = MGB_YPATHS))
local({
for (ce in mgb_cases) {
  d <- MGB_DESIGNS[[ce$d]]; nf <- max(d$fac); allbin <- vapply(seq_len(nf), function(f) all(d$K[d$fac == f] == 2L), NA)
  for (l in c("metric", "scalar")) for (bm in c("free", "tied", "g2only")) {
    tab <- mgb_table(d$K, d$fac, l, bm, ce$paths)
    # H-B5a: generic thresholds (inv_tau: unequal binary thresholds)
    th0 <- mgb_start(tab, inv_tau(d$K)); th2 <- mg2_second(tab, th0)
    stopifnot(mgb_def(tab, th0) == 0L, mgb_def(tab, th2) == 0L)
    if (l == "metric") {                                                  # the metric level never depends on the thresholds
      stopifnot(mgb_def(tab, mgb_start(tab, mg2_tau0(d$K))) == 0L, mgb_def(tab, mg2_second(tab, mgb_start(tab, mg2_tau0(d$K)))) == 0L)
      next
    }
    modes <- which(allbin)
    # H-B5b: every binary threshold at 0
    t0 <- mgb_start(tab, mg2_tau0(d$K)); t2 <- mg2_second(tab, t0)
    want2 <- mgb_def_pred(modes, if (bm == "tied") ce$paths else list(), nf)
    cat(sprintf("zero binary thresholds, scalar, %s, beta %-6s: deficient by %d at theta0, %d at theta2\n",
                ce$d, bm, mgb_def(tab, t0), mgb_def(tab, t2)))
    stopifnot(mgb_def(tab, t0) == length(modes), mgb_def(tab, t2) == want2)
    # H-B5d: leave beta out of the perturbation
    nb <- mg2_second(tab, t0, c("lambda", "psi"))
    stopifnot(mgb_def(tab, nb) == length(modes))
    # H-B5c: a common nonzero binary threshold
    c0 <- mgb_start(tab, MGB_TAU_T(d$K, 0.3)); c2 <- mg2_second(tab, c0)
    stopifnot(mgb_def(tab, c0) == length(modes), mgb_def(tab, c2) == 0L)
  }
}
# The consequence for the abort rule: a model that passes only at theta2 is started there (spec 4.8). Here that
# is a tied-beta model on I5's set whose beta enters theta2 at a perturbation of at most .05.
tab <- mgb_table(MGB_DESIGNS$B$K, MGB_DESIGNS$B$fac, "scalar", "tied")
t0 <- mgb_start(tab, mg2_tau0(MGB_DESIGNS$B$K)); t2 <- mg2_second(tab, t0)
bi <- tab$rows$fidx[tab$rows$type == "beta"][1]
cat(sprintf("tied beta, zero thresholds: beta %.3f at theta0, %.3f at theta2; sigma_min/sigma_max %.3g, %.3g\n",
            t0[bi], t2[bi], mg2_rk(tab, t0)[["ratio"]], mg2_rk(tab, t2)[["ratio"]]))
stopifnot(abs(t2[bi]) <= 0.05, abs(t2[bi]) > 0)

# H-B6, conditioning of the rescue: sigma_min/sigma_max of Delta at the same population point (design B, scalar
# level, tied beta, F2's thresholds on I5's set) as beta moves away from 0. First-order argument (the tie makes
# the F2 scale mode cost a change of beta, dbeta = -beta du): the smallest singular value is proportional to
# |beta| near 0, so the ratio at beta = .01 is about a fifth of the ratio at .05. The band [.1, .4] was chosen after
# the drafter's numpy scratch run (.204, not evidence); rank at beta = 0 is q - 1 and at .01 it is q.
d <- MGB_DESIGNS$B; tab <- mgb_table(d$K, d$fac, "scalar", "tied")
rat <- vapply(c(0, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.4), function(bv) mg2_rk(tab, mgb_set(tab, d$K, d$fac, 2L, 0.4, bv))[["ratio"]], 0)
print(signif(setNames(rat, c(0, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.4)), 3))
stopifnot(mgb_def(tab, mgb_set(tab, d$K, d$fac, 2L, 0.4, 0)) == 1L, mgb_def(tab, mgb_set(tab, d$K, d$fac, 2L, 0.4, 0.01)) == 0L,
          all(diff(rat[2:5]) > 0), rat[2] / rat[3] > 0.1, rat[2] / rat[3] < 0.4)
})
```

```{r mgb-null}
# Depends on: mgb-core, mgb-rank (mgb_set), mg2-core (mg2_delta).
# Executed 2026-10-10 by the main session (R 4.6.0, lavaan 0.7.2); held as predicted.
# H-B7 (Result B4), frozen before any run. On I5's set for an all-binary factor f (its binary items share the
# ratio tau_j/lambda_j = c), with beta untied, the scale of f in the later group is a free direction. In theta it is
#   d omega_gj = +omega_gj u (items j of f),   d psi_gff = -2 psi_gff u,
#   d beta_fh = -beta_fh u (every path INTO f),   d beta_kf = +beta_kf u (every path OUT of f),
#   d alpha_gf = (c - alpha_gf) u,   d alpha_gk = -beta_gkf c u (every child k of f),
# and zero elsewhere. It is a null vector of Delta: |Delta n| / |n| < 1e-8 (the bound of inv-algebra (d), exact
# algebra). The omitted-alpha vector is the negative control: it must exceed 1e-4 (set before measuring: the
# omitted term is (c - alpha) times alpha's column of Delta, both of order one at this point).
mgb_theta_of <- function(tab, type, g, i, j = 1L) {
  k <- tab$rows$fidx[tab$rows$type == type & tab$rows$g == g & tab$rows$i == i & tab$rows$j == j]
  stopifnot(length(k) == 1L, !is.na(k)); k
}
mgb_null <- function(tab, th, f, cval, paths, fac, with_alpha = TRUE) {
  n <- numeric(tab$npar); P <- mg2_pars(tab, th)[[2]]
  for (j in which(fac == f)) n[mgb_theta_of(tab, "omega", 2L, j)] <- P$om[j]
  n[mgb_theta_of(tab, "psi", 2L, f, f)] <- -2 * P$Psi[f, f]
  for (pa in paths) {
    if (pa[1] == f) n[mgb_theta_of(tab, "beta", 2L, pa[1], pa[2])] <- -P$B[pa[1], pa[2]]
    if (pa[2] == f) {
      n[mgb_theta_of(tab, "beta", 2L, pa[1], pa[2])] <- P$B[pa[1], pa[2]]
      if (with_alpha) n[mgb_theta_of(tab, "alpha", 2L, pa[1])] <- n[mgb_theta_of(tab, "alpha", 2L, pa[1])] - P$B[pa[1], pa[2]] * cval
    }
  }
  if (with_alpha) n[mgb_theta_of(tab, "alpha", 2L, f)] <- n[mgb_theta_of(tab, "alpha", 2L, f)] + (cval - P$al[f])
  n
}
local({
  cases <- list(list(d = "B", f = 2L, paths = list(c(2L, 1L))),            # outcome factor: paths in
                list(d = "S", f = 1L, paths = list(c(2L, 1L))),            # predictor factor: paths out
                list(d = "Z", f = 2L, paths = list(c(2L, 1L))), list(d = "Z", f = 1L, paths = list(c(2L, 1L))),
                list(d = "Y", f = 2L, paths = MGB_YPATHS))                 # in and out
  for (ce in cases) for (cv in c(0.4, -0.3, 0)) {
    d <- MGB_DESIGNS[[ce$d]]; tab <- mgb_table(d$K, d$fac, "scalar", "free", ce$paths)
    th <- mgb_set(tab, d$K, d$fac, ce$f, cv, 0.4); D <- mg2_delta(tab, th)
    n <- mgb_null(tab, th, ce$f, cv, ce$paths, d$fac); n0 <- mgb_null(tab, th, ce$f, cv, ce$paths, d$fac, FALSE)
    stopifnot(max(abs(D %*% n)) / sqrt(sum(n^2)) < 1e-8,
              mgb_def(tab, th) == 1L)                                      # it is the only lost rank
    if (abs(cv - th[mgb_theta_of(tab, "alpha", 2L, ce$f)]) > 1e-3)         # the omitted term (c - alpha) is nonzero
      stopifnot(max(abs(D %*% n0)) / sqrt(sum(n0^2)) > 1e-4)               # negative control
  }
})
```

```{r mgb-pop}
# Depends on: mgb-core, mg2-core (mg2_sigma, mg2_delta, mg2_thetastar, mg2_pars).
# Executed 2026-10-10 by the main session (R 4.6.0, lavaan 0.7.2); held as predicted.
# H-B8, population fits (Result B5), frozen before any run. A truth that satisfies scalar invariance with a
# KNOWN raw beta per group (tau, lambda tied, nu = 0, kappa_2 = (I-B)^-1 alpha, omega from the unit diagonal) gives
# sigma. A model "contains" it iff min over theta of |sigma - sigma(theta)|^2 is zero. The minimizer is
# Levenberg-Marquardt on the closed-form Delta from four deterministic starts; the minimum over starts is used.
# Criteria (set before measuring): contained <=> F < 1e-12 (the Gauss-Newton limit on a zero-residual problem
# is rounding, ~1e-30); not contained <=> F > MGB_FLOOR = 1e-5. The floor was chosen after the drafter's numpy
# scratch run measured misfits of 4.9e-4 to 7e-2 on the cells below (a port, not evidence): it is 50 times below
# the smallest. A cell that lands between 1e-12 and 1e-5 fails both ways and is reported, not repaired.
MGB_FLOOR <- 1e-5
mgb_truth <- function(K, fac, bet = c(.4, .4), phi1 = c(1, 1.44), psi2 = c(1, 1.3), alpha = c(.3, .2),
                      th2 = .3 + .05 * seq_along(K)) {
  stopifnot(phi1[1] == 1, psi2[1] == 1)
  tab <- mgb_table(K, fac, "scalar", "free"); R <- tab$rows; p <- length(K); th <- numeric(tab$npar)
  lam <- 0.55 + 0.04 * seq_len(p)
  tk <- lapply(seq_len(p), function(j) if (K[j] == 2L) -0.6 + 0.25 * (j - 1) else qnorm(seq_len(K[j] - 1L) / K[j]))
  Ph2 <- { A <- solve(diag(2) - matrix(c(0, 0, bet[2], 0), 2, byrow = TRUE)); A %*% diag(c(phi1[2], psi2[2])) %*% t(A) }
  for (r in which(R$free)) th[R$fidx[r]] <- switch(R$type[r],
    tau = tk[[R$i[r]]][R$j[r]], lambda = lam[R$i[r]], beta = bet[R$g[r]], psi = c(phi1[2], psi2[2])[R$i[r]],
    alpha = alpha[R$i[r]], omega = 1 / sqrt(lam[R$i[r]]^2 * Ph2[fac[R$i[r]], fac[R$i[r]]] + th2[R$i[r]]))
  stopifnot(all(unlist(mg2_thetastar(tab, th)) > 0))                         # a legal population in both groups
  list(tab = tab, theta = th, sigma = mg2_sigma(tab, th), tauK = tk)
}
mgb_lm <- function(tab, s, th0, maxit = 300L) {
  th <- th0; lam <- 1e-2; r <- s - mg2_sigma(tab, th); F <- sum(r^2)
  for (it in seq_len(maxit)) {
    J <- mg2_delta(tab, th); g <- crossprod(J, r); H <- crossprod(J); ok <- FALSE
    while (lam < 1e12) {
      step <- tryCatch(solve(H + lam * diag(diag(H) + 1e-9), g), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(step)) {
        rn <- tryCatch(s - mg2_sigma(tab, th + drop(step)), error = function(e) NULL)
        if (!is.null(rn) && all(is.finite(rn)) && sum(rn^2) < F) {
          th <- th + drop(step); r <- rn; F <- sum(rn^2); lam <- max(lam / 3, 1e-12); ok <- TRUE; break }
      }
      lam <- lam * 4
    }
    if (!ok || F < 1e-26 || sqrt(sum(step^2)) < 1e-14) break
  }
  list(theta = th, F = F)
}
mgb_misfit <- function(tab, s, tauK, nst = 4L) {
  best <- Inf
  for (k in seq_len(nst)) {
    th0 <- mgb_start(tab, tauK); if (k > 1L) th0 <- th0 + 0.05 * sin(k * seq_along(th0))
    best <- min(best, mgb_lm(tab, s, th0)$F)
  }
  best
}
local({
  b2z <- function(b1, phi, psi) {                                            # raw beta_2 that equalizes r, given Phi_11 and psi_22 in group 2
    r2 <- b1^2 / (b1^2 + 1); sqrt(r2 / (1 - r2) * psi / phi) }
  truths <- list(
    TR1 = list(bet = c(.4, .4)),                                              # raw beta equal; group-2 variances differ from 1
    TR2 = list(bet = c(.4, .2)),                                              # raw beta unequal (negative control)
    TR3 = list(bet = c(.4, .4 * sqrt(1.3))),                                  # beta / sqrt(psi_22) equal, raw beta unequal
    TR4 = list(bet = c(.4, b2z(.4, 1.5, 1)), phi1 = c(1, 1.5), psi2 = c(1, 1)))   # standardized association equal, raw beta unequal
  want <- list(                                                              # TRUE: contained, FALSE: not contained
    P = list(TR1 = c(metric_tied = TRUE,  scalar_tied = TRUE),  TR2 = c(metric_tied = FALSE, scalar_tied = FALSE)),
    B = list(TR1 = c(metric_free = TRUE,  metric_tied = FALSE, scalar_free = TRUE, scalar_tied = TRUE),
             TR3 = c(metric_tied = TRUE,  scalar_tied = FALSE)),
    Z = list(TR1 = c(metric_free = TRUE,  metric_tied = FALSE, scalar_free = TRUE, scalar_tied = TRUE),
             TR4 = c(metric_tied = TRUE,  scalar_tied = FALSE)))
  out <- list()
  for (dn in names(want)) for (tn in names(want[[dn]])) {
    d <- MGB_DESIGNS[[dn]]; args <- c(list(K = d$K, fac = d$fac), truths[[tn]])
    tr <- do.call(mgb_truth, args)
    for (mn in names(want[[dn]][[tn]])) {
      lv <- strsplit(mn, "_")[[1]][1]; bm <- strsplit(mn, "_")[[1]][2]
      tab <- mgb_table(d$K, d$fac, lv, bm); Fm <- mgb_misfit(tab, tr$sigma, tr$tauK)
      out[[length(out) + 1L]] <- data.frame(design = dn, truth = tn, model = mn, F = Fm, contained = want[[dn]][[tn]][[mn]])
    }
  }
  out <- do.call(rbind, out); print(out, digits = 3)
  stopifnot(out$F[out$contained] < 1e-12, out$F[!out$contained] > MGB_FLOOR)
})
```

```{r mgb-lav-funs}
# Depends on: mgb-core, inv-setup (inv_tau), mg2-lavaan (mg2_lav_implied, MG2_TOL_IMP), mg-lavaan (mg_parts).
# Executed 2026-10-10 by the main session (R 4.6.0, lavaan 0.7.2); held as predicted.
# lavaan syntax for a beta model, EXPLICIT (nothing relies on lavaan's automatic freeing or fixing, the rule of
# inv_syntax). lavaan's "f ~~ f" of an endogenous factor is its RESIDUAL (disturbance) variance, which is psi.
mgb_syntax <- function(K, fac, level, beta = "free", paths = list(c(2L, 1L)), psi = "gen", nfac = max(fac), bval = 0.4) {
  # bval and mode "fixed" added by mgb-fixed-prereg (2026-10-10): a beta fixed at bval in both groups.
  p <- length(K); y <- paste0("y", seq_len(p)); beta <- rep_len(beta, length(paths))
  poly <- vapply(seq_len(nfac), function(f) any(K[fac == f] > 2L), NA)
  tied_tau <- level != "configural"; tied_lam <- level %in% c("metric", "scalar")
  out <- character()
  for (f in seq_len(nfac)) {
    it <- which(fac == f)
    ld <- if (tied_lam) sprintf("c(l%d,l%d)*%s", it, it, y[it]) else sprintf("c(NA,NA)*%s", y[it])
    out <- c(out, paste0("f", f, " =~ ", paste(ld, collapse = " + ")))
  }
  if (tied_tau) for (j in seq_len(p)) {
    cc <- seq_len(K[j] - 1L)
    out <- c(out, sprintf("%s | %s", y[j], paste(sprintf("c(t%d_%d,t%d_%d)*t%d", j, cc, j, cc, cc), collapse = " + ")))
  }
  for (ip in seq_along(paths)) {
    a <- paths[[ip]][1]; b <- paths[[ip]][2]
    lab <- switch(beta[ip], free = "c(NA,NA)", tied = sprintf("c(b%d_%d,b%d_%d)", a, b, a, b), g2only = "c(0,NA)",
                  g1only = "c(NA,0)", none = NA_character_, fixed = sprintf("c(%s,%s)", format(bval), format(bval)), stop("no lavaan form for this beta mode"))
    if (!is.na(lab)) out <- c(out, sprintf("f%d ~ %s*f%d", a, lab, b))
  }
  psi_free <- vapply(seq_len(nfac), function(f) switch(level, scalar = TRUE,
                       metric = if (is.logical(psi)) psi[f] else switch(psi, gen = poly[f], fixed = FALSE, free = TRUE), FALSE), NA)
  om_free <- switch(level, configural = rep(FALSE, p), thresholds = K > 2L, rep(TRUE, p))
  nu_free <- level %in% c("thresholds", "metric")
  c(out,
    sprintf("%s ~*~ c(1,%s)*%s", y, ifelse(om_free, "NA", "1"), y),
    sprintf("%s ~ c(0,%s)*1", y, if (nu_free) "NA" else "0"),
    sprintf("f%d ~~ c(1,%s)*f%d", seq_len(nfac), ifelse(psi_free, "NA", "1"), seq_len(nfac)),
    sprintf("f%d ~ c(0,%s)*1", seq_len(nfac), if (level == "scalar") "NA" else "0")) |> paste(collapse = "\n")
}
mgb_sim <- function(K, fac, N = c(1200L, 2800L), bet = c(.4, .4), phi1 = c(1, 1.44), psi2 = c(1, 1.3), alpha = c(.3, .2), seed = 1L) {
  set.seed(seed); p <- length(K); lam <- 0.55 + 0.04 * seq_len(p); tau <- inv_tau(K)
  # group 1: unit total latent-response variance (the delta reference); group 2: nu = 0, same lambda and tau,
  # its own factor mean / variance / residuals. Truth is scalar-invariant with raw beta equal to bet.
  one <- function(n, b, ph1, ps2, al, th) {
    f1 <- rnorm(n, al[1], sqrt(ph1)); f2 <- al[2] + b * f1 + rnorm(n, 0, sqrt(ps2)); Fm <- cbind(f1, f2)
    sapply(seq_len(p), function(j) findInterval(lam[j] * Fm[, fac[j]] + rnorm(n, 0, sqrt(th[j])), tau[[j]]))
  }
  ph22 <- bet[1]^2 * phi1[1] + psi2[1]
  th1 <- 1 - lam^2 * c(phi1[1], ph22)[fac]; th2 <- seq(.4, .8, length.out = p)
  d <- data.frame(g = rep(1:2, times = N),
                  rbind(one(N[1], bet[1], phi1[1], psi2[1], c(0, 0), th1), one(N[2], bet[2], phi1[2], psi2[2], alpha, th2)))
  names(d)[-1] <- paste0("y", seq_len(p))
  for (g in 1:2) for (j in seq_len(p)) stopifnot(length(unique(d[d$g == g, j + 1L])) == K[j])   # no empty category (O6 is not under test)
  d
}
mgb_fit <- function(dat, K, fac, level, beta = "free", paths = list(c(2L, 1L)), psi = "gen", syntax = NULL, ...) {
  p <- length(K); warns <- character()
  fit <- withCallingHandlers(
    sem(if (is.null(syntax)) mgb_syntax(K, fac, level, beta, paths, psi) else syntax, data = dat, group = "g",
        ordered = paste0("y", seq_len(p)), estimator = "WLSMV", parameterization = "delta", std.lv = TRUE,
        auto.cov.y = FALSE, auto.cov.lv.x = FALSE, ...),
    warning = function(w) { warns <<- c(warns, conditionMessage(w)); invokeRestart("muffleWarning") })
  list(fit = fit, warns = warns, conv = lavInspect(fit, "converged"), df = unname(fitMeasures(fit, "df")),
       npar = unname(fitMeasures(fit, "npar")),
       delta = { B <- lavaan:::lav_con_eq_basis(fit@Model); D <- do.call(rbind, lavTech(fit, "delta")); if (is.null(B)) D else D %*% B })
}
```

```{r mgb-lavaan}
# Depends on: mgb-lav-funs (mgb_syntax, mgb_sim, mgb_fit), mgb-core, mg2-core (mg2_sigma, mg2_dcols, mg2_delta, mg2_pars,
# mg2_tpos, mg2_Dg, mg2_off, mg2_thr_rows), mg2-lavaan (mg2_lav_implied, MG2_TOL_IMP), mg2-lavdelta (MG2_TOL_LD),
# mg-setup and mg-lavaan (mg_pool, mg_traces_q, mg_ab, mg_acov, mg_rel, mg_parts, mg_Tcand), inv-setup (inv_rank, INV_TOL).
# Executed 2026-10-10 by the main session (R 4.6.0, lavaan 0.7.2): H-L1-H-L4 and H-L6 held; H-L5 FAILED (kept, see
# its block; diagnosis after the failure: lavaan's group.equal route frees group 2's nu, fixes alpha = 0 and frees
# omega only for some items in M and B, a different parameterization; which level it matches is not established).
# Hypotheses, frozen before any run (lavaan 0.7.2, delta, WLSMV, G = 2, N = 1200 and 2800 (unequal, so that T's candidates B and C differ), seed 20261010):
#  H-L1  df: lavaan's df = Result B2 (mgb_df) for designs P (all polytomous), M (mixed, binary items in both
#        factors) and B (the outcome all binary), levels configural, metric, scalar, beta free and tied;
#        lavaan converges; Delta at lavaan's estimates has rank = lavaan's npar (locally identified).
#  H-L2  sigma at lavaan's estimates, through mg2_sigma on the mgb table, equals lavInspect(fit, "implied"):
#        <= MG2_TOL_IMP = 1e-10 (the mg2-lavaan bound, exact algebra, accessor path read not audited).
#  H-L3  every table row's closed-form Delta column equals lavaan's Delta column of the matching free parameter:
#        <= MG2_TOL_LD = 1e-10 (mg2-lavdelta's bound).
#  H-L4  the factor means kappa_g = (I - B_g)^-1 alpha_g equal lavInspect(fit, "mean.lv"): <= 1e-10. alpha of an
#        endogenous factor is an intercept: kappa_2 = alpha_2 + beta alpha_1 (the chunk asserts that identity too).
#  H-L5  (group.equal) lavaan's group.equal = c("thresholds","loadings") IS the scalar level (nu = 0, group-2
#        means, variances and scales free) and adding "regressions" ties beta: same df as the scalar level with
#        beta free / tied, and chi-square equal to the explicit fit to 1e-6 (the inv-lavaan `same` bound,
#        chosen after measuring there, inherited, not re-measured for beta). lavaan has no group.equal route to the
#        metric level; that level is written explicitly.
#  H-L6  negative control: design B, metric level, psi_22 of group 2 free (an all-binary OUTCOME factor): lavaan
#        counts df = D - npar as if identified, and rank(Delta) = npar - 1.
mgb_fit_all <- function() {
  out <- list()
  for (dn in c("P", "M", "B")) {
    d <- MGB_DESIGNS[[dn]]; dat <- mgb_sim(d$K, d$fac, seed = 20261010L)
    for (l in c("configural", "metric", "scalar")) for (bm in c("free", "tied"))
      out[[paste(dn, l, bm, sep = ".")]] <- c(mgb_fit(dat, d$K, d$fac, l, bm), list(dn = dn, level = l, beta = bm, dat = dat))
  }
  out
}
mgb_from_lavaan <- function(tab, fit) {
  est <- lavInspect(fit, "est"); R <- tab$rows; th <- rep(NA_real_, tab$npar)
  for (r in which(R$free)) {
    g <- R$g[r]; i <- R$i[r]; j <- R$j[r]; e <- est[[g]]
    v <- switch(R$type[r], tau = e$tau[mg2_tpos(tab$K[[g]], i, j), 1], lambda = e$lambda[i, j], beta = e$beta[i, j],
                psi = e$psi[i, j], nu = e$nu[i, 1], omega = e$delta[i, 1], alpha = e$alpha[i, 1])
    f <- R$fidx[r]
    if (is.na(th[f])) th[f] <- v else stopifnot(abs(th[f] - v) < 1e-9)       # tied rows carry one value
  }
  th
}
mgb_lav_map <- function(tab, fit) {            # lavaan's free parameters (in `free` order) -> the table's free rows
  pt <- parTable(fit); fr <- pt[pt$free > 0, ]; fr <- fr[order(fr$free), ]
  ov <- lavNames(fit, "ov"); lv <- lavNames(fit, "lv")
  key_l <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(fr)), function(k) { x <- fr[k, ]; g <- as.integer(x$group)
    switch(x$op,
      "=~" = paste("lambda", g, match(x$rhs, ov), match(x$lhs, lv)),
      "|"  = paste("tau", g, match(x$lhs, ov), as.integer(sub("t", "", x$rhs))),
      "~~" = paste("psi", g, match(x$lhs, lv), match(x$rhs, lv)),
      "~*~" = paste("omega", g, match(x$lhs, ov), 1L),
      "~1" = if (x$lhs %in% ov) paste("nu", g, match(x$lhs, ov), 1L) else paste("alpha", g, match(x$lhs, lv), 1L),
      "~"  = paste("beta", g, match(x$lhs, lv), match(x$rhs, lv)),
      NA_character_) }, "")
  fr_rows <- which(tab$rows$free); key_o <- with(tab$rows[fr_rows, ], paste(type, g, i, j))
  m <- match(key_l, key_o)
  stopifnot(!anyNA(key_l), !anyNA(m), length(m) == length(fr_rows), anyDuplicated(m) == 0L)
  list(m = m, fr_rows = fr_rows, nfree = nrow(fr))
}
mgb_fits <- mgb_fit_all()
mgb_lav <- do.call(rbind, lapply(mgb_fits, function(r) {
  d <- MGB_DESIGNS[[r$dn]]; tab <- mgb_table(d$K, d$fac, r$level, r$beta); fit <- r$fit
  th <- mgb_from_lavaan(tab, fit); mp <- mgb_lav_map(tab, fit); P <- mg2_pars(tab, th)
  Dl <- do.call(rbind, lavTech(fit, "delta"))
  kap_l <- lavInspect(fit, "mean.lv")
  kap <- lapply(P, function(Pg) drop(solve(diag(tab$m) - Pg$B) %*% Pg$al))
  stopifnot(nrow(Dl) == sum(mg2_Dg(tab)), ncol(Dl) == mp$nfree)
  data.frame(design = r$dn, level = r$level, beta = r$beta, conv = r$conv, lav_df = as.integer(r$df),
             df_B2 = mgb_df(d$K, d$fac, r$level, mgb_nb(r$beta, 1L)), npar = as.integer(r$npar), mine_npar = tab$npar,
             rank = inv_rank(r$delta),
             gap_imp = max(abs(mg2_sigma(tab, th) - mg2_lav_implied(fit))),
             gap_delta = max(abs(mg2_dcols(tab, th)[, mp$m] - Dl)),
             gap_kappa = max(abs(unlist(kap) - unlist(lapply(kap_l, as.numeric)))),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
rownames(mgb_lav) <- NULL; print(mgb_lav, digits = 3)
stopifnot(mgb_lav$conv, mgb_lav$lav_df == mgb_lav$df_B2, mgb_lav$npar == mgb_lav$mine_npar, mgb_lav$rank == mgb_lav$npar,   # H-L1
          mgb_lav$gap_imp < MG2_TOL_IMP,                                                                                   # H-L2
          mgb_lav$gap_delta < MG2_TOL_LD,                                                                                  # H-L3
          mgb_lav$gap_kappa < 1e-10)                                                                                       # H-L4

local({                                                                      # H-L4, the intercept identity, on a scalar fit
  r <- mgb_fits[["M.scalar.free"]]; d <- MGB_DESIGNS$M; tab <- mgb_table(d$K, d$fac, "scalar", "free")
  P <- mg2_pars(tab, mgb_from_lavaan(tab, r$fit))[[2]]
  stopifnot(abs(drop(solve(diag(2) - P$B) %*% P$al)[2] - (P$al[2] + P$B[2, 1] * P$al[1])) < 1e-14,
            abs(P$al[2] - drop(solve(diag(2) - P$B) %*% P$al)[2]) > 1e-3)    # alpha_2 is an intercept: it is not the mean of F2
})

local({                                                                      # H-L5, lavaan's group.equal route
  for (dn in c("P", "M", "B")) {
    d <- MGB_DESIGNS[[dn]]; y <- paste0("y", seq_along(d$K)); dat <- mgb_fits[[paste(dn, "scalar.free", sep = ".")]]$dat
    mod <- paste0("f1 =~ ", paste(y[d$fac == 1], collapse = " + "), "\nf2 =~ ", paste(y[d$fac == 2], collapse = " + "), "\nf2 ~ f1")
    for (ge in list(c("thresholds", "loadings"), c("thresholds", "loadings", "regressions"))) {
      fit <- suppressWarnings(sem(mod, data = dat, group = "g", ordered = y, estimator = "WLSMV", parameterization = "delta",
                                  std.lv = TRUE, group.equal = ge))
      bm <- if ("regressions" %in% ge) "tied" else "free"; ex <- mgb_fits[[paste(dn, "scalar", bm, sep = ".")]]$fit
      # H-L5 FAILED on the first main-session run (2026-10-10, lavaan 0.7.2) and is kept as a failure: the
      # preregistered assertion is replaced by this record, nothing loosened. The df pairs below are the result.
      ok <- lavInspect(fit, "converged") && unname(fitMeasures(fit, "df")) == unname(fitMeasures(ex, "df")) &&
            abs(unname(fitMeasures(fit, "chisq")) - unname(fitMeasures(ex, "chisq"))) < 1e-6
      cat(sprintf("H-L5 %s %-34s df group.equal %d, scalar level %d: %s\n", dn, paste(ge, collapse = "+"),
                  as.integer(fitMeasures(fit, "df")), as.integer(fitMeasures(ex, "df")), if (ok) "held" else "FAILED"))
      stopifnot(lavInspect(fit, "converged"), !ok)    # the recorded failure must reproduce
    }
  }
})

local({                                                                      # H-L6
  d <- MGB_DESIGNS$B; dat <- mgb_fits[["B.metric.free"]]$dat
  r <- mgb_fit(dat, d$K, d$fac, "metric", "free", psi = c(TRUE, TRUE)); tab <- mgb_table(d$K, d$fac, "metric", "free", psi = c(TRUE, TRUE))
  cat(sprintf("negative control: lavaan df %d (nominal), npar %d, rank(Delta) %d\n", as.integer(r$df), tab$npar, inv_rank(r$delta)))
  stopifnot(as.integer(r$df) == nrow(r$delta) - tab$npar, inv_rank(r$delta) == tab$npar - 1L)
})
```

```{r mgb-infer}
# Depends on: mgb-lavaan (mgb_fits, mgb_from_lavaan, mgb_lav_map), mgb-core, mg2-core (mg2_delta, mg2_Dg, mg2_off,
# mg2_thr_rows), mg-setup (mg_pool, mg_traces_q, mg_ab, mg_acov, mg_rel), mg-lavaan (mg_parts, mg_Tcand, mg_T_convention).
# Executed 2026-10-10 by the main session (R 4.6.0, lavaan 0.7.2), first AFTER the preregistered H-L5 failure in mgb-lavaan,
# in diagnostic mode: what it shows held as predicted, but it is not preregistered evidence.
# H-I (inference needs nothing new for beta), frozen before any run. The pooled scaling of @sec-multigroup-scaling
# (weighting (a), T = (N-G)F, e(V) = ACOV/(N-G), the traces of MG4) uses Delta only as a stacked matrix with tied
# columns, so a beta model enters through Delta's beta columns (MS2) and nothing else. Hence, with the production
# Delta replaced by the closed-form mgb Delta at lavaan's estimates and lavaan's own Gamma_g and W_g:
#  H-I1  T3 = a T + b, with T lavaan's unscaled statistic (the convention found in mg-lavaan) and (a, b) from the MG4
#        traces, equals lavaan's chisq.scaled: relative difference <= MGB_TOL_T3 = 1e-8 (mg-lavaan's bound);
#  H-I2  ACOV / (N - G), mapped into lavaan's labelled free-parameter basis, equals vcov(fit): relative <= MGB_TOL_V
#        = 1e-7. Set before measuring: Delta agrees to 1e-10 (H-L3) and the bread's condition number is below 1e3
#        on these fits, so 1e-7 leaves a factor 1e3 over the propagated rounding. mg-lavaan's 1e-9 compares lavaan's
#        Delta with itself, which this does not;
#  H-I3  negative control, as corrected after the drafter's scratch run (R 4.3.3, lavaan 0.6.17, not evidence):
#        as first drafted it predicted that a Delta whose beta columns have zero threshold entries would miss BOTH
#        T3 and vcov. It misses vcov only. T3 depends on Delta through col(Delta) alone (U projects off it), and
#        the threshold part of a beta column, -omega kappa_b L_ja (MS2), is kappa_b times alpha_a's column, so the
#        mutated column stays in the span. The corrected hypothesis, to be tested as stated: at the SCALAR level
#        (kappa != 0) the mutation moves vcov by more than MGB_TOL_MUT = 1e-4 (set before measuring) and leaves T3
#        within MGB_TOL_T3; at the metric level (kappa = 0) it changes nothing.
MGB_TOL_T3 <- 1e-8; MGB_TOL_V <- 1e-7; MGB_TOL_MUT <- 1e-4
mgb_infer <- function(r, mutate = NULL) {
  d <- MGB_DESIGNS[[r$dn]]; tab <- mgb_table(d$K, d$fac, r$level, r$beta); fit <- r$fit
  pp <- mg_parts(fit); th <- mgb_from_lavaan(tab, fit); mp <- mgb_lav_map(tab, fit)
  D <- mg2_delta(tab, th); if (!is.null(mutate)) D <- mutate(D, tab)
  Dg <- lapply(1:2, function(g) D[mg2_off(tab)[g] + seq_len(mg2_Dg(tab)[g]), , drop = FALSE])
  po <- mg_pool(pp$Gam, Dg, pp$wv, pp$n_g); stopifnot(po$Dtot == pp$Dtot, po$q == tab$npar)
  ab <- mg_ab(mg_traces_q(po), po$Dtot - po$q)
  Tc <- mg_Tcand(pp); hit <- names(Tc)[abs(Tc / fit@test$standard$stat - 1) < 1e-9]
  stopifnot(identical(hit, mg_T_convention[["h1"]]))                         # the convention already measured in mg-lavaan
  T3 <- ab[["a"]] * Tc[[hit]] + ab[["b"]]; lavT3 <- unname(fitMeasures(fit, "chisq.scaled"))
  S <- matrix(0, mp$nfree, tab$npar); S[cbind(seq_len(mp$nfree), tab$rows$fidx[mp$fr_rows][mp$m])] <- 1
  Vm <- S %*% (mg_acov(po) / (po$N - po$G)) %*% t(S)
  c(T3 = abs(T3 / lavT3 - 1), V = mg_rel(Vm, unname(vcov(fit))))
}
mgb_mut <- function(D, tab) {                                                  # zero the threshold entries of every beta column
  D[mg2_thr_rows(tab), unique(tab$rows$fidx[tab$rows$free & tab$rows$type == "beta"])] <- 0; D }
mgb_inf <- do.call(rbind, lapply(mgb_fits, function(r) {
  m0 <- mgb_infer(r); m1 <- mgb_infer(r, mgb_mut)
  data.frame(design = r$dn, level = r$level, beta = r$beta, T3 = m0[["T3"]], V = m0[["V"]], T3_mut = m1[["T3"]], V_mut = m1[["V"]])
}))
rownames(mgb_inf) <- NULL; print(mgb_inf, digits = 3)
stopifnot(mgb_inf$T3 < MGB_TOL_T3, mgb_inf$V < MGB_TOL_V)                                                 # H-I1, H-I2
mgb_sc <- mgb_inf$level == "scalar"
stopifnot(mgb_inf$V_mut[mgb_sc] > MGB_TOL_MUT, mgb_inf$T3_mut < MGB_TOL_T3,                                   # H-I3: vcov moves, T3 does not
          mgb_inf$V_mut[!mgb_sc] < MGB_TOL_V)                                                                 # vacuous where kappa = 0
```

```{r mgb-checks}
# Depends on: mgb-core, c11-defs (c11_group, c11_check), mg2-core (mg2_table), inv-setup (inv_rank).
# Executed 2026-10-10 by the main session (R 4.6.0, lavaan 0.7.2), first AFTER the preregistered H-L5 failure in mgb-lavaan,
# in diagnostic mode: what it shows held as predicted, but it is not preregistered evidence.
# H-C (what check 11 and check 8 see), frozen before any run.
#  H-C1  check 11 reads the table group by group (Q-2: omega multiplies, so omscales = TRUE) and needs nothing new for
#        beta. (a) No table of the grid, user-written beta free, tied, in one group or fixed, with every loading free,
#        is refused. (b) A user-fixed F2 loading (item 4 of design P, value .9) with beta FIXED at .5 and unit
#        disturbance variance has Theta_44 = 1 - .81 (beta^2 + psi_22) = -0.0125 (the Case E / r8 value, 1e-12), and is
#        refused in group 1 at every level and in group 2 exactly where omega does not multiply (configural: omega
#        absent = fixed 1). (c) The same text with beta free or tied is not refused: a boundary forced through a free
#        parameter is not refused, and a tied element is free (G2).
#  H-C2  check 8 as proposed in Architecture principle 5 ("tied in H0, untied in H1 is a nested pair") needs one rule
#        beyond row-by-row free/fixed: rows that share a theta element in H1 must share one (or be fixed at the same
#        value) in H0. (a) beta tied in H0 against beta free in H1, everything else equal: nested, d = 1 = the
#        difference in df (mgb_df). (b) beta absent in H0 (fixed at 0) against free in H1: nested, d = 2 per path.
#        (c) The pair "beta tied and lambda_1 untied in H0, beta free, lambda_1 tied and lambda_2 untied in H1" has d = 1, equal free/
#        fixed status everywhere and the right df difference, so a count-and-status check ACCEPTS it, yet H0 is not a
#        restriction of H1; the closure rule refuses it. (d) metric against configural stays refused (nu and omega
#        rows free in H0, absent in H1): the generated-chain exemption is still needed.
mgb_c11 <- function(tab) {
  R <- tab$rows; p <- tab$p; m <- tab$m
  lapply(seq_len(tab$G), function(g) {
    Rg <- R[R$g == g, ]
    Lam <- matrix(0, p, m); Lfree <- matrix(FALSE, p, m); Psi <- matrix(0, m, m); Pfree <- matrix(FALSE, m, m)
    B <- matrix(0, m, m); Bfree <- matrix(FALSE, m, m); om <- rep(1, p); omfree <- rep(FALSE, p)
    for (r in seq_len(nrow(Rg))) {
      x <- Rg[r, ]
      switch(x$type,
        lambda = { Lam[x$i, x$j] <- x$val; Lfree[x$i, x$j] <- x$free },
        beta   = { B[x$i, x$j] <- x$val;   Bfree[x$i, x$j] <- x$free },
        psi    = { Psi[x$i, x$j] <- x$val; Pfree[x$i, x$j] <- x$free },
        omega  = { om[x$i] <- x$val; omfree[x$i] <- x$free },
        NULL)
    }
    c11_group(Lam, Lfree, Psi, Pfree, B, Bfree, om, omfree, omscales = TRUE)
  })
}
# The check-8 rule proposed in principle 5, on the R image of the tables. A row absent from a table is fixed at
# its type's default (omega 1, every other type 0: spec 4.8 G4). closure = FALSE is the count-and-status version.
mgb_nest <- function(t0, t1, closure = TRUE) {
  stopifnot(identical(t0$K, t1$K), t0$m == t1$m)
  key <- function(t) paste(t$rows$g, t$rows$type, t$rows$i, t$rows$j)
  k0 <- key(t0); k1 <- key(t1); allk <- union(k0, k1); i0 <- match(allk, k0); i1 <- match(allk, k1)
  ty <- vapply(strsplit(allk, " "), `[`, "", 2L)
  pick <- function(t, ii, col, dflt) { v <- t$rows[[col]][ii]; v[is.na(ii)] <- dflt[is.na(ii)]; v }
  dv <- ifelse(ty == "omega", 1, 0)
  f0 <- pick(t0, i0, "free", rep(FALSE, length(allk))); f1 <- pick(t1, i1, "free", rep(FALSE, length(allk)))
  v0 <- pick(t0, i0, "val", dv); v1 <- pick(t1, i1, "val", dv)
  why <- character()
  if (any(f0 & !f1)) why <- c(why, "a parameter free in H0 is fixed or absent in H1")
  if (any(!f0 & !f1 & v0 != v1)) why <- c(why, "a parameter fixed in both takes different values")
  if (closure) {
    st0 <- ifelse(f0, paste0("F", pick(t0, i0, "fidx", rep(NA, length(allk)))), paste0("V", v0))
    cls <- split(st0[f1], pick(t1, i1, "fidx", rep(NA, length(allk)))[f1])
    if (any(vapply(cls, function(z) length(unique(z)) > 1L, NA))) why <- c(why, "H1 equates rows that H0 leaves apart")
  }
  d <- t1$npar - t0$npar
  if (d < 1L) why <- c(why, "d < 1")
  list(ok = !length(why), why = why, d = d)
}
mgb_retie <- function(tab, fn) { R <- tab$rows; R$fidx <- NULL; mg2_table(tab$K, tab$m, fn(R)) }   # edit the tie column, recompute theta

local({
  # H-C1 (a)
  for (dn in c("P", "M", "B", "S", "Z")) { d <- MGB_DESIGNS[[dn]]
    for (l in MGB_LEVELS) for (bm in c("free", "tied", "g2only", "fixed")) {
      tab <- mgb_table(d$K, d$fac, l, bm, bval = 0.4); stopifnot(!c11_check(mgb_c11(tab))$refused) } }
  # H-C1 (b), (c)
  d <- MGB_DESIGNS$P
  for (l in MGB_LEVELS) {
    tab <- mgb_table(d$K, d$fac, l, "fixed", fixlam = list(item = 4L, val = 0.9), bval = 0.5); ck <- c11_check(mgb_c11(tab))
```
